AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争当局提供了具体的评估参数和指导原则，建议除明确共谋协议外，其他算法使用应在合理原则下评估，避免过度抑制算法创新。

title: Investing Around Elections
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: Investing Around Elections
detail.abstract: How do elections affect firms' growth strategies? Using administrative data on large capital expenditure projects in India (1995-2024) and exploiting 171 staggered state elections, I apply a real options framework to show that pre-electoral uncertainty produces opposing effects on investment behavior. In a stacked differences-in-differences design, I find firms delay new project announcements by 7% in the three months before elections while simultaneously accelerating existing project completions by a similar magnitude. This divergent response---exercising options to delay versus accelerate---challenges the conventional view that political uncertainty uniformly depresses economic activity. After elections, firms appear to strategically reallocate capital to curry favor with new leadership: with the incoming chief minister's home district receiving a disproportionate increase in new investment projects. These findings demonstrate that electoral cycles create distinct strategic logics for capital deployment, with firms using both timing and geography as tools for navigating political uncertainty and building access to power.

AI.tldr: 本文通过印度171次州选举数据发现，选举前企业会推迟新项目7%但同时加速完成现有项目，选举后企业会战略性地将投资重新分配到新任首席部长的家乡地区以建立政治关系。
AI.research_question: 选举如何影响企业的增长策略？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统观点，即政治不确定性会统一抑制经济活动，探索选举周期中企业资本配置的复杂战略逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物期权框架，用于分析企业在政治不确定性下的投资决策。
AI.method: 使用印度大型资本支出项目行政数据（1995-2024），采用堆叠双重差分设计，分析171次交错州选举的影响。
AI.findings: 选举前三个月，企业推迟新项目宣布7%，同时加速现有项目完成7%；选举后，企业将新投资项目不成比例地分配到新任首席部长的家乡地区。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战政治不确定性统一抑制投资的观点，揭示企业使用时间和地理作为应对政治不确定性和建立权力接入的战略工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供在选举周期中优化资本配置的战略指导，帮助政策制定者理解选举对投资决策的影响机制。

title: Managing Supporting Services for Product Competition: Exclusivity Strategies and Policy Implications
affiliations: School of Management, Zhejiang University, University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management and University of Texas at Dallas - Department of Information Systems & Operations Management

detail.title: Managing Supporting Services for Product Competition: Exclusivity Strategies and Policy Implications
detail.abstract: We investigate whether a firm with an advantageous proprietary supporting service (e.g., Tesla’s Supercharger network) should keep the service exclusive to its own product in a competitive setting. To do so, we model a duopoly where a focal service‑advantageous firm and a competitor price and sell substitutable products over two stages with the focal firm also making service-exclusivity decisions. Adopting the rational expectation equilibrium concept, we explicitly characterize the equilibrium prices and service-exclusivity decisions as well as customer choices. We show that, even with unchanging market fundamentals, the focal firm may strategically switch its supporting service policy from exclusive in the early stage to open in the mature stage. We then endogenize the focal firm's investment to enhance its supporting service and study whether and when the government should mandate open supporting services to maximize social welfare. We find that when the service is highly significant in terms of value advantage and revenue generation, such mandates are not necessary; as the significance decreases, the optimal policy shifts to an immediate mandate, a delayed mandate, and no mandate. Finally, we show that the focal firm's ability to commit to future service-exclusivity policies does not structurally impact the government's optimal mandate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有优势专有配套服务的企业是否应在竞争环境中保持服务专有性。研究发现，即使市场基本面不变，企业可能策略性地从早期阶段的专有服务转向成熟阶段的开放服务。政府应根据服务的重要性程度决定是否强制开放服务，而企业对未来服务专有性政策的承诺能力不影响政府的最优政策。
AI.research_question: 具有优势专有配套服务的企业是否应该保持服务专有性？
AI.motivation: 在竞争环境中，企业面临是否开放其优势配套服务的战略决策问题，如特斯拉的超级充电网络是否应向其他品牌开放。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双寡头竞争模型、理性预期均衡概念、两阶段定价与服务专有性决策
AI.method: 建立双寡头竞争模型，采用理性预期均衡概念，明确刻画均衡价格、服务专有性决策和客户选择
AI.findings: 即使市场基本面不变，企业可能策略性地从早期专有服务转向成熟期开放服务；政府应根据服务重要性程度决定是否强制开放服务
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了企业服务专有性策略的动态变化规律，为服务开放决策提供了理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定服务开放策略和政府制定监管政策提供了实践指导

title: The Regulation of Astroturfing: A Submission to the Senate Select Committee on Information Integrity on Climate Change and Energy
affiliations: Queensland University of Technology (QUT)

detail.title: The Regulation of Astroturfing: A Submission to the Senate Select Committee on Information Integrity on Climate Change and Energy
detail.abstract: This submission focuses on the origins, growth, and prevalence of astroturfing and its impact on public policy and debate. It highlights that astroturfing is a significant problem in various fields – including climate change, public health, and information technology.  This submission discusses the application of Australian Consumer Law in dealing with the problem of astroturfing. It also notes the utility of intellectual property in dealing with passing off and impersonation of personalities – which can be an element of astroturfing. Astroturfing can also raise questions of defamation law if there are attacks on individual reputation. This submission observes that corporations law can address astroturfing by corporations, as part of its remit to deal with false and misleading information. At a political level, there could be a reform of laws in respect of political lobbying. This submission argues that truth in political advertising laws could address the problem of astroturfing. Likewise, legislation on misinformation and disinformation could cover the problem of astroturfing within its remit. Astroturfing by foreign governments could raise larger issues in respect of foreign interference.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了伪草根运动（astroturfing）的起源、发展和影响，探讨了澳大利亚消费者法、知识产权法、诽谤法、公司法等法律工具在应对伪草根运动中的作用，并提出了政治广告真实性立法和虚假信息立法等改革建议。

title: Promoting Eco-Driving Using Personalized Feedback and Social Comparison Nudges A Randomized Controlled Trial of Commercial Vehicles in a Business Sector
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Osaka University

detail.title: Promoting Eco-Driving Using Personalized Feedback and Social Comparison Nudges A Randomized Controlled Trial of Commercial Vehicles in a Business Sector
detail.abstract: This study aimed to examine whether personalized feedback and social comparison nudges improve eco-driving among commercial vehicle drivers in a randomized controlled trial. At a business site in Tochigi, Japan, 54 drivers were randomly assigned to intervention and control groups, considering age, baseline fuel efficiency, and vehicle type. The intervention group received personalized feedback on their average fuel efficiency (km/L) and rank within their vehicle type, categorized into three levels. These messages, combining personalized feedback and social comparison, were emailed twice during the intervention by the company’s general affairs department. A three-way analysis of variance considering group, month, and vehicle type revealed that the control group’s average fuel efficiency declined significantly by 4.8% during the intervention, whereas no significant change occurred in the intervention group. These findings suggest that such messages can effectively promote eco-driving.

detail.abstract: National Regulation of Private Military Companies 4.1 Introduction Acknowledging the utility of PMCs to states in this age of privatization, the increasing reliance placed on PMCs by states as they strive to maintain an adequate defense capacity and the simple fact of their existence, states stand in a difficult and conflicted situation vis-à-vis the PMC industry. While it is often expedient for a state to condemn the actions of a given PMC in a foreign state, the same state will undoubtedly be reliant on a raft of other PMCs (or perhaps the same PMCs) for the successful implementation of its defense policy. Accordingly, the fundamental question to be addressed in this chapter, expressed pragmatically is, how can states impose consistent controls on PMCs that will simultaneously stymie the actions of rogue PMCs and allow the state to further its policy objectives via PMCs and not jeopardize the utility of PMCs to that state's defense agenda? In this chapter we first examine issues surrounding regulation and regulatory design. After a review of the potential of self-regulation, we examine two voluntary codes as attempts at self-regulation. Then we examine the broader argument for regulation using the cases of PMC activity in PNG and Iraq. The remainder of the chapter considers the variety of regulatory regimes that have been advocated and adopted by various states, namely New Zealand, US, UK, and South Africa, and assesses the pros and cons of each model in terms of whether they effectively achieve their regulatory goals and their potential contribution to developing appropriate and effective regulation of the PMC on the national front. 4.2 Regulation and regulatory design Regulation is a controversial topic. Even what is meant by "regulation" is disputed.

title: Trade Finance under AfCFTA: Appraising the Utility of Financial Instruments in Mitigating Nigeria's Debt Profile
affiliations: University of Ibadan, Ibadan, Nigeria

detail.title: Trade Finance under AfCFTA: Appraising the Utility of Financial Instruments in Mitigating Nigeria's Debt Profile
detail.abstract: This study evaluates the potential of trade finance instruments under the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) to address Nigeria's mounting debt crisis, which reached about US$97.24 billion (N149.39 trillion) by July 2025, amidst macroeconomic volatility and structural inefficiencies. It examines how mechanisms such as letters of credit, export credits, and the Pan-African Payment and Settlement System (PAPSS) can enhance intra-African trade and alleviate fiscal pressures, while critically assessing the barriers to their effectiveness. The analysis highlights AfCFTA's promise to boost trade by US$220 billion continent-wide, with Nigeria potentially gaining US$4 billion in exports, fostering economic diversification aligned with Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) 8 and 9. However, challenges, including a 40.9% naira depreciation in 2024, a 21.88% inflation rate in July 2025, and limited SME access due to regulatory and collateral constraints, limit debt mitigation. Legal frameworks, including the AfCFTA Agreement (2018) and Nigeria's Finance Act 2024, offer integration opportunities, but enforcement gaps and measures like the 0.5% cybersecurity levy hinder progress. The study proposes digital currency integration, unified collateral registries, policy harmonisation, capacity building, and blended financing to overcome these obstacles. Addressing these barriers can allow AfCFTA's instruments to reduce Nigeria's projected 50% debt-to-GDP ratio by 2030, promoting fiscal sustainability. This research contributes to sustainable development law by linking trade finance to regional integration, offering policy insights for Nigeria's economic resilience.

title: Urban Form, Not Just Scale: Rethinking Growth in a Fragmented Global Order - Evidence from a Dynamic Panel Across Income Groups
affiliations: , University of the Punjab (PU) - Department of Economics and Government College University Lahore

detail.title: Urban Form, Not Just Scale: Rethinking Growth in a Fragmented Global Order - Evidence from a Dynamic Panel Across Income Groups
detail.abstract: In an era marked by global economic realignments and shifting urban geographies, this study examines how urban agglomeration, population distribution, and business density shape national income dynamics across the global income spectrum. Using a panel of 214 countries from 2000 to 2023, categorized by World Bank income groups, we explore the differentiated impacts of urban population structures, within and beyond metropolitan centers, and new business density on Gross National Income (GNI) per capita. Leveraging dynamic panel techniques, including Differenced and System Generalized Method of Moments (GMM), our findings underscore that concentrated urban agglomerations significantly boost income levels, particularly in upper-middle-income economies. In contrast, dispersed urban population growth i.e. indicative of urban sprawl, negatively correlates with income, highlighting the pitfalls of unplanned spatial expansion. Business density emerges as a key enabler of agglomeration economies, contributing positively to income growth through entrepreneurial dynamism. These results offer critical insights into the spatial-economic architecture of development, emphasizing that in a transforming global order, economic gains from urbanization depend less on scale and more on form, functionality, and institutional capacity. The study also reveals strong path dependency in income growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了城市集聚、人口分布和商业密度如何影响全球收入动态。基于214个国家2000-2023年的面板数据，研究发现城市集聚显著提升收入水平（尤其在中高收入经济体），而分散的城市扩张（城市蔓延）则对收入产生负面影响。商业密度通过集聚经济促进收入增长，研究强调经济发展更依赖城市形态和功能而非规模。

AI.method: 使用动态面板技术，包括差分GMM和系统GMM，分析214个国家2000-2023年的面板数据，按世界银行收入组别分类
AI.findings: 1) 集中的城市集聚显著提升收入水平（尤其在中高收入经济体） 2) 分散的城市人口增长（城市蔓延）与收入负相关 3) 商业密度通过集聚经济促进收入增长 4) 收入增长存在强路径依赖

title: The Four Heads Dam: Negotiation Ethics and Sustainable Development

detail.title: The Four Heads Dam: Negotiation Ethics and Sustainable Development
detail.abstract: This article analyses the ethical, social, and environmental dilemmas surrounding the construction of the so-called Four Heads Dam, a hypothetical large-scale infrastructure project. Framed as a negotiation scenario, the case highlights competing interests between state authorities seeking equitable energy distribution and civil society actors concerned with cultural heritage, environmental impact, and social displacement. Drawing on the framework of principled negotiation (Fisher & Ury, 1981), the analysis explores how interests, options, and criteria can be balanced to achieve sustainable outcomes. The paper contributes to ongoing debates on infrastructure ethics, green energy policy, and conflict resolution in public projects.

title: Is Pass-Through Voting a Desirable Way to Limit BlackRock’s Influence on Environmental and Social Issues?
affiliations: Harvard University

detail.title: Is Pass-Through Voting a Desirable Way to Limit BlackRock’s Influence on Environmental and Social Issues?
detail.abstract: The Index Act purports to impose mandatory pass-through voting on index fund managers to limit their influence — particularly BlackRock’s — over environmental and social (“E & S”) issues. Although the proposal has so far lacked the necessary political momentum for advancement, and large index fund managers such as BlackRock, Vanguard, and State Street Global Advisors (the “Big Three”) have recently scaled back their E & S commitments, rising anti-ESG and anti-DEI sentiment in U.S. politics may revive it. Moreover, the Big Three’s substantial holdings enable them to resume more assertive E & S advocacy if they choose. This Article argues against the Index Act or similar initiatives, demonstrating that its overemphasis on voting is misplaced and unlikely to attain its main policy objective. First, virtually all E & S proposals are precatory only, and although valuable for monitoring managers, end up playing a limited role in corporate governance. Meanwhile, private engagements — largely shielded from public view — play a central, often dominant, role in the Big Three’s E & S stewardship. Second, even if precatory voting mattered, delegating decisions to beneficial investors might not change the outcome of E & S votes. Beyond its limited efficacy, the Act could impose significant costs. Most notably, it risks chilling essential shareholder activism that restrains managerial misconduct and holds directors accountable. Far from democratizing corporate power, the Index Act may ultimately weaken shareholder oversight and entrench corporate executives.

detail.abstract: Tens of millions of individuals are displaced due to violence, and most are hosted by other households in their home countries. We ask what motivates people to host the forcibly displaced. We are interested in whether empathy increases the willingness to host but also consider alternative explanations. To explore the correlates of hosting we collected survey data from 1,504 households in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, fielded in-depth interviews, and implemented an experiment. We employ a novel strategy to measure hosting behavior, where household characteristics are measured prior to the arrival of displaced persons. We find that households with higher empathy are more likely to host in the ten-month period following the survey. There is no evidence that ethnicity, religiosity or wealth affect hosting behavior. Results from the experiment suggest that it is difficult to increase hosting propensity in the longer term (4+ months) through simple interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了刚果民主共和国居民收容被迫流离失所者的动机，发现同理心是主要驱动因素，而种族、宗教信仰或财富不影响收容行为。
AI.research_question: 是什么促使人们收容被迫流离失所者？同理心是否会增加收容意愿？
AI.motivation: 全球有数千万人因暴力而流离失所，其中大多数由本国的其他家庭收容。理解收容动机对于人道主义应对至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于同理心理论，同时考虑种族、宗教信仰、财富等替代解释。
AI.method: 在刚果民主共和国收集了1,504户家庭的调查数据，进行深度访谈并实施实验。采用新颖策略在流离失所者到达前测量家庭特征。
AI.findings: 同理心较高的家庭在调查后十个月内更可能收容流离失所者。种族、宗教信仰或财富不影响收容行为。实验表明通过简单干预难以在长期（4个月以上）提高收容倾向。
AI.theory_contributions: 确证了同理心在收容行为中的核心作用，挑战了传统认为种族、宗教或经济因素主导的观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为人道主义组织设计收容干预措施提供实证依据，表明需要更复杂的长期策略而非简单干预。

title: Navigating the Shift of Supply Chain Transparency: The Effect of SCM IT
affiliations: Department of Logistics and Maritime Studies, Hong Kong Polytechnic University, University of Science and Technology Beijing, University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration and University of Science and Technology Beijing

detail.title: Navigating the Shift of Supply Chain Transparency: The Effect of SCM IT
detail.abstract: Healthcare organizations increasingly rely on supply chain management information technologies (SCM IT) to enhance operational efficiency. While prior research has focused mainly on clinical IT systems, the adoption and sequencing of auxiliary IT remain underexplored. Drawing on dynamic capability theory, this study examines how the deployment of various SCM technologies, and their adoption paths form a capability hierarchy that differentially impacts hospital operational performance. Utilizing a large-scale panel dataset from the Healthcare Information and Management Systems Society (HIMSS), encompassing 4,157 U.S. hospitals and 29,076 hospital-year observations, we analyze the effects of SCM IT adoption on operational efficiency, together with its adoption sequences. Our findings reveal that the adoption of SCM technologies significantly enhances hospital operational efficiency through enhanced supply chain transparency. Sequential deployment aligned with the capability hierarchy (i.e., building foundational capabilities before advanced ones) yields superior operational performance improvements, demonstrating pronounced path dependence in healthcare SCM IT integration. Moreover, we show that hospital operational complexity (task-driven and resource-driven) moderates these effects, with task-driven complexity amplifying the benefits of hierarchy-consistent technology deployment, while resource-driven complexity diminishes these benefits. These moderating effects provide critical insights into the underlying mechanisms driving capability accumulation within healthcare supply chain. This research advances healthcare IT and SCM literature by highlighting the strategic importance of technology sequencing and contextual contingencies, offering actionable insights for optimizing SCM technology investments.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于动态能力理论，探讨医疗供应链管理信息技术(SCM IT)的采用顺序如何形成能力层次结构，并差异化影响医院运营绩效。研究发现SCM IT通过提升供应链透明度显著改善运营效率，符合能力层次结构的顺序部署(先基础后高级)能获得更好的绩效提升，且医院运营复杂性(任务驱动型和资源驱动型)调节这些效应。
AI.research_question: 医疗供应链管理信息技术(SCM IT)的采用顺序如何形成能力层次结构，并差异化影响医院运营绩效？
AI.motivation: 医疗组织日益依赖SCM IT提升运营效率，但现有研究主要关注临床IT系统，辅助IT的采用和排序机制尚未充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论
AI.method: 使用HIMSS的大规模面板数据集，涵盖4,157家美国医院和29,076个医院年度观测值，分析SCM IT采用对运营效率的影响及其采用顺序。
AI.findings: 1) SCM技术采用通过增强供应链透明度显著提升医院运营效率；2) 符合能力层次结构的顺序部署(先基础后高级)产生更优的运营绩效改善；3) 医院运营复杂性调节这些效应：任务驱动型复杂性放大层级一致技术部署的益处，而资源驱动型复杂性削弱这些益处。
AI.theory_contributions: 推进医疗IT和SCM文献，强调技术排序的战略重要性和情境权变性，为能力积累机制提供关键见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为优化SCM技术投资提供可操作的见解，指导医疗组织制定有效的技术采用策略。

reference: Jus ad Epistemics Issue 1
title: Advancing Fricker with Wokeism: Testimonial, Credibility, and Definitional Injustice to the Legally Categorized "Oppressor" Race by an Illegitimate Academia
affiliations: Meta-AI: Journal of Post-Biological Epistemics

detail.title: Advancing Fricker with Wokeism: Testimonial, Credibility, and Definitional Injustice to the Legally Categorized "Oppressor" Race by an Illegitimate Academia

publicationDetails.detailsText: Jus ad Epistemics Issue 1

detail.abstract: This paper defines wokeism as the systemic escalation of epistemic injustice emerging during the so-called "Great Awokening" (mid-2010s) and persisting through 2025. Drawing on Miranda Fricker's foundational analysis of testimonial injustice and hermeneutical injustice, we develop and prove two further categories: credibility injustice, where entire legally defined categories are subjected to structural credibility deficits by institutional fiat, and definitional injustice, where those categories are reconstituted as pathologies so that all possible testimony is excluded by definition. The preliminaries establish the framework through Aristotelian syllogistic form (Barbara), Aquinas's definition of truth (adaequatio intellectus ad rem), and a settheoretic formulation of Fricker's and our own categories. We formalize the unfalsifiability criterion P (T) = 1 ⇐⇒ ∀E, E ⇒ Conf irm(T) and prove the Illegitimacy Trigger, P (T) = 1 ⇒ IASE(E) = 1, identifying when an epistemic instrument becomes self-sealing and thus illegitimate. A further formalization, Pathological Attribution (PA), captures how attributes such as "privilege," "fragility," or "supremacy" are attached irreducibly to legal child and human being "white" categories of race, rendering credibility permanently discounted regardless of individual testimony with no legal due process. Fricker herself warned of the "prejudicial dysfunction in the economy of credibility" (2007, p. 28). We extend this insight by showing how testimonial injustice metastasizes into hermeneutical injustice, and through definitional capture becomes credibility and definitional injustice. The impossibility of restoring credibility is not a flaw of the theory, but evidence of systemic closure itself. Wokeism, on this account, is best understood as an epistemic fracture: public epistemics grounded in testimony and empirical reality versus academic epistemics grounded in redefinition and unfalsifiable constructs. This fracture institutionalizes new and distinctively Frickerian injustices.

AI.tldr: 本文将觉醒主义定义为2010年代中期兴起并持续到2025年的系统性认知不公正升级。基于Fricker的证言不公正和解释不公正理论，发展了可信度不公正和定义不公正两个新类别，并证明了当认知工具变得自我封闭时就会失去合法性。
AI.research_question: 觉醒主义如何体现为系统性认知不公正的升级？
AI.motivation: 理解"大觉醒"运动中出现的系统性认知不公正现象及其制度化过程
AI.theoretical_framework: Miranda Fricker的证言不公正和解释不公正理论、亚里士多德三段论、阿奎那真理定义、集合论
AI.method: 理论框架构建、形式化证明、概念分析
AI.findings: 证明了可信度不公正和定义不公正的存在，发现了认知工具的自我封闭性标准，揭示了觉醒主义作为认知断裂的本质
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Fricker的认知不公正理论，提出了可信度不公正和定义不公正两个新类别，发展了认知工具合法性的形式化标准
AI.practical_contributions: 为识别和应对系统性认知不公正提供了理论工具，有助于理解当代社会中的认知断裂现象

title: Orchestrating Digital Platform Ecosystems: A Conceptual Framework and Research Agenda
affiliations: University of Bayreuth, University of Arkansas and University of Bayreuth, Frankfurt University of Applied Sciences

detail.title: Orchestrating Digital Platform Ecosystems: A Conceptual Framework and Research Agenda
detail.abstract: Digital platform ecosystems (DPE) dominate value co-creation and capture in many industries as they afford unique possibilities to capture positive network externalities stemming from independent actors. However, coordinating DPEs is difficult and complex, and current insights on the required coordination work still strongly build on an outdated and fragmented platform governance perspective borrowed from corporate and IT governance. Tackling this issue, we develop DPE orchestration as a concept that systematizes this coordination work and offers a contemporary perspective that lets go of the historical loading of the governance concept. We develop an actionable DPE orchestration framework along two main components (DPE orchestration instrument and capabilities) and six sub-components (platform and ecosystem parameters, cooperative and competitive activities, and ordinary and dynamic capabilities). We then discuss blank spots and opportunities for future research on the orchestration of DPEs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了数字平台生态系统（DPE）编排的概念，以系统化协调工作并提供当代视角，摆脱传统治理概念的历史负担。
AI.research_question: 如何系统化数字平台生态系统的协调工作？
AI.motivation: 数字平台生态系统在价值共创和捕获中占据主导地位，但协调工作困难复杂，现有见解仍基于过时且分散的平台治理视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台治理理论、编排理论、能力理论
AI.method: 概念开发框架构建
AI.findings: 开发了可操作的DPE编排框架，包含两个主要组件（编排工具和能力）和六个子组件（平台和生态系统参数、合作与竞争活动、普通和动态能力）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了DPE编排概念，为数字平台生态系统协调提供了系统化理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台管理者提供了可操作的编排框架，帮助更好地协调生态系统中的合作与竞争活动。

title: Digital Entrepreneurial Intention of Generation Z: Affinity for Technology, Self-Efficacy, and AI Anxiety

detail.title: Digital Entrepreneurial Intention of Generation Z: Affinity for Technology, Self-Efficacy, and AI Anxiety

publicationDetails.detailsText: TECHNOVATION-D-25-02469

detail.abstract: This study examines the psychological and technological factors influencing Generation Z’s digital entrepreneurial intentions through the lens of Social Cognitive Career Theory (SCCT). Based on data from 348 university students in Turkey, the study explores how affinity for technology affects digital entrepreneurial intention mediated by self-efficacy, and how AI anxiety moderates this relationship. The results indicate that affinity for technology positively predicts entrepreneurial intention, partially mediated by self-efficacy. However, high levels of AI anxiety diminish the effect of affinity for technology on self-efficacy, reducing entrepreneurial intention. The study extends SCCT by introducing affinity for technology as a novel dispositional antecedent and conceptualizing AI anxiety as a future-oriented, internalized environmental barrier. Practically, findings highlight the need for interventions to mitigate anxiety and strengthen self-efficacy. These efforts may foster a more inclusive and resilient digital entrepreneurship ecosystem among tech-savvy yet anxious members of Generation Z.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于社会认知职业理论，探讨了Z世代数字创业意向的心理和技术因素。研究发现技术亲和力通过自我效能感正向影响创业意向，但AI焦虑会削弱这种关系。
AI.research_question: 技术亲和力如何通过自我效能感影响Z世代的数字创业意向？AI焦虑在这一关系中起什么调节作用？
AI.motivation: 理解Z世代在数字创业中的心理机制，特别是技术亲和力与AI焦虑的交互作用，以促进更具包容性和韧性的数字创业生态系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会认知职业理论(SCCT)，将技术亲和力作为新的倾向性前因，AI焦虑作为未来导向、内化的环境障碍。
AI.method: 基于土耳其348名大学生的问卷调查数据，采用中介和调节效应分析。
AI.findings: 技术亲和力正向预测创业意向，部分通过自我效能感中介；高AI焦虑会削弱技术亲和力对自我效能感的影响，从而降低创业意向。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展SCCT理论，引入技术亲和力作为新的前因变量，将AI焦虑概念化为未来导向的环境障碍。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要干预措施来减轻焦虑和增强自我效能感，以培养更具包容性和韧性的数字创业生态系统。

title: Bring Your Own AI (BYOAI) and Flexible Governance: Organizational Adaptability in Employee-Driven Digital Transformation
affiliations: S.B.Patil Institute of Management, Associate Professor, School of Business, PO BOX: 345050, MAHE, Dubai, DIAC, UAE, S.B.Patil Institute of Management, Independent and Indian Institute of Management (IIM)

detail.title: Bring Your Own AI (BYOAI) and Flexible Governance: Organizational Adaptability in Employee-Driven Digital Transformation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study, as it did not involve clinical participants or sensitive personal data. Participation in the survey was voluntary, and informed consent was obtained from all respondents.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Organizations are under increasing pressure to remain agile while managing the rapid and often informal use of generative AI by employees. This study focuses on the Bring Your Own AI (BYOAI) phenomenon, where staff adopt tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, and Gemini without formal approval. While such practices raise concerns about risk and oversight, they also create opportunities for organizational learning and adaptability. To investigate these dynamics, we adopted a mixed-methods design, combining a systematic review of 45 peer-reviewed studies with a cross-regional survey of 345 professionals working in business, healthcare, education, and government. The analysis revealed six distinct employee behavioral archetypes and four organizational governance patterns, highlighting misalignments between formal governance mechanisms and everyday workplace practices. Psychological safety, workplace culture, and individual perceptions of risk emerged as critical factors shaping whether employees disclose or conceal their AI use. In response, we propose the Adaptive AI Governance Framework, which integrates behavioral insights with flexible systems management principles. The framework rests on three components: segmentation of employee behaviors, a balanced 70-20-10 oversight mix (Enable, Regulate, Restrict), and a staged maturity pathway that supports innovation while maintaining accountability. Findings show that informal AI use should not be dismissed as a policy violation. Instead, it can be redirected into structured routines that build resilience, foster learning, and strengthen competitiveness. This study reframes governance as a dynamic organizational capability and offers practical guidance for developing context-sensitive, ethically aligned systems that balance innovation with responsible oversight.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了"自带AI"现象，通过混合方法识别了6种员工行为原型和4种组织治理模式，提出了适应性AI治理框架，强调将非正式AI使用转化为结构化实践以增强组织韧性。
AI.research_question: 组织如何有效管理员工非正式使用生成式AI的现象，在控制风险的同时促进组织学习和适应性？
AI.motivation: 组织面临员工非正式使用生成式AI工具的压力，需要在保持敏捷性的同时管理相关风险，但目前缺乏有效的治理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织行为学、治理理论、系统管理原则、心理安全理论
AI.method: 混合方法设计：系统回顾45篇同行评审研究 + 跨区域调查345名专业人士
AI.findings: 识别了6种员工行为原型和4种组织治理模式；心理安全、职场文化和个人风险感知是影响员工AI使用披露的关键因素；正式治理机制与日常工作实践存在错位
AI.theory_contributions: 将治理重新定义为动态组织能力；提出了适应性AI治理框架；整合行为洞察与灵活系统管理原则
AI.practical_contributions: 提供适应性AI治理框架（员工行为细分、70-20-10监督组合、分阶段成熟路径）；指导组织将非正式AI使用转化为结构化实践

title: Stronger Together? Corporate Contributions and Volunteer Engagement in Online Communities
affiliations: Arizona State University (ASU) - W.P. Carey School of Business, University of California, Berkeley, Indiana University - Kelley School of Business and Arizona State University - W.P. Carey School of Business

detail.title: Stronger Together? Corporate Contributions and Volunteer Engagement in Online Communities
detail.abstract: Online communities traditionally rely on volunteer contributions to generate content. As they mature, these communities attract direct corporate contributions, raising the question of whether corporate participation harms or hurts volunteer engagement. We shed light on this question by exploiting temporal variation in corporate contributions between 2017-2021 across different regions in OpenStreetMap Brazil, a crowdsourced mapping platform, using a staggered difference-indifferences approach. Our findings reveal that corporate participation significantly increases volunteer contributions rather than crowding them out. This is because corporate contributions motivate dedicated volunteers to contribute more and redirect their efforts toward previously neglected and less mature areas of the map. This positive effect is increasing in the intensity of corporate participation, as measured by the number and duration of corporate contributions in a given region. These results suggest that strategic corporate participation can enhance overall platform quality by complementing rather than substituting volunteer efforts. Our work contributes to understanding the complex dynamics between different contributor types in online communities and offers insights for platform governance that effectively balances volunteer and corporate participation.

AI.tldr: 企业参与在线社区不会挤出志愿者贡献，反而通过激励志愿者向地图不成熟区域转移努力而增加总体贡献
AI.research_question: 企业参与是否会损害或促进志愿者在在线社区中的参与度？
AI.motivation: 随着在线社区成熟，企业直接参与增加，需要了解企业参与对志愿者贡献的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业参与与志愿者贡献的互动关系，替代效应与互补效应
AI.method: 利用2017-2021年OpenStreetMap巴西数据，采用交错双重差分方法分析企业贡献的时间变化
AI.findings: 企业参与显著增加志愿者贡献而非挤出；激励专注志愿者贡献更多并转向地图不成熟区域；积极效应随企业参与强度增加
AI.theory_contributions: 理解在线社区中不同类型贡献者间的复杂动态关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台治理提供见解，有效平衡志愿者和企业参与

title: The DX4D Illusion: Results from a Stakeholder Survey on Digital Transformation for Development
affiliations: The University of Manchester, The University of Manchester - Global Development Institute, The University of Manchester - Global Development Institute, Global Development Institute, University of Manchester, The University of Manchester - Global Development Institute, The University of Manchester - Global Development Institute and The University of Manchester

detail.title: The DX4D Illusion: Results from a Stakeholder Survey on Digital Transformation for Development
detail.abstract:
Digital transformation is a buzz term in the development sector but we have heard little or nothing as yet from individual stakeholders.  This paper provides an original contribution by presenting results from a survey and workshop held with a range of digital development stakeholders drawn from government, NGOs, the private sector, international development agencies, and research organisations.  Guided by debates and issues within existing literature, the survey asked about stakeholder understandings, views and future research priorities regarding DX4D: digital transformation for development.

It found mainly incremental interpretations of transformation when respondents were asked about DX4D definitions, examples and challenges.  That worldview is clearly out-of-synch with metamorphic meanings of transformation.  Yet, when pushed, stakeholders could differentiate transformative from incremental applications of digital technologies in development, and we found some evidence of pressure to apply the label of transformation to non-transformational initiatives.  Alongside, there was clear interest in more DX4D-related evidence and guidance with a research agenda including best practice guidelines, measurement of impact, and investigation of political economy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过调查和研讨会发现，数字发展利益相关者对数字转型的理解主要是渐进式的，与彻底的变革含义存在差距。尽管利益相关者能够区分变革性和渐进式的数字技术应用，但存在将非变革性项目标榜为"转型"的压力。研究提出了包括最佳实践指南、影响评估和政治经济学研究在内的研究议程。
AI.research_question: 数字发展利益相关者如何理解和看待数字转型（DX4D）？他们对DX4D的定义、案例、挑战以及未来研究重点有何看法？
AI.motivation: 数字转型是发展领域的热门术语，但缺乏来自个体利益相关者的声音。现有文献中的讨论和问题需要实证研究的支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字转型理论和发展研究框架，探讨渐进式变革与彻底变革的差异，以及标签应用与实际变革之间的差距。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法：对来自政府、NGO、私营部门、国际发展机构和研究组织的利益相关者进行问卷调查和研讨会。
AI.findings:
1. 利益相关者对DX4D的定义主要是渐进式理解
2. 这种世界观与彻底的变革含义不同步
3. 利益相关者能够区分变革性和渐进式应用
4. 存在将非变革性项目标榜为"转型"的压力
5. 对更多DX4D相关证据和指导有明确需求
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了数字转型概念在实践中的理解差距，提出了渐进式变革与彻底变革的理论区分，为数字转型理论提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展实践者提供了关于数字转型理解的实证证据，提出了包括最佳实践指南、影响测量和政治经济学研究在内的具体研究议程，有助于指导实际的数字转型项目。

title: Quantum-Inspired Optimization for Enhanced Cross-Sectional Dispersion Strategies, The 21st WBS Quantitative Finance Conference, Palermo, Italy
affiliations: University of Reading

detail.title: Quantum-Inspired Optimization for Enhanced Cross-Sectional Dispersion Strategies, The 21st WBS Quantitative Finance Conference, Palermo, Italy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a quant advisor at the company Inspiration-Q, which is where the quantum-inspired algorithms adapted to the problem at hand were developed.

detail.abstract: This presentation introduces quantum-inspired optimization methods developed at Inspiration-Q for enhancing cross-sectional dispersion and pairs trading strategies. To motivate the approach and introduce the company’s technology, we first present results from other use cases, such as index tracking, computed with proprietary algorithmic variants. We then focus on dispersion and pairs trading, where basket-based indicators are used to stabilize signals and improve reliability. The framework highlights the complementary roles of basket size in reducing noise and hierarchical contrasts in accelerating mean reversion. All experiments on equity markets are computed with Inspiration-Q’s quantum-inspired solvers, while Simulated Annealing is shown as a baseline model for illustration. More broadly, the results illustrate how these algorithms make previously intractable combinatorial problems in finance computationally feasible, opening the door to scalable applications in equities, credit, and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Inspiration-Q开发的量子启发优化方法，用于增强横截面分散度和配对交易策略。通过专有算法变体在指数跟踪等用例中展示技术优势，重点研究如何利用篮子指标稳定信号并提高可靠性。框架强调篮子大小在减少噪声和分层对比在加速均值回归中的互补作用。所有实验均使用量子启发求解器，模拟退火作为基准模型。结果表明这些算法使金融中原本难以处理的组合问题变得计算可行。
AI.research_question: 量子启发优化方法如何有效增强横截面分散度和配对交易策略的性能？
AI.motivation: 金融领域存在大量计算上难以处理的组合优化问题，传统方法在处理复杂投资组合和交易策略时面临计算挑战。量子启发算法为解决这些问题提供了新的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于量子计算原理的启发式优化理论，包括组合优化、均值回归理论、信号稳定化框架，以及篮子大小与分层对比在策略优化中的互补作用理论。
AI.method: 使用Inspiration-Q的量子启发求解器进行实证实验，以模拟退火作为基准模型对比。通过指数跟踪、横截面分散度和配对交易等多个用例验证方法有效性，重点分析篮子指标在信号稳定中的作用。
AI.findings: 量子启发算法能够有效处理金融中的组合优化问题；篮子指标可以显著提高交易信号的稳定性和可靠性；篮子大小和分层对比在策略优化中发挥互补作用；该方法使原本计算不可行的金融问题变得可行。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于量子启发的金融组合优化新框架；发展了篮子大小与分层对比在交易策略中的互补理论；扩展了量子计算原理在金融工程中的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了可扩展的量子启发优化解决方案；开发了增强横截面分散度和配对交易策略的有效方法；展示了量子技术在股票、信用等金融领域的实际应用前景。

title: From Dialectics to Multilectics: Navigating Networks of Tensions in AI Governance
affiliations: University of Oulu, University of Sydney, University of Oulu - Oulu Business School and University of Oulu - Oulu Business School

detail.title: From Dialectics to Multilectics: Navigating Networks of Tensions in AI Governance

declarations.funderStatement: This research has been funded by the Research Council of Finland (AI-REG project, grant number 347221).

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Conference on Information Systems (ICIS2025), Nashville, Tennessee

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) can potentially transform public services but presents complex risks. Regulatory measures, like the European AI Act, address some of these risks but complicate AI development and use. As public sector organizations (PSOs) navigate these complexities, AI governance must address tensions between compliance and innovation along with legal ambiguities, institutional contradictions, and ethical dilemmas. Information Systems research traditionally frames tensions as dyadic, resolvable through synthesis, but this view overlooks the multilectical nature of tensions in AI governance. In our qualitative study of three Finnish PSOs (a hospital, a governmental agency, a municipality), we explore, through the trifecta framework of technology-based regulation, how these organizations navigate this complexity. Our contribution is twofold: (1) we empirically apply the trifecta framework to evidence the multilectical nature of tensions in public AI governance, and (2) we conceptually extend dialectical inquiry with multilectics, viewing tensions as interconnected, co-evolving networks rather than dyadic oppositions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过三要素框架分析芬兰三个公共部门组织在AI治理中面临的复杂张力，揭示了这些张力具有多辩证性而非传统的二元对立特征，并提出了多辩证理论来扩展传统的辩证分析。
AI.research_question: 公共部门组织如何在AI治理中应对合规与创新之间的张力，以及这些张力的本质是什么？
AI.motivation: AI在公共服务中的潜力与风险并存，现有监管措施（如欧盟AI法案）虽然解决了一些风险，但也使AI开发和使用复杂化，需要探索公共部门如何应对这些复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三要素框架（技术监管框架）和多辩证理论，扩展了传统的辩证分析。
AI.method: 对芬兰三个公共部门组织（医院、政府机构、市政当局）的定性研究。
AI.findings: 公共部门AI治理中的张力具有多辩证性，表现为相互关联、共同演化的网络，而非简单的二元对立。
AI.theory_contributions: 概念上扩展了辩证分析，提出了多辩证理论，将张力视为相互关联的网络而非二元对立。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共部门组织提供了应对AI治理复杂性的框架，帮助它们在合规与创新之间找到平衡。

title: Cultural Factor in E-Commerce Website Design: A Narrative Literature Review and Research Roadmap
affiliations: Universidad Nacional Santiago Antunez de Mayolo

detail.title: Cultural Factor in E-Commerce Website Design: A Narrative Literature Review and Research Roadmap
detail.abstract: Background: The exponential growth of global e-commerce has intensified the need to understand how cultural factors influence website design effectiveness and consumer behavior in digital environments. Despite significant research in cross-cultural marketing, there is limited synthesis on the specific impact of cultural dimensions on e-commerce platform design. Purpose: This narrative literature review (El Factor Cultural en el Diseño de Sitios de Comercio Electrónico: Una Revisión Narrativa de la Literatura y Hoja de Ruta para Investigación Futura) examines the influence of cultural factors on e-commerce website design, identifies empirical evidence of correlations between cultural dimensions and design methodologies, and detects theoretical gaps in digital cultural adaptation research. Methods: A systematic search was conducted in ScienceDirect, Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar for the period 2010-2025, using Boolean combinations of terms about cultural factors, e-commerce, and web design. Rigorous inclusion and exclusion criteria were applied, followed by inductive thematic analysis to identify emerging patterns in 47 selected studies. Results: Empirical evidence confirms significant correlations between Hofstede's five cultural dimensions (individualism-collectivism, power distance, masculinity-femininity, uncertainty avoidance, and temporal orientation) and online consumer behavior. Companies implementing cultural adaptations achieve improvements of 20-40% in key metrics including dwell time, pages visited, and conversion rates, with average revenue increases of 35% in international markets. Cultural factors shape visual elements (color schemes, information density, navigation architecture), promotional message effectiveness, and social interaction preferences. Conclusions: Culture constitutes a strategic factor in e-commerce design and success, but demands new theoretical, methodological, and ethical approaches to address rapid changes in the global digital economy and emerging cultural identities. Significant gaps exist in traditional pre-digital cultural models, research in emerging markets, and methodological approaches for cross-cultural studies.

AI.tldr: 这篇文献综述分析了文化因素对电子商务网站设计的影响，发现霍夫斯泰德文化维度与在线消费者行为显著相关，文化适应能提升20-40%的关键指标和35%的收入增长。
AI.research_question: 文化因素如何影响电子商务网站设计？文化维度与设计方法之间存在什么经验证据？数字文化适应研究存在哪些理论空白？
AI.motivation: 全球电子商务的指数级增长迫切需要理解文化因素如何影响网站设计效果和数字环境中的消费者行为，而现有研究缺乏对文化维度与电商平台设计关系的系统整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于霍夫斯泰德的五个文化维度理论：个人主义-集体主义、权力距离、男性气质-女性气质、不确定性规避和时间导向。
AI.method: 采用系统性文献检索方法，在ScienceDirect、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar数据库（2010-2025年）中搜索相关文献，应用严格的纳入和排除标准，对47篇选定研究进行归纳性主题分析。
AI.findings: 经验证据证实文化维度与在线消费者行为显著相关；实施文化适应的公司在关键指标（停留时间、访问页面数、转化率）上提升20-40%，国际市场平均收入增长35%；文化因素影响视觉元素、促销信息效果和社交互动偏好。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了传统前数字文化模型的局限性，提出了应对全球数字经济快速变化和新兴文化认同的新理论、方法和伦理方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电商企业提供了文化适应设计的具体指导，证明文化适应能显著提升商业绩效，为国际市场的成功扩张提供了实践依据。

title: Discover Hidden Visual Complexity: The Impact of Hierarchical Attention Entropy on User Engagement with Social Media Content
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Discover Hidden Visual Complexity: The Impact of Hierarchical Attention Entropy on User Engagement with Social Media Content

keywords: Hierarchical Attention Entropy Hierarchical Attention Entropy And User Engagement

detail.abstract: Deep neural networks have been broadly utilized as a critical component in visual analysis, such as image classification, object recognition, and feature extraction. However, their resemblance to human cognitive processes has rarely been examined. Extending the literature on visual complexity, this study proposes to extract visual complexity features-Hierarchical Attention Entropy (HAE)-from the attention layers of a pre-trained Transformer model (CLIP). HAE helps to reveal a layered structure of perception complexity triggered during the stagewise visual processing of an image. The derived hierarchical attention entropy significantly predicts social media user engagement. Specifically, low-and mid-level attention entropy measures are positively associated with engagement, while high-level attention entropy has a negative relationship. Additional analysis suggests that attention entropy measures mediate the effects of objective image-based visual complexity (e.g., pixel and object-level measures) on engagement, reconciling the conflicting findings in prior studies. This study demonstrates the value of information embedded in pre-trained deep neural network layers.

AI.tldr: 本研究从预训练Transformer模型(CLIP)的注意力层提取视觉复杂度特征——层次注意力熵(HAE)，揭示了图像处理过程中的分层感知复杂度结构。HAE能显著预测社交媒体用户参与度：低中层级注意力熵与参与度正相关，高层级注意力熵与参与度负相关。注意力熵中介了客观图像复杂度对参与度的影响。
AI.research_question: 如何从深度神经网络中提取视觉复杂度特征来预测社交媒体用户参与度？层次注意力熵(HAE)能否揭示图像处理过程中的分层感知复杂度结构？
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在视觉分析中广泛应用，但其与人类认知过程的相似性很少被研究。现有视觉复杂度文献存在矛盾发现，需要新的方法来理解图像复杂度如何影响用户参与度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 视觉复杂度理论、注意力机制理论、深度神经网络理论、社交媒体参与度理论
AI.method: 从预训练Transformer模型(CLIP)的注意力层提取层次注意力熵(HAE)特征，分析其与社交媒体用户参与度的关系，并进行中介效应分析
AI.findings: 1. 层次注意力熵显著预测社交媒体用户参与度；2. 低中层级注意力熵与参与度正相关；3. 高层级注意力熵与参与度负相关；4. 注意力熵中介了客观图像复杂度对参与度的影响
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出层次注意力熵(HAE)概念，揭示了图像处理过程中的分层感知复杂度结构；2. 将深度神经网络注意力机制与视觉复杂度理论结合；3. 解决了现有视觉复杂度研究中的矛盾发现
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为社交媒体平台优化内容推荐提供新方法；2. 为内容创作者设计更具吸引力的视觉内容提供指导；3. 展示了预训练深度神经网络层中嵌入信息的价值

title: Government Efficiency vs. Cybersecurity: A CIA Triad Analysis of the DOGE Social Security Data Incident

detail.title: Government Efficiency vs. Cybersecurity: A CIA Triad Analysis of the DOGE Social Security Data Incident
detail.abstract: The Department of Government Efficiency's (DOGE) handling of Social Security Administration data in 2025 represents a critical case study in the tension between operational efficiency and cybersecurity architecture principles. This paper analyzes DOGE's approach through the lens of the CIA triad-Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability-to understand how the pursuit of rapid fraud detection compromised fundamental security principles. The incident, involving the transfer of over 300 million Americans' personally identifiable information to an unsecured cloud environment, demonstrates systemic failures in implementing established cybersecurity frameworks. Through examination of existing government security standards and comparison with historical data breaches, this analysis reveals the critical importance of integrating security architecture from inception rather than treating it as a postimplementation consideration. The findings suggest that with proper implementation of zero trust architecture, risk-based security controls, and adherence to established frameworks like FISMA and NIST guidelines, government agencies can achieve both mission effectiveness and robust data protection.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2025年政府效率部处理社会保障管理局数据的事件，揭示了在追求运营效率与网络安全原则之间的紧张关系。研究发现，通过适当实施零信任架构、基于风险的安全控制以及遵循FISMA和NIST指南，政府机构可以实现任务有效性和数据保护的双重目标。
AI.research_question: 政府效率部在处理社会保障数据时，如何在追求运营效率与维护网络安全原则之间取得平衡？
AI.motivation: 2025年政府效率部将超过3亿美国人的个人身份信息转移到不安全云环境的事件，揭示了系统性网络安全框架实施失败的问题，需要分析如何从一开始就整合安全架构而非事后考虑。
AI.theoretical_framework: CIA三要素框架（保密性、完整性、可用性）、零信任架构、基于风险的安全控制、FISMA和NIST网络安全指南
AI.method: 通过检查现有政府安全标准并与历史数据泄露事件进行比较分析
AI.findings: 追求快速欺诈检测损害了基本安全原则，系统性地未能实施已建立的网络安全框架，需要从一开始就整合安全架构
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对CIA三要素在政府数据管理中的应用理解，为零信任架构在政府环境中的实施提供了理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府机构提供了实现任务有效性和强大数据保护的具体实施路径，包括零信任架构、风险控制以及FISMA和NIST指南的遵循

title: LLMs as Bounded Rational Agents: Governing Bias as a System Property
affiliations: Department of Computer Science, School of Engineering & Computer Science, Baylor University

detail.title: LLMs as Bounded Rational Agents: Governing Bias as a System Property
detail.abstract: The Information Systems community has long viewed technology as a means to overcome the bounds of human rationality. Large Language Models (LLMs) now represent the apex of this ambition, promising to automate and optimize complex managerial decisions with data-driven objectivity. This paper challenges this prevailing view. We argue that LLMs are not a solution to bounded rationality but are instead a new form of computationally bounded rational agent whose decision-making is systematically biased. We introduce a framework that locates these biases at three distinct levels: (1) the incomplete information environment of training data; (2) the algorithmic heuristics embedded in the model's architecture; and (3) the economic trade-offs of the physical hardware. This framework reveals bias not as a correctable flaw, but as an inherent property of the system. We conclude by issuing a call to action for the MIS community: to shift our research focus from optimizing LLM performance to developing new theories of governance, accountability, and organizational design for managing these powerful but deeply flawed decisionmaking agents.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了信息系统学界将大语言模型视为克服人类有限理性界限的传统观点，认为LLMs本身就是一种新的计算有限理性代理，其决策存在系统性偏见。作者提出了一个三层偏见框架，并呼吁MIS社区将研究重点从优化LLM性能转向开发新的治理、问责和组织设计理论。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型是否真正解决了有限理性问题，还是它们本身就是一种新的有限理性代理？
AI.motivation: 信息系统学界长期以来将技术视为克服人类有限理性的手段，LLMs被视为这一雄心的顶峰。但本文质疑这一主流观点，认为LLMs并非有限理性的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三层偏见框架：1) 训练数据的不完整信息环境；2) 模型架构中嵌入的算法启发式；3) 物理硬件的经济权衡
AI.method: 概念性分析框架构建
AI.findings: LLMs的偏见不是可纠正的缺陷，而是系统的固有属性。LLMs是计算有限理性代理，其决策存在系统性偏见。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了LLMs作为计算有限理性代理的新理论视角，建立了三层偏见分析框架，挑战了技术克服有限理性的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁MIS社区转变研究方向，从优化LLM性能转向开发治理、问责和组织设计的新理论，以管理这些强大但有缺陷的决策代理。

title: Technology Law Chapter 3: Social Impacts
affiliations: University of Wisconsin Law School and University of Richmond School of Law, Yale University - Yale Information Society Project

detail.title: Technology Law Chapter 3: Social Impacts
detail.abstract:
Based on years of experience teaching the subject, we have produced a first draft of a “Technology Law” coursebook. It teases out fundamental concepts, introduces our methodology for resolving tech-fostered legal uncertainties, and identifies the strengths and weaknesses of different regulatory choices. Through a mixture of readings, exercises, and discussion questions, it helps readers develop facility in:

- Recognizing the recurring techlaw and policy questions and discerning the application, normative, and institutional uncertainties associated with a particular technology;
- Working through the process of resolving legal uncertainties, which includes consciously selecting a regulatory approach, identifying legally salient characteristics and relevant analogies, and weighing the benefits and drawbacks of various regulatory choices (law-by-analogy, creating new law, or reconfiguring legal institutions); and
- Developing familiarity with employing and countering common rhetorical strategies for advancing, opposing, or shaping regulation.

This course is designed to be accessible and useful to all students, regardless of career interests or prior experience with technology. New technologies challenge every area of the law, and the regulatory and rhetorical strategies we’ll explore are transferable across subjects.

This posting includes Chapter 3: Social Impacts. Future chapters will be posted bi-monthly.

We welcome feedback at the link included in the document; additional chapters will be updated regularly. If you are interested in teaching from this text, in whole or in part, please let us know, as we would be happy to share our class notes and slides.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一本《科技法》教材的初稿，旨在通过阅读、练习和讨论问题，帮助读者识别科技法律和政策问题，解决法律不确定性，并熟悉监管辩论的修辞策略。
AI.research_question: 如何系统化地教授科技法，帮助学生识别和解决技术引发的法律不确定性？
AI.motivation: 基于多年教学经验，需要开发一个系统化的科技法课程教材，帮助学生应对新技术对法律各领域带来的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 科技法基础概念、法律不确定性解决方法论、监管选择分析框架
AI.method: 混合教学方法：阅读材料、练习和讨论问题的结合
AI.findings: 开发了系统的科技法教学框架，包括识别法律问题、解决不确定性和熟悉监管辩论策略三个核心能力
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了科技法教学的系统方法论，包括法律不确定性的识别和解决框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的科技法教材和教学方法，适用于不同背景的学生，具有跨学科的可转移性

title: Can Kindness be Matched? Dynamic Matching and Goal Matching in Civic Crowdfunding
affiliations: , Lehigh University and University of Delaware

detail.title: Can Kindness be Matched? Dynamic Matching and Goal Matching in Civic Crowdfunding
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of matching funds on donor behavior in civic crowdfunding. Using over ten years of data from Goteo.org, we compare the effects of goal matching (i.e., a lump-sum donation committed by the matcher conditional on the attainment of a pre-defined goal) and dynamic matching (i.e., real-time matching at a constant rate for each individual donation transaction). After preprocessing our data with Coarsened Exact Matching (CEM) at a project level, we find in our project-day level analysis that goal matching increases contribution size after projects surpass their minimum goals (i.e., the minimum budget required to start the project) and dynamic matching decreases average contribution size before the minimum goals are reached. Further, contrary to conventional wisdom, both match funding schemes reduce backer (donor) participation. We also show that the effects of match funding are heterogeneous across Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs): goal matching (but not dynamic matching) boosts the fundraising performance of ecological projects but dampens the performance of democratic projects, as compared to social projects. These results highlight the stage-contingent and context-dependent nature of match funding, offering insights for the design of more effective crowdfunding strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了匹配资金对公民众筹中捐赠者行为的影响。通过分析Goteo.org十年数据，发现目标匹配在项目达到最低目标后能增加捐赠金额，而动态匹配在达到最低目标前会降低平均捐赠额。两种匹配方案都会减少捐赠者参与度，且效果因可持续发展目标而异。
AI.research_question: 匹配资金（目标匹配和动态匹配）如何影响公民众筹中的捐赠者行为？
AI.motivation: 了解不同匹配资金方案对众筹项目筹款表现的影响，为设计更有效的众筹策略提供依据
AI.theoretical_framework: 匹配资金理论、捐赠行为理论、众筹动态机制
AI.method: 使用Goteo.org十年数据，采用粗化精确匹配（CEM）进行项目级数据预处理，然后进行项目-日级分析
AI.findings: 1. 目标匹配在项目超过最低目标后增加捐赠金额；2. 动态匹配在达到最低目标前降低平均捐赠额；3. 两种匹配方案都减少捐赠者参与度；4. 目标匹配对生态项目有积极影响，但对民主项目有消极影响
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了匹配资金效应的阶段依赖性和情境依赖性，挑战了传统观念
AI.practical_contributions: 为众筹平台设计更有效的匹配资金策略提供指导，特别是针对不同项目类型和筹款阶段

title: Taxonomizing Synthetic Data for Law
affiliations: Oxford University Faculty of Law, New York University School of Law and New York University School of Law

detail.title: Taxonomizing Synthetic Data for Law
detail.abstract: Synthetic data is increasingly important in data usage and AI design, creating novel legal and policy dilemmas. All too often, discussions of synthetic data treat it as entirely distinct from "real," collected data, overlooking the risks posed by different kinds and uses of synthetic data. This piece comments on Michal Gal and Orla Lynskey's work, which persuasively argues that synthetic data will transform information privacy, market competition, and data quality. While the risks posed by synthetic data depend on its connection to collected data, we argue that background knowledge and assumptions about ground truth used to create it are at least as important. We bring that focus to Gal and Lynskey's taxonomy of synthetic data, arguing that it is essential to grasp synthetic data's legal and policy implications. As such, we divide synthetic data into (1) transformed data, which modifies collected data to preserve certain statistical properties for an end use; (2) augmented data, which relies on assumptions to bolster a collected dataset's fidelity to the ground truth; and (3) simulated data, which relies almost entirely on background knowledge and ground-truth assumptions. As policymakers weigh whether to incentivize, mandate, or discourage the use of synthetic data, they should consider the validity of the ground-truth assumptions used in producing that data.

AI.tldr: 本文评论了Gal和Lynskey关于合成数据的研究，提出合成数据的风险不仅取决于其与收集数据的联系，更关键的是创建时使用的背景知识和基础事实假设。作者将合成数据分为三类：转换数据、增强数据和模拟数据，建议政策制定者在考虑是否激励、强制或限制合成数据使用时，应评估其基础事实假设的有效性。
AI.research_question: 合成数据的法律和政策影响是什么？如何基于其与基础事实假设的关系来分类和评估合成数据？
AI.motivation: 当前关于合成数据的讨论往往将其与"真实"收集数据完全区分，忽视了不同类型和用途的合成数据带来的风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Gal和Lynskey的合成数据分类框架，但强调背景知识和基础事实假设的重要性
AI.method: 概念分析和理论论证，对现有分类框架进行批判性扩展
AI.findings: 提出新的合成数据三分法：转换数据（修改收集数据保留统计特性）、增强数据（依赖假设增强数据集保真度）、模拟数据（几乎完全依赖背景知识和基础事实假设）
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了合成数据的理论分类框架，强调基础事实假设在评估合成数据风险中的核心地位
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供评估合成数据使用的实用框架，建议在制定政策时考虑基础事实假设的有效性

detail.abstract: In today's digital age, fake news is one of the most serious challenges to social security, politics and social relations. The rapid development of technology and technology has greatly benefited human life by expanding its range without time and space limitations, but at the same time, many negative effects and risks are increasing hour by minute and day by day. Fake news the process of intentionally or unintentionally spreading incorrect or false information online. Its main purpose is to change and confuse people's perception and opinion. Fake news is often activated during changes in international relations, geopolitical competition, internal and external social, political, and economic confrontations, public unrest, and any online. It is also the activity of broadcasting and distributing online news (content) that is purposefully misleading, with the aim of gaining financial and political benefits and advantages in traditional media, media and social networks.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了数字时代假新闻对社会安全、政治和社会关系的严重挑战，分析了假新闻的传播机制及其在特定情境下的活跃特征。
AI.research_question: 数字时代假新闻如何影响社会安全、政治和社会关系？
AI.motivation: 随着技术的快速发展，假新闻的传播范围和速度急剧增加，对社会各方面产生了严重的负面影响，需要系统研究其机制和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息传播理论、社会心理学和媒体研究理论，分析假新闻的传播机制和社会影响。
AI.method: 理论分析和文献综述方法，结合假新闻传播的典型案例。
AI.findings: 假新闻在国际关系变化、地缘政治竞争、社会政治经济对抗等情境下特别活跃，主要通过故意传播误导性信息来改变公众认知和意见。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对假新闻传播机制和社会影响的理论理解，为相关研究提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、媒体从业者和公众识别和应对假新闻提供了实践指导，有助于维护社会安全和稳定。

title: Engagement Diversification and the Effectiveness of Platform Content Moderation: An Instrumental Variable Approach
affiliations: University of Massachusetts Amherst - Isenberg School of Management, University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business, University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business and University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business

detail.title: Engagement Diversification and the Effectiveness of Platform Content Moderation: An Instrumental Variable Approach
detail.abstract: Content moderation is a central governance mechanism on user-generated content (UGC) platforms, yet extensive prior research shows that its effectiveness is often constrained by unintended consequences, including harmful content spillovers, rule-breaking recidivism, and declines in user contributions. Despite this, far less is understood about the conditions under which moderation yields beneficial versus suboptimal outcomes. We address this gap by examining user engagement diversification, defined as the breadth of a user's contributions across platform communities. High-diversification users distribute their activity across many communities, whereas low-diversification users concentrate engagement within one or a few communities. Drawing on media substitution theory and psychological reactance theory, we theorize that diversified users can more easily redirect their activity and experience less reactance, thereby mitigating adverse responses to moderation. We test these predictions in the context of Reddit's ban of a politically oriented community. To address endogeneity from users' self-selection into communities, we implement a two-stage least squares instrumental variable strategy that leverages exogenous variation in link exposure. Our results show that users with greater engagement diversification across the platform experience smaller declines in contributions, fewer spillovers of harmful behavior, and a lower likelihood of subsequent sanctions. These findings position engagement diversification as a key mechanism shaping moderation effectiveness, bridge content moderation and personalization policies, and suggest that platforms can strengthen governance outcomes by fostering diversified engagement through coordinated policy design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了用户参与多样化如何影响内容审核效果，发现在Reddit封禁政治社群后，参与多样化的用户贡献下降更少、有害行为溢出更少、后续制裁概率更低。
AI.research_question: 用户参与多样化如何影响内容审核的效果？
AI.motivation: 内容审核作为用户生成内容平台的核心治理机制，其有效性常受意外后果限制，但缺乏对审核产生有益与次优结果条件的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 媒体替代理论和心理抗拒理论
AI.method: 在Reddit封禁政治社群的背景下，采用两阶段最小二乘法工具变量策略，利用链接曝光的外生变异解决用户自选择的内生性问题。
AI.findings: 平台参与多样化程度更高的用户，在内容审核后贡献下降更小、有害行为溢出更少、后续制裁概率更低。
AI.theory_contributions: 将参与多样化定位为影响审核效果的关键机制，连接内容审核与个性化政策。
AI.practical_contributions: 平台可通过协调政策设计促进多样化参与，从而加强治理效果。

title: Can risks to fundamental rights arising from AI systems be 'managed' alongside health and safety risks? Implementing Article 9 of the EU AI Act
affiliations: The University of Birmingham

detail.title: Can risks to fundamental rights arising from AI systems be 'managed' alongside health and safety risks? Implementing Article 9 of the EU AI Act

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Since December 2023, I have participated as an expert in CEN and CENELEC Joint Technical Committee 21 (JTC21) working groups to support the AI Risk Management Standard on behalf of the European Network of Equality Bodies (Equinet) which is a JTC21 liaison organisation
declarations.funderStatement: My participation in JTC21 on behalf of Equinet between December 2023 to May 2025 was funded by the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council, grant number EP/Y009800/1, through funding from Responsible Ai UK for which I was Principal Investigator (Project: AI Equality by Design, Deliberation and Oversight). This work was also part funded by UK Research and Innovation (UKRI) under the UK government’s Horizon Europe Guarantee, Grant number 1042622 as part of the Horizon Europe Call: Horizon-CL4-2021-HUMAN-01 under Grant Proposal 10107617, European Lighthouse on Safe and Secure AI. The views expressed are entirely my own and do not represent those of Equinet or JTC21. All errors are mine alone

detail.abstract: The EU's AI Act introduces various 'essential requirements' which providers of 'high-risk AI systems' must comply with before their AI system can be placed on the market or put into service, including an obligation under Article 9 to establish and maintain a risk management system that reduces risks to 'health, safety and fundamental rights' to a level 'judged acceptable'. Although safety risk management systems are well established under the EU's 'New Approach' to product safety (to which the AI Act also belongs) extending those systems to encompass 'fundamental rights' risks introduce novel challenges. This chapter demonstrates that it is theoretically possible to devise and maintain a single integrated risk management system that encompasses both risks to health, safety and fundamental rights to comply with Article 9, based on risk management systems for safety-critical products. However, this entails complex theoretical, conceptual, interdisciplinary and practical challenges, particularly given uncertainty surrounding the meaning of key terms and unresolved questions concerning the extent to which fundamental rights can be asserted 'horizontally' against private parties in a networked digital age. I show that it offers rich opportunities to develop integrated cross-disciplinary methods to manage risks and threats to health, safety and fundamental rights in collaboration with affected stakeholder groups. However, there are grave dangers that Article 9 risk management systems will, in practice, be little more than 'theatres of compliance', appearing to take health, safety and fundamental rights seriously even as the deployment of AI technologies further undermines respect for the individual dignity and freedom upon which democracy depends.

AI.tldr: 欧盟AI法案要求高风险AI系统建立风险管理体系，涵盖健康、安全和基本权利风险。虽然理论上可以建立综合风险管理体系，但面临概念、理论和实践挑战，可能沦为形式合规。
AI.research_question: 如何设计符合欧盟AI法案第9条要求的综合风险管理体系，同时涵盖健康、安全和基本权利风险？
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案将传统产品安全风险管理扩展到基本权利领域，这一扩展带来了新的理论和实践挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧盟'新方法'产品安全管理体系，扩展到基本权利风险管理，涉及横向效力和数字时代权利保护等理论问题。
AI.method: 理论分析欧盟AI法案要求，基于安全关键产品风险管理体系，探讨综合风险管理系统的可行性。
AI.findings: 理论上可以建立综合风险管理体系，但面临概念模糊、横向效力不确定性等挑战，实践中可能沦为形式合规。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将产品安全风险管理扩展到基本权利领域的理论框架，探讨了数字时代权利保护的新挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统提供商提供了合规指导，强调了跨学科合作和利益相关者参与的重要性，警示了形式合规的风险。

title: Games as a Crime-Generating Factor and a Cybercrime Victimological Preventive Measure
affiliations: Moscow State Institute of International Relations (MGIMO)

detail.title: Games as a Crime-Generating Factor and a Cybercrime Victimological Preventive Measure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflicts of interest.

publicationDetails.detailsText: IV International Scientific and Practical Conference "Digital Technologies and Law". Kazan, 19-th September of 2019.

detail.abstract: The author of the article defines cybercrime as any use of information and communication technologies for criminal purposes. From a criminological point of view, games can be considered a criminogenic factor in a variety of crimes: violent (aggression), mercenary (acts against property such as theft and robbery, money laundering, financing of terrorism, extremism and prohibited organizations, mules), computer crimes (other types of so-called droppers) and crimes against public safety (the spread of dangerous ideologies and harmful content). Countering such a crime-prone situation must be comprehensive in nature: starting with the eradication of causes and conditions, personal development and ending with criminal prosecution (inter alia appropriate criminalization and penalization). The formation of a person's socalled digital immunity must be ensured at all stages of committing administrative and criminal offences. Meanwhile, the games themselves can be seen as one of the ways to prevent traditional and cybercrimes by revealing the scenarios of victims and criminals, and should have a number of restrictions that meet existing and emerging international standards, including international humanitarian law and problematic content.

AI.tldr: 本文从犯罪学角度分析游戏作为犯罪诱因的作用，提出网络犯罪的定义，并探讨游戏在预防传统犯罪和网络犯罪中的双重角色，强调需要建立数字免疫系统和综合防控措施。
AI.research_question: 游戏如何作为犯罪诱因影响不同类型的犯罪行为？如何通过游戏预防传统和网络犯罪？
AI.motivation: 随着信息通信技术的发展，网络犯罪日益严重，游戏作为数字环境中的重要元素，既可能成为犯罪诱因，也可能成为犯罪预防工具，需要系统研究其双重作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 犯罪学理论、网络犯罪理论、数字免疫理论、国际人道法标准
AI.method: 概念分析、理论框架构建、法律标准分析
AI.findings: 游戏可诱发暴力犯罪、财产犯罪、计算机犯罪和公共安全犯罪；同时游戏也可通过展示受害者和犯罪者情景来预防犯罪；需要建立全面的数字免疫系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了游戏作为犯罪诱因和预防工具的双重理论框架，发展了数字免疫概念在犯罪预防中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为游戏产业提供犯罪预防指导，为执法机构提供综合防控策略，为国际标准制定提供参考依据。

title: Generative AI, Open Source, and Application-Layer Product Development
affiliations: Wisconsin School of Business, Marshall School of Business - University of Southern California and Boston University - Questrom School of Business

detail.title: Generative AI, Open Source, and Application-Layer Product Development
detail.abstract: The rise of foundation models in generative AI (GenAI), driven by the development of large language models (LLMs), is reshaping firms' product development strategies through open-source technologies. Unlike traditional open-source environments characterized by collaboration and standardization, the LLM-based open-source paradigm introduces new complexities, notably fine-tuning uncertainty on performance and limited collaboration between firms, that influence innovation efforts of firms. This paper develops an analytical model to examine how these dynamics shape firms' product development strategies, contrasting settings involving traditional open-source technologies with those built on LLMs. Our results show that fine-tuning uncertainty acts as a double-edged sword: whereas it destabilizes predictable product development outcomes for firms, it can also create artificial vertical differentiation that softens competition and boosts firm profitability. In contrast, limited collaboration imposes structural barriers that prevent cooperative vertical improvement, curtailing shared progress and reducing profitability. Taken together, however, these dynamics can still yield positive outcomes for firms. From a welfare perspective, we find that as LLMs become easier to adapt to product needs, total welfare increases in both settings, but interestingly, it grows more slowly under LLM-based open source, due to distortions introduced by the artificial vertical differentiation that weaken firm-user matching. At the same time, limited collaboration can improve welfare by compelling firms to undertake stronger vertical development individually, raising product quality and alleviating the underinvestment problem that arises in traditional open-source collaboration. Overall, our study sheds lights on the strategic trade-offs and opportunities in leveraging open-source LLMs for corporate product development. It also informs ongoing policy discussions surrounding the governance of open-source LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了基于大语言模型的开源技术如何改变企业产品开发策略，重点探讨了微调不确定性和有限合作这两个新特性对创新和盈利的影响。研究发现微调不确定性既是风险也是机会，而有限合作虽然阻碍共同进步但可能改善福利。
AI.research_question: 基于大语言模型的开源技术如何影响企业的产品开发策略？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI和大语言模型的兴起正在通过开源技术重塑企业的产品开发策略，但与传统开源环境不同，LLM开源范式引入了新的复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开源技术创新理论、产品开发策略理论、垂直差异化理论
AI.method: 分析模型构建，对比传统开源技术与基于LLM的开源技术设置
AI.findings: 微调不确定性具有双重效应：破坏产品开发可预测性，但创造人工垂直差异化缓解竞争；有限合作阻碍垂直改进但可能改善福利；LLM适应度提高时总福利增加但增长较慢
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了LLM开源范式下企业战略权衡的理论机制，特别是微调不确定性和有限合作对创新动态的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业利用开源LLM进行产品开发提供战略指导，为开源LLM治理政策讨论提供参考

title: Cyber Conflict and Critical Infrastructure: State-Sponsored Threats, Escalating Vulnerabilities, and U.S. Defense Imperatives
affiliations: Coastline Community College, Coastline College and Coastline Community College

detail.title: Cyber Conflict and Critical Infrastructure: State-Sponsored Threats, Escalating Vulnerabilities, and U.S. Defense Imperatives

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There were no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human subjects were used in the study.
declarations.funderStatement: There was no funding provided for the study.

detail.abstract: This study examines the evolving landscape of statesponsored cyber operations targeting U.S. critical infrastructure, situating these attacks within broader geopolitical, legal, and societal contexts. Drawing upon the Council on Foreign Relations Cyber Operations Tracker, the research employs a mixed-methods approach that combines large-scale quantitative analysis with qualitative case studies of the Bowman Dam intrusion, persistent energy sector compromises, and the Colonial Pipeline ransomware attack. The study finds that cyber operations are highly concentrated among four adversaries China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea whose campaigns align with major geopolitical events and demonstrate an escalation toward sustained, campaign-level operations. Critical infrastructure incidents reveal a particularly volatile pattern, with a 1,200% surge in attacks during 2020, underscoring the sector's vulnerability in times of global instability. The research highlights systemic weaknesses such as supply chain dependencies, limited resilience strategies, and insider threats, as well as the absence of enforceable international legal frameworks. The findings conclude with recommendations for a defensive doctrine based on zero-trust architecture, enhanced forensic visibility, and proactive norm-setting in international cyberspace governance.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了针对美国关键基础设施的国家支持网络攻击，发现攻击高度集中于中俄伊朝四国，2020年攻击激增1200%，揭示了供应链依赖、恢复力不足等系统性弱点，并提出零信任架构等防御建议。
AI.research_question: 国家支持的网络攻击如何针对美国关键基础设施，这些攻击在更广泛的地缘政治、法律和社会背景下有何特征和影响？
AI.motivation: 关键基础设施面临日益严重的国家支持网络攻击威胁，需要理解这些攻击的模式、动因和系统性弱点，以制定有效的防御策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地缘政治理论、网络安全理论和国际关系理论，分析网络攻击与地缘政治事件的关联性。
AI.method: 混合方法：利用CFR网络行动追踪器进行大规模定量分析，结合Bowman Dam入侵、能源部门持续妥协和Colonial Pipeline勒索软件攻击的定性案例研究。
AI.findings: 网络攻击高度集中于中俄伊朝四国；攻击与重大地缘政治事件相关；2020年关键基础设施攻击激增1200%；存在供应链依赖、恢复力策略有限、内部威胁等系统性弱点；缺乏可执行的国际法律框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对国家支持网络攻击与地缘政治关联的理解；提出了网络攻击升级为持续性战役级行动的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了基于零信任架构的防御原则；建议增强取证可见性；倡导在国际网络空间治理中建立主动规范制定机制。

title: Six-Maturity-Level National Digital Twins: Processes, Roadmap, and Management Strategies for Logistics and Supply Chain Systems
affiliations: University Canada West, Purdue University and Delft University of Technology

detail.title: Six-Maturity-Level National Digital Twins: Processes, Roadmap, and Management Strategies for Logistics and Supply Chain Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NO
declarations.funderStatement: NSF

detail.abstract: Digital Twin (DT) technology is increasingly critical for enhancing efficiency and responsiveness in logistics and supply chain systems (LSCS), particularly as these systems grow in complexity and dynamism. While existing research has extensively explored specialized DT solutions, these standalone implementations often neglect critical aspects of communication, interoperability, and coordinated management among multiple stakeholders, leading to suboptimal performance and reduced operational effectiveness in LSCS. To address these challenges, the National Digital Twin (NDT) emerges as a transformative solution, promising significant improvements through integration and system-level management. This paper conducts a comprehensive investigation into the development of an NDT tailored explicitly for LSCS. Specifically, we propose a robust and scalable five-layer NDT architecture, designed to facilitate seamless integration, effective communication, and enhanced coordination among stakeholders across LSCS. Furthermore, six-level maturity NDT is coined to guide the decision-makers and developers to select their appropriate NDT structure. In particular, we outline a detailed roadmap that guides transitioning from conventional systems to a fully operational NDT environment. Finally, critical management strategies, encompassing stakeholders, data governance, and continuous improvement mechanisms, are discussed to ensure sustained effectiveness and adaptability. As a pioneering research in the application of NDT to LSCS, this study highlights essential insights and practical recommendations that advance both theoretical understanding and practical applications, offering valuable guidance for future research directions and industrial deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个专门为物流与供应链系统设计的五层国家数字孪生架构，旨在解决现有数字孪生解决方案在通信、互操作性和协调管理方面的不足。
AI.research_question: 如何为物流与供应链系统开发一个有效的国家数字孪生架构？
AI.motivation: 现有数字孪生解决方案多为独立实现，忽视了多利益相关者之间的通信、互操作性和协调管理，导致物流与供应链系统性能不佳。

detail.abstract:
Full paper access is available on publisher site through the following e-print link: https://www.tandfonline.com/eprint/7CXSE7ZYUBMTJAGJCF2Q/full?target=10.1080/20421338.2025.2542592
In the era of digitalization, electronic procurement is playing a major role in enhancing the productivity of organizations in the construction sector. Unfortunately, this is not as evident in Ethiopia, and the situation in regional areas is aggravated by distinct challenges. The study aimed to develop an e-procurement system using data from interviews and focus group discussions with IT experts and major construction stakeholders of the Central Ethiopia Regional State. It was noted that the region needs e-procurement to increase transparency, save costs and time, and improve management. To address these needs, a web-based system using JavaScript was suggested, particularly for its security and accessibility attributes. However, a lack of government-based infrastructure and organizational necessities, along with un-equipped staff, were major barriers to e-procurement implementation. Testing the system showed positive sentiment, with average ratings of 99.3% for attainability and 95.67% for functionality. The sector can benefit from e-procurement by creating strong authentication mechanisms, linking with financial organizations, and incorporating timely capacity building programmes. The study contributed to the development of the e-procurement system as an initial stage for the region's construction sector.

AI.tldr: 本研究为埃塞俄比亚中部地区开发了一个基于JavaScript的电子采购系统，旨在提高建筑行业的透明度、节约成本和时间。系统测试显示99.3%的可实现性和95.67%的功能性评分，但面临政府基础设施不足和员工能力欠缺等障碍。

contentType.other: I submitted the paper to Ofcom in their consultation on automated illegal content detection tools

detail.abstract:
In the UK, the communications services regulator, Ofcom, has issued for consultation proposed guidance to user-to-user (U2U) platforms and search engines on “proactive technology: automated systems intended to detect particular kinds of illegal content and content harmful to children, with a view to blocking or swiftly removing them”, as required under the UK Online Safety Act. This paper was submitted to Ofcom in that consultation.
In section 2, I discuss one preliminary and three substantive issues relating to the proposed guidelines under the European Convention on Human Rights and the UK Human Rights Act. In section 3, I address four issues relating to the in-principle prohibition of the taking of fully-automated decisions on individuals enshrined in Article 22 of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and still also contained (for now, without change) in the UK_GDPR. (In fact, the fourth issue under the GDPR – whether human rights violations must be [fully] prevented or need only be “minimised” – also relates to the ECHR and the HRA.) In section 4, I summarise my analyses and set out my conclusions.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了英国Ofcom关于在线安全法案中主动技术指南的合规性问题，重点讨论了欧洲人权公约和GDPR中关于自动化决策的禁止规定。
