title: Climate Risk and Strategic Green M&As
affiliations: Deakin Business School, Deakin University, Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University) - School of Economics, Finance and Marketing, Deakin University - Deakin Business School and Deakin University

detail.title: Climate Risk and Strategic Green M&As

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no potential conflicts of interest.
declarations.funderStatement: The authors declare that they have not received any financial support for the research paper.

detail.abstract: We examine how firms adapt to climate risk through the market for corporate control. Using firm-level measures of climate exposure, we find that more exposed firms are significantly more likely to acquire targets with green technologies and operations. This effect is strongest among firms with limited internal innovation capacity and in industries where offshoring emissions is less feasible. Evidence suggests these acquisitions are value-driven rather than agency-driven, as the effect is concentrated among firms with stronger managerialshareholder alignment, greater analyst coverage, and closer monitoring by socially responsible institutions. Consistent with investor influence, higher climate exposure is associated with increases in socially responsible ownership, the number of climate-related shareholder proposals, and support for such proposals. Green acquisitions also yield positive announcement returns and boost subsequent green innovation, indicating benefits beyond technology transfer. Overall, our results highlight M&A as a strategic, market-based mechanism for corporate adaptation to climate risk.

title: Investor Memory and Stock Returns: Empirical Evidence
affiliations: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE) - China Center for Behavior Economics and Finance and Southwestern University of Finance and Economics (SWUFE) - China Center for Behavior Economics and Finance

detail.title: Investor Memory and Stock Returns: Empirical Evidence
detail.abstract: We measure investor memory bias (MB) as the proportion of negative daily returns that investors tend to forget or suppress. We find that stocks with high MB earn significantly lower subsequent returns than stocks with low MB. The high-minus-low MB portfolio generates a return spread of-0.90% per month for equal-weighted portfolios and-0.81% per month for value-weighted portfolios. The negative relation between MB and future returns remains after controlling for fifteen established stock characteristics and stays statistically significant under multiple asset-pricing factor models. Further analysis reveals that the MB effect is stronger when investor sentiment is high, when investors use closing prices rather than opening prices, and when arbitrage constraints are tighter. High-MB stocks also exhibit significantly greater abnormal trading volume, consistent with memory-induced reinvestment behavior. Our findings provide the first direct empirical evidence that positive memory bias systematically affects aggregate stock prices.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现投资者记忆偏差（MB）与股票未来回报呈负相关关系，高MB股票比低MB股票获得显著更低的后续回报，这为正面记忆偏差系统性影响股票价格提供了首个直接实证证据。
AI.research_question: 投资者记忆偏差如何影响股票价格和未来回报？
AI.motivation: 研究投资者记忆偏差对股票市场定价的影响，填补了记忆偏差在金融市场中实证研究的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为金融学理论，特别是投资者记忆偏差和认知偏差理论。
AI.method: 构建投资者记忆偏差指标，进行投资组合分析，控制15个已知股票特征，使用多种资产定价因子模型进行检验。
AI.findings: 高MB股票比低MB股票每月回报低0.90%（等权重）和0.81%（价值权重）；MB效应在投资者情绪高、使用收盘价、套利约束严格时更强；高MB股票交易量异常增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供记忆偏差系统性影响股票价格的直接实证证据，扩展了行为金融学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供新的投资策略参考，帮助识别受记忆偏差影响的股票定价异常。

title: ASSESSING THE IMPACT OF MULTIPLE STOCK SCREENING TECHNIQUES ON THE PERFORMANCE OF LISTED MANUFACTURING FIRMS IN BANGLADESH
affiliations: American International University Bangladesh (AIUB)

detail.title: ASSESSING THE IMPACT OF MULTIPLE STOCK SCREENING TECHNIQUES ON THE PERFORMANCE OF LISTED MANUFACTURING FIRMS IN BANGLADESH
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the efficacy of various stock screening methods in analyzing the financial distress and performance of listed manufacturing companies in Bangladesh. As financial decision-making becomes increasingly complex, businesses, investors, and policymakers require sound evaluation methodologies to assess the viability and potential growth of firms. This study systematically analyzes several screening techniques (e.g., financial ratios, market, and operational indicators) to evaluate their ability to predict the viability of manufacturing firms. The analysis is conducted on a sample of listed manufacturing companies across various sectors, using a quantitative approach to measure associations between screening variables and performance indicators such as profitability, liquidity, and growth potential. The results indicate that multimethod function testing can create an integrated performance assessment method, providing a richer picture for the decision-making process. This paper contributes to corporate finance literature by demonstrating that a variety of screening tools can be effective for monitoring the manufacturing industry and offers both academic and practical relevance for financial analysts, investors, and firms seeking long-term sustainability.

title: Aggregate Investor Attention and Bitcoin Return: The Long Short-term Memory Networks Perspective
affiliations: Tianjin University, School of Finance, Nankai University and University of Hull

detail.title: Aggregate Investor Attention and Bitcoin Return: The Long Short-term Memory Networks Perspective

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance Research Letters, volume 49, 2022[10.1016/j.frl.2022.103143]

detail.abstract: Investor attention is a scarce cognitive resource which affects investment decisions, and recent studies suggest that investor attention also have impacts on asset prices. Although Bitcoin is found to be one of the most unpredictable cryptocurrencies with excessive volatilities, researchers are still looking for determinants of Bitcoin prices. In this study, we firstly adopt the Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM) approach to evaluate the effect of investor attention on Bitcoin returns by constructing an aggregate investor attention proxy. We combine both direct and indirect proxies for investor attention, in addition to the Bitcoin trading variables as the LSTM inputs. Our empirical results suggest that the including of attention variables could effectively improve the LSTM's prediction accuracy of Bitcoin prices, whereas direct proxies (i.e. daily Google Trends to Bitcoin and Bitcoin tweets) contains more valuable information to further improve the LSTM's forecasting capacity.

title: A quantitative approach to practical transcription of Japanese names into Ukrainian
affiliations: Institute of Artificial Intelligence Problems

detail.title: A quantitative approach to practical transcription of Japanese names into Ukrainian

publicationDetails.detailsText: Russian Linguistics, volume 49, issue 1, 2025[10.1007/s11185-025-09321-x]

detail.abstract: This study introduces a quantitative phonetic distance metric to evaluate and improve the practical transcription of Japanese names into Ukrainian. We argue for a standardization of Japanese-Ukrainian transcription grounded in objective phonetic similarity, while also proposing a phoneticphonemic model that accounts for coarticulation effects in Japanese. By applying a metric method grounded in articulatory phonetics, this work identifies the clos est phoneme pairs between Japanese and Ukrainian and assesses their alignment in several established transcription systems. Special attention is given to Japanese palatalized conso nants such as [ɕ], [ʑ], and [t͡ ɕ], which correspond more accurately to Ukrainian soft alveolar phonemes [sʲ], [zʲ], and [t͡ sʲ] than to their postalveolar counterparts. The results reveal that the modified Fedoryshyn system-replacing the Ukrainian letter "ґ" ("g") with "г" ("gh")-most closely aligns with both phonetic and phonological principles of the Ukrainian lan guage. Statistical frequency data from the Ukrainian language corpus further support these findings. The metric method used here provides a replicable framework that can be extended to other language pairs and transcription contexts. This approach enhances linguistic preci sion and supports the development of consistent, phonetically accurate, and computationally useful transcription systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究引入定量语音距离指标来评估和改进日语名字在乌克兰语中的实际转写，提出基于客观语音相似度的标准化转写系统，并开发了考虑日语协同发音效应的语音音位模型。
AI.research_question: 如何基于语音相似度建立日语-乌克兰语转写的标准化系统？
AI.motivation: 当前日语-乌克兰语转写系统缺乏统一的语音学基础，需要建立客观的语音距离指标来改进转写准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于发音语音学的语音距离度量理论，考虑协同发音效应的语音音位模型。
AI.method: 应用基于发音语音学的度量方法，识别日语和乌克兰语中最接近的音位对，评估多个现有转写系统的对齐程度。
AI.findings: 修改后的Fedoryshyn系统（用"г"替代"ґ"）在语音和音位原则方面与乌克兰语最匹配；日语腭化辅音更准确地对应乌克兰语软腭音素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了可复制的语音距离度量框架，可扩展到其他语言对和转写情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 提高了转写的语言学精确度，支持开发一致、语音准确且计算有用的转写系统。

title: Regulating Cryptocurrency Transactions: International Tax Frameworks, IFRS Convergence, and Cross-Border Arbitrage
affiliations: The University of Lahore Islamabad Campus

detail.title: Regulating Cryptocurrency Transactions: International Tax Frameworks, IFRS Convergence, and Cross-Border Arbitrage
detail.abstract: This study looks at how international tax rules work to control cryptocurrency transactions. It is based on IFRS rules and the OECD's Crypto-Asset Reporting Framework (CARF). The researcher uses a new global dataset covering the years 2011 to 2025. The study introduces ten measures: the Global Regulatory Coverage Index (GRCI), the Global IFRS Alignment Score (GIFRSAS), the Global Tax Compliance Effectiveness Score (GTCES), the Global Cross-Border Arbitrage Index (GCBAI), the Global Disclosure Quality Index (GDQI), the Global Enforcement Capacity Score (GECS), the Global Detection Rate (GDR), the Global Penalty Collection Ratio (GPCR), the Global Convergence Score (GCS), and the Global Policy Diffusion Speed (GPDS). These measures show both how much regulation is in place and how well people follow the rules. The study uses several methods, including describing data, looking at how variables are connected, and using time-based analysis to understand how these factors relate to each other. The results show a strong link between how much regulation is in place and cross-border arbitrage, with a correlation of-0.97. This means that when more countries follow CARF and IFRS reporting, there is less chance of people taking advantage of tax differences in different countries. The study shows that working together internationally, spreading new rules quickly, and having strong enforcement are all important for tax compliance and reducing arbitrage. The study adds value by offering an easy-to-use framework, new measures, and important evidence for policymakers. It concludes that international tax changes can help with compliance and reduce arbitrage only when regulation, IFRS alignment, and enforcement all improve at the same time.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于IFRS规则和OECD的加密资产报告框架，使用2011-2025年全球数据集，开发了10个衡量指标来评估国际税收规则对加密货币交易的监管效果。研究发现监管覆盖与跨境套利呈强负相关(-0.97)，表明国际合作、规则快速传播和强力执法对税收合规和减少套利至关重要。

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于IFRS会计准则和OECD的加密资产报告框架(CARF)，构建国际税收监管理论框架。
AI.method: 使用2011-2025年全球数据集，采用描述性统计、相关性分析和时间序列分析等方法，开发了10个衡量指标。
AI.findings: 监管覆盖与跨境套利呈强负相关(-0.97)，国际合作、规则传播速度和执法能力对税收合规有显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了包含10个新指标的综合衡量框架，丰富了国际税收监管理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实用的监管框架和实证证据，有助于改善加密货币税收合规和减少套利行为。

title: Stochastic thermodynamics of financial markets II: temperature.
affiliations: GammaDynamics, LLC

detail.title: Stochastic thermodynamics of financial markets II: temperature.

AI.tldr: 该论文使用随机热力学和哈密顿形式主义量化市场温度，发现市场环境通常比市场本身更"热"，能量从环境流向市场。当两者温度接近时，表明大部分信息已被市场定价。
AI.research_question: 市场中有多少信息已被定价，有多少尚未被定价？
AI.motivation: 理解市场定价效率，探索随机热力学在金融市场分析中的应用
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机热力学（用于熵变分析）和金融市场哈密顿形式主义（用于能量变化分析）
AI.method: 通过量化市场温度和环境温度，分析两者差异来评估定价程度
AI.findings: 市场温度通常为负值，市场环境比市场本身更"热"，能量从环境流向市场；当两者温度接近时，表明大部分信息已被定价
AI.theory_contributions: 将热力学概念引入金融市场分析，建立了市场定价效率的量化评估框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供判断市场定价程度的工具，帮助识别投资机会和风险

title: Corporate Social Irresponsibility: After ESG, activist investors should side with taxpayers
affiliations: Competitive Enterprise Institute and Center for Economic Accountability

detail.title: Corporate Social Irresponsibility: After ESG, activist investors should side with taxpayers
detail.abstract: State and municipal governments across America are engaged in a massive transfer of public resources to private corporate interests in the name of economic development. However, the evidence is clear that these corporate subsidy programs operate more for the benefit of the cronies who control them than for any measurable public interest. At the same time, environmental, social, and governance (ESG) investing has become increasingly toxic with policymakers, the corporate world, and the voting public. Rather than doubling down on the divisive and increasingly discredited approach of current ESG practice, firms should pivot to an emphasis on first doing no harm economically and protecting the welfare of American taxpayers.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了美国州和地方政府以经济发展为名向私营企业提供补贴的做法，认为这些补贴更多惠及关系户而非公共利益。同时，ESG投资日益受到质疑，作者建议企业转向"首先不造成经济伤害"和保护美国纳税人福利的立场。
AI.research_question: 企业补贴计划和ESG投资实践如何影响公共利益和美国纳税人福利？
AI.motivation: 政府向私营企业提供大规模补贴，但这些补贴更多惠及关系户而非公共利益；ESG投资实践日益受到质疑，需要寻找更有效的方法来保护公共利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共利益理论、企业社会责任理论和纳税人保护理论，分析政府补贴和ESG实践的有效性。
AI.method: 批判性分析现有证据和政策实践，采用规范性分析方法提出替代方案。
AI.findings: 企业补贴计划主要惠及关系户而非公共利益；ESG投资实践日益受到质疑且具有分裂性；需要转向"首先不造成经济伤害"的原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从争议性ESG实践向"首先不造成经济伤害"原则转变的理论框架；拓展了企业社会责任理论在纳税人保护方面的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了从争议性ESG实践转向更务实做法的具体建议；为政策制定者提供了重新评估企业补贴计划有效性的依据；强调保护美国纳税人福利的重要性。

title: Peer Effects and Worker Visibility in Team Production: Evidence from NBA Rookies
affiliations: Yale University - Department of Economics, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Cambridge, Cambridge Judge Business School and Drexel University

detail.title: Peer Effects and Worker Visibility in Team Production: Evidence from NBA Rookies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no conflict of interest to declare.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how peer quality impacts early-career visibility, productivity, and longterm earnings in team-based settings. While high-ability peers can generate positive spillovers, they may limit opportunities for less-experienced individuals to showcase their skills, limiting visibility and career progression. Using National Basketball Association (NBA) data, where rookies are quasi-randomly assigned to teams, we find that stronger teams provide less playing time, especially for lower-ranked picks or those competing with star players in the same position. This reduces experience, performance, and future earnings. A theoretical model identifies reduced exposure as the key mechanism, with broader implications for team-based industries where early exposure shapes career paths.

AI.tldr: 本文研究同伴质量如何影响团队环境中早期职业的可见性、生产力和长期收入。研究发现，虽然高能力同伴能产生正向溢出效应，但可能限制经验较少个体展示技能的机会，从而影响职业发展。
AI.research_question: 同伴质量如何影响早期职业的可见性、生产力和长期收入？
AI.motivation: 在团队环境中，高能力同伴既可能带来正向溢出效应，也可能限制经验较少个体的展示机会，这种平衡关系对职业发展路径有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于团队生产理论和职业发展理论，关注同伴效应中的可见性机制。
AI.method: 使用NBA数据，利用新秀准随机分配到球队的自然实验设计，分析比赛时间、表现和未来收入。
AI.findings: 更强的球队提供更少的比赛时间，特别是对于排名较低的新秀或与明星球员位置重叠的球员，这减少了经验积累、表现和未来收入。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"减少曝光"作为关键机制的理论模型，拓展了对团队环境中同伴效应的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 对团队型产业中早期职业发展有重要启示，强调早期曝光对职业路径形成的关键作用。

title: Aggregation Fallacy: An Explanation for Systematic Forecast Bias
affiliations: Emory University - Goizueta Business School, Lehigh University - College of Business and University of Fribourg - Department of Business Administration

detail.title: Aggregation Fallacy: An Explanation for Systematic Forecast Bias
detail.abstract: In forecasting and capital budgeting, managers tend to underestimate costs. Prior research typically attributes this forecast bias to misaligned incentives or imperfect information. We introduce a novel explanation: aggregation fallacy. The key idea is that individuals provide forecasts of aggregate outcomes (e.g., total costs) by erroneously adding component forecasts (e.g., costs in divisions A and B). While such linear aggregation is appropriate for deterministic information (i.e., costs that have been incurred), it can result in systematic bias with probabilistic information (i.e., future costs) due to right skew in cost distributions. In support of our hypotheses, results of several experiments show that aggregation fallacy leads to systematic underestimation of costs. Additional analyses demonstrate that aggregation fallacy is not eliminated by learning and also holds with financial incentives for forecast accuracy. Overall, our study demonstrates that, even with aligned incentives and perfect information, systematic cost underestimation may arise due to aggregation fallacy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的解释——聚合谬误，来解释管理者在预测和资本预算中低估成本的现象。研究发现，即使激励一致且信息完美，由于成本分布的右偏特性，个体在预测总成本时会错误地将各组成部分的预测线性相加，导致系统性低估。
AI.research_question: 为什么管理者在预测和资本预算中会系统性低估成本？聚合谬误是否能够解释这种现象？
AI.motivation: 传统研究通常将预测偏差归因于激励不一致或信息不完美，但本文希望探索是否存在其他认知机制导致成本低估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 聚合谬误理论：个体在预测总体结果时，会错误地将各组成部分的预测线性相加。这种线性聚合对于确定性信息是合适的，但对于概率性信息（如未来成本）则会产生系统性偏差，因为成本分布通常呈现右偏特性。
AI.method: 多项实验研究，通过控制实验条件来检验聚合谬误对成本低估的影响。
AI.findings: 聚合谬误确实导致系统性成本低估；这种谬误不会通过学习消除，即使在有财务激励的情况下仍然存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了聚合谬误作为成本低估的新解释机制，丰富了预测偏差的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织改进预测和预算流程提供了实践启示，建议采用非线性聚合方法来减少成本低估偏差。

title: Oligopolistic Information Markets
affiliations: University of York and Humboldt University of Berlin - School of Business and Economics

detail.title: Oligopolistic Information Markets
detail.abstract: We develop a model of oligopolistic price competition in information markets where buyers purchase and combine signals from multiple sellers. This nonexclusivity transforms competition into "portfolio competition", with sellers competing against all possible coalitions rather than individual competitors. We fully characterize its pure-strategy competition equilibria and study endogenous entry. In every equilibrium, buyers purchase efficiently from all active sellers. Whether competition protects buyers from rent extraction depends on information complementarities: in duopoly, full extraction occurs if and only if signals are complements; in oligopoly this if-and-only-if condition generalizes to a coalitional "balancedness" condition. With symmetric sellers, balancedness reduces to a geometric test. Entry can paradoxically reduce competitive pressure when entrants provide strong complementarities. Entry is never excessive, contrasting standard oligopoly models where excess results from business-stealing externalities. Instead, efficient entry is always an equilibrium, though insufficient entry equilibria may exist, prompting regulatory intervention.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了信息市场中卖方之间的寡头价格竞争，其中买方从多个卖方购买并组合信号。这种非排他性将竞争转变为"投资组合竞争"，卖方与所有可能的联盟竞争而非单个竞争对手。论文完全描述了纯策略竞争均衡并研究了内生进入。在均衡中，买方从所有活跃卖方处有效购买。竞争是否保护买方免受租金提取取决于信息互补性：在双头垄断中，当且仅当信号是互补品时会发生完全提取；在寡头垄断中，这一条件推广为联盟"平衡性"条件。当进入者提供强互补性时，进入可能矛盾地减少竞争压力。进入从不过度，这与标准寡头垄断模型形成对比。
AI.research_question: 信息市场中卖方之间的寡头价格竞争如何影响买方福利？竞争是否保护买方免受租金提取？内生进入如何影响竞争结果？
AI.motivation: 传统寡头竞争模型假设买方从单个卖方购买，而信息市场中的买方通常从多个卖方购买并组合信号，这种非排他性可能改变竞争动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于寡头价格竞争理论，引入"投资组合竞争"概念，卖方与所有可能的联盟竞争而非单个竞争对手。
AI.method: 构建信息市场寡头价格竞争模型，分析纯策略竞争均衡，研究内生进入决策。
AI.findings: 1. 在均衡中买方从所有活跃卖方处有效购买；2. 竞争保护买方免受租金提取取决于信息互补性；3. 双头垄断中当且仅当信号是互补品时发生完全提取；4. 寡头垄断中平衡性条件决定租金提取；5. 进入可能减少竞争压力；6. 进入从不过度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"投资组合竞争"新概念；2. 建立信息市场非排他性竞争模型；3. 发现竞争保护买方条件与信息互补性相关；4. 揭示进入对竞争压力的矛盾影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为信息市场监管提供理论依据；2. 帮助理解信息市场进入决策；3. 为买方信息购买策略提供指导；4. 提示监管干预的必要性。

title: Complementary Learning Approach for Text Classification using Large Language Models
affiliations: Fordham University - Gabelli School of Business

detail.title: Complementary Learning Approach for Text Classification using Large Language Models

keywords: mechanism-based theorizing RUNNING HEAD: Complementary Learning Approach Complementary Learning Approach for Text Classification using Large Language Models large language models

detail.abstract: In this study, we propose a structured methodology that utilizes large language models (LLMs) in a cost-efficient, parsimonious manner that integrates the strengths of scholars and machines while offsetting their respective weaknesses. Our methodology-facilitated through "chain of thought" and "few-shot learning" prompting from computer science-extends best practices for co-author teams in qualitative research to human-machine teams in quantitative research. This allows humans to utilize abductive reasoning and natural language to interrogate not just what the machine has done but also what the human has done. Our method highlights how scholars can manage LLMs' inherent weaknesses using careful, low-cost techniques. We demonstrate how to use the methodology to interrogate human-machine rating discrepancies for a sample of 1,934 press releases announcing pharmaceutical alliances (1990-2017). Managerial Summary Facilitated through "chain of thought" and "few-shot learning" prompting from computer science, we introduce a method of utilizing large language models (LLMs) to efficiently tackle large text corpora that require subject matter expertise to classify properly. The approach combines the contextual understanding, creativity, and ethical judgment of humans with the computational efficiency, rule-derived consistency, and large dataset processing capacity of LLMs. We draw upon and extend best practices for co-author teams in qualitative research to human-machine teams in quantitative research, allowing humans to utilize natural language to interrogate not just what the machine has done but also what the human has done. We demonstrate how to use the methodology on a sample of 1,934 press releases announcing pharmaceutical alliances (1990-2017).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结构化方法，利用大型语言模型以成本效益高的方式结合学者和机器的优势，弥补各自的弱点。该方法通过"思维链"和"少样本学习"提示技术，将定性研究中合著团队的最佳实践扩展到定量研究中的人机团队。
AI.research_question: 如何有效利用大型语言模型进行大规模文本分析，同时克服其固有弱点？
AI.motivation: 需要一种成本效益高、简洁的方法来整合学者和机器在文本分析中的各自优势，同时弥补各自的弱点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计算机科学中的"思维链"和"少样本学习"提示技术；定性研究中合著团队的最佳实践；人机协作理论。
AI.method: 结构化方法论，结合人类的情境理解、创造力和伦理判断与LLM的计算效率、规则一致性和大数据处理能力。使用1,934份制药联盟新闻稿(1990-2017)作为样本进行验证。
AI.findings: 该方法能够有效管理LLM的固有弱点，通过低成本技术实现人机协作，允许人类使用自然语言质疑机器和人类的工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 将定性研究中合著团队的最佳实践扩展到定量研究中的人机团队；提出了结合人类溯因推理与机器计算能力的新方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种成本效益高的方法来处理需要专业知识分类的大规模文本语料库；展示了如何在制药联盟新闻稿分析中应用该方法。

title: The Economics of Working Environments: Evidence from Linked Survey and Register Data
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Management and Technology, Copenhagen Business School - Department of Economics, INSEAD - Economics and Political Sciences and

detail.title: The Economics of Working Environments: Evidence from Linked Survey and Register Data
detail.abstract: We use a large-scale survey from Denmark to construct firm-level measures of the working environment capturing its physical, psychological, and social elements. First, to validate our measures, we show that firms with better working environments fare better in unannounced workplace inspections conducted by a government agency. Second, using register data, we show that firms with better working environments have longer employee tenures, and their employees are less likely to be hospitalized or to experience work-related accidents. Finally, firms with better working environments have higher labor productivity and, ultimately, better profitability. Collectively, our findings suggest that improving firms' working environments can be beneficial to both employees and shareholders.

AI.tldr: 本文使用丹麦的大规模调查数据构建了衡量工作环境的指标体系，涵盖物理、心理和社会三个维度。研究发现，工作环境更好的企业员工任期更长、住院率和工伤事故率更低，同时这些企业的劳动生产率和盈利能力也更高。
AI.research_question: 企业工作环境的改善是否对员工福利和企业绩效产生积极影响？
AI.motivation: 探究工作环境质量与员工健康、企业绩效之间的关系，为改善工作环境提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资源管理理论和组织行为学理论，关注工作环境对员工福祉和企业绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用丹麦大规模调查数据构建工作环境指标，结合政府检查记录、员工住院数据、工伤事故数据和财务数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1）工作环境更好的企业在政府突击检查中表现更好；2）这些企业员工任期更长，住院率和工伤事故率更低；3）这些企业劳动生产率和盈利能力更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了工作环境多维度的量化测量方法，验证了工作环境改善对员工福祉和企业绩效的正向影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业改善工作环境提供了实证支持，表明良好的工作环境既能提升员工福利，又能提高企业绩效，实现双赢。

title: On Finding the Optimal Rotation of Principal Components for Structural Interpretation
affiliations: Swiss Finance Institute

detail.title: On Finding the Optimal Rotation of Principal Components for Structural Interpretation
detail.abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of interpreting statistical factors derived from principal component analysis (PCA), a common issue in empirical macroeconomics. Traditional methods for rotating these factors to achieve economic meaning are often ad-hoc and subjective. The paper proposes a novel approach that systematically finds an interpretable rotation by maximizing the cosine similarity between the statistical factor loadings and a target structure. The maximization problem is shown to be equivalent to the Orthogonal Procrustes Problem, which has a unique, optimal solution provided by Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). The paper showcases the method by extracting the monetary policy surprise factors proposed by Kroencke et al. (2021).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新方法，通过最大化统计因子载荷与目标结构之间的余弦相似度，系统性地找到可解释的旋转，解决了PCA统计因子解释性的挑战。该方法等价于正交Procrustes问题，可通过SVD获得唯一最优解。
AI.research_question: 如何系统性地找到可解释的旋转，使PCA统计因子具有经济意义？
AI.motivation: 传统方法旋转统计因子以获得经济意义通常是临时性和主观的，缺乏系统性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主成分分析（PCA）、因子旋转、正交Procrustes问题、奇异值分解（SVD）
AI.method: 通过最大化统计因子载荷与目标结构之间的余弦相似度来寻找最优旋转，该方法等价于正交Procrustes问题，可通过SVD求解。
AI.findings: 该方法能够系统性地找到可解释的旋转，解决了传统方法的主观性问题，并成功应用于提取Kroencke等人（2021）提出的货币政策意外因子。
AI.theory_contributions: 将因子旋转问题形式化为正交Procrustes问题，提供了系统性的解决方案，避免了传统方法的主观性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证宏观经济学中PCA因子的解释提供了可靠的方法，提高了因子分析结果的经济意义和可解释性。

title: Cybersecurity Threats, Credit Risk, and the Role of Dual Ownership
affiliations: Texas A&M University

detail.title: Cybersecurity Threats, Credit Risk, and the Role of Dual Ownership
detail.abstract: I study how corporate bond markets price cybersecurity risk. Ex-post, bond prices decline significantly following cyberattacks-especially for junk bonds. Ex-ante, a onestandard deviation increase in cyber risk exposure is associated with a 4.3 basis point rise in bond yield spreads. Firms with higher cyber risk also issue bonds with more issuer restrictive covenants. Ownership structure matters: dual ownership-when the same institution holds both debt and equity-attenuates the risk premium to cyberexposed firms. Using mergers among financial institutions as quasi-exogenous shocks to dual ownership, I find that dual holders reduce firm-level cyber risk and mitigate its pricing in the corporate bond market, but interestingly, not in the equity market. These findings have implications for cybersecurity governance, credit contracting, and SEC disclosure rules, highlighting how financial markets internalize operational risks even in the absence of formal regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究公司债券市场如何对网络安全风险进行定价。研究发现：事后看，网络攻击后债券价格显著下跌，特别是垃圾债券；事前看，网络安全风险暴露每增加一个标准差，债券收益率利差上升4.3个基点。双重所有权结构能降低网络安全风险溢价，且双重持有者能减少企业层面的网络安全风险及其在债券市场的定价，但在股票市场无此效应。
AI.research_question: 公司债券市场如何对网络安全风险进行定价？所有权结构如何影响这种定价？
AI.motivation: 网络安全风险日益成为企业重要的运营风险，但金融市场如何内化这种风险，特别是在债券市场中的定价机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险定价理论、双重所有权理论、公司治理理论
AI.method: 实证研究，使用金融机构合并作为双重所有权的准自然实验
AI.findings: 1.网络攻击后债券价格显著下跌，特别是垃圾债券；2.网络安全风险暴露与债券收益率利差正相关；3.双重所有权能降低网络安全风险溢价；4.双重持有者能减少企业网络安全风险及其在债券市场的定价
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了风险定价理论在网络安全领域的应用，深化了对双重所有权在公司治理中作用的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为网络安全治理、信贷合同设计和SEC披露规则提供了实证依据，揭示了金融市场在缺乏正式监管时如何内化运营风险

title: CSR Performance and Firm Idiosyncratic Risk in a Data-Rich Environment: The Role of Retail Investor Attention
affiliations: Capital University of Economics and Business, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics - School of Public Economics & Administration, Capital University of Economics and Business and University of Hull

detail.title: CSR Performance and Firm Idiosyncratic Risk in a Data-Rich Environment: The Role of Retail Investor Attention

keywords: Chinese financial market JEL code: M14

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions and Money, volume 89, 2023[10.1016/j.intfin.2023.101877]

detail.abstract: In the Chinese stock market, there are many retail investors who focus on short-term profits and may consider corporate social responsibility (CSR) differently from institutional investors. We find that CSR significantly reduces firms' idiosyncratic risk in the Chinese financial market. This result still holds after a series of robustness checks with potential endogeneity concerns. We further test the role of CSR as a nonfinancial informational supplement, the interplay of CSR with stock analyst forecasts and the effect of heterogeneity in corporate governance characteristics. Finally, we find that retail investors' attention mediates the relationship between CSR and firms' idiosyncratic risk. Our results have general implications for understanding the impact of CSR on retail investors.

AI.tldr: 在中国股市中，企业社会责任(CSR)显著降低公司特质性风险，这一关系通过散户投资者关注度中介，且不受分析师预测和公司治理异质性的影响。
AI.research_question: 企业社会责任如何影响中国股市中公司的特质性风险？
AI.motivation: 中国股市存在大量关注短期利润的散户投资者，他们可能与企业社会责任的投资理念存在差异，需要研究CSR在中国特定市场环境下的作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业社会责任理论、信息不对称理论和投资者行为理论，探讨CSR作为非财务信息补充的作用。
AI.method: 采用实证分析方法，进行一系列稳健性检验以解决潜在的内生性问题，并检验中介效应和调节效应。
AI.findings: CSR显著降低公司特质性风险；散户投资者关注度在CSR与特质性风险关系中起中介作用；CSR与分析师预测存在交互作用；公司治理特征的异质性影响CSR效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了CSR在发展中国家市场的理论应用，揭示了散户投资者关注度的中介机制，丰富了CSR与公司风险关系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业制定CSR战略提供实证依据，帮助投资者理解CSR的风险管理价值，为监管机构完善信息披露制度提供参考。

title: Sand in the Wheels: Addressing Runs through Contingent Fees
affiliations: , SKEMA Business School - Université Côte d'Azur and University of Amsterdam - Finance Group

detail.title: Sand in the Wheels: Addressing Runs through Contingent Fees

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The opinions expressed in this paper do not necessarily reflect those of De Nederlandsche Bank.

detail.abstract: We show how escalation of outflows on viable banks can be tempered by automatic stabilizers. The frequency of inefficient runs is reduced by contingent redemption fees. Fee revenues may be retained or used to pay out more withdrawals. When reassigned back to the queue, they reduce strategic uncertainty and improve liquidity allocation, so a high fee is optimal. A 'fee to the unpaid' allocation reduces liquidity provision but reduces run incentives further, allowing lower fees. When liquidity needs are high, the 'fee to the queue' is preferred, whereas when the costs of inefficient runs are high or to limit spillover effects, the 'fee to the unpaid' mechanism proves more effective.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何通过自动稳定机制（如或有赎回费）来抑制对健康银行的挤兑潮。研究发现，将赎回费重新分配给排队中的投资者可以减少战略不确定性并改善流动性分配，因此高费率是最优的。当流动性需求高时，"费用给排队者"机制更优；当无效挤兑成本高或需要限制溢出效应时，"费用给未支付者"机制更有效。
AI.research_question: 如何通过自动稳定机制来抑制对健康银行的挤兑潮？
AI.motivation: 银行挤兑可能导致健康银行倒闭，造成系统性风险，需要有效的稳定机制来防止这种无效的挤兑行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于银行挤兑理论和自动稳定机制理论，研究或有赎回费在抑制挤兑中的作用机制。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，研究不同费用分配机制（费用给排队者 vs 费用给未支付者）对挤兑行为的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 或有赎回费能减少无效挤兑频率；2. 将费用重新分配给排队投资者可减少战略不确定性并改善流动性分配；3. 高费率是最优选择；4. 不同费用分配机制适用于不同情境。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于或有赎回费的自动稳定机制理论框架，深化了对银行挤兑预防机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行和监管机构提供了具体的政策工具设计建议，可根据不同情境选择最优的费用分配机制来抑制挤兑风险。

title: Traffic jams and driver behavior archetypes
affiliations: William Howard Taft University

detail.title: Traffic jams and driver behavior archetypes

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest in the creation of this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: As no human participants were employed (computer simulation), no ethics approval was necessary.
declarations.funderStatement: The author self-funded the research for this paper.

detail.abstract: Traffic congestion represents a complex urban phenomenon that has been the subject of extensive research employing various modeling techniques grounded in the principles of physics and molecular theory. Although factors such as road design, accidents, weather conditions, and construction activities contribute to traffic congestion, driver behavior and decision-making are primary determinants of traffic flow efficiency. This study introduces a driver behavior archetype model that quantifies the relationship between individual driver behavior and system-level traffic outcomes through game-theoretic modeling and simulation (N = 500,000) of a three-lane roadway. Mann-Whitney U tests revealed statistically significant differences across all utility measures (p < .001, d > 2.0). In homogeneous populations, responsible drivers achieved substantially higher expected utility (M =-0.090) than irresponsible drivers (M =-1.470). However, in mixed environments (50/50), irresponsible drivers paradoxically outperformed responsible drivers (M = 0.128 vs. M =-0.127), illustrating a social dilemma wherein defection exploits cooperation. Pairwise comparisons across the six driver archetypes indicated that all irresponsible types achieved equivalent utilities while consistently surpassing responsible drivers. Lane-specific analyses revealed differential capacity patterns, with lane 1 exhibiting a more pronounced cumulative utility decline. These findings offer a robust framework for traffic management interventions, congestion prediction, and policy design that aligns individual incentives with collective efficiency. Directions for future research were also proposed.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过博弈论建模和模拟，开发了一个驾驶员行为原型模型，量化个体驾驶行为与系统级交通结果之间的关系。研究发现，在混合环境中，不负责任的驾驶员反而比负责任的驾驶员获得更高效用，揭示了合作被背叛利用的社会困境。
AI.research_question: 个体驾驶员行为如何影响系统级交通效率？不同行为类型的驾驶员在交通系统中的效用表现如何？
AI.motivation: 交通拥堵是复杂的城市现象，虽然道路设计、事故、天气等因素都影响交通，但驾驶员行为和决策是交通流效率的主要决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于物理学和分子理论原理的建模技术，结合博弈论框架分析驾驶员行为。
AI.method: 采用博弈论建模和模拟方法，在三车道道路上进行大规模模拟（N=500,000），使用Mann-Whitney U检验进行统计显著性分析。
AI.findings: 在同类群体中，负责任驾驶员获得更高期望效用（M=-0.090 vs M=-1.470）；但在混合环境中，不负责任驾驶员反而表现更好（M=0.128 vs M=-0.127），形成社会困境。所有不负责任类型驾驶员效用相当且都优于负责任驾驶员。车道分析显示车道1的累积效用下降更明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了量化个体行为与系统结果关系的理论框架，揭示了交通系统中的社会困境现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通管理干预、拥堵预测和政策设计提供了稳健框架，有助于协调个体激励与集体效率。

title: Experience-Based Pairwise Comparison Dynamics
affiliations: University of Oregon - Department of Economics

detail.title: Experience-Based Pairwise Comparison Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the experience-based payoff comparison dynamics-a deterministic evolutionary process in which each agent, upon having the opportunity to revise her strategy, compares her realized payoff with that of another agent. In a uniformly random pairwise matching environment, this dynamic is markedly more sensitive to the cardinality of the underlying game's payoff structure than standard dynamics based on comparing the expected payoffs of different strategies. This heightened sensitivity yields equilibrium selection results in coordination games without the long waiting times typical of stochastic stability models. We further show that the strictly dominated strategy in the prisoner's dilemma can survive.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种基于经验的收益比较动态过程，该过程在协调博弈中能更快地实现均衡选择，且在囚徒困境中允许严格劣势策略存活。
AI.research_question: 基于经验的收益比较动态过程在博弈中如何影响均衡选择和行为结果？
AI.motivation: 传统基于期望收益比较的动态过程对博弈收益结构的基数性不敏感，而实际决策往往基于经验比较而非期望计算。
AI.theoretical_framework: 进化博弈理论、随机稳定性理论、经验学习模型
AI.method: 确定性进化过程建模，在均匀随机配对环境中分析策略修订动态
AI.findings: 1) 该动态对博弈收益结构的基数性更敏感；2) 在协调博弈中能快速实现均衡选择；3) 囚徒困境中的严格劣势策略可能存活
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了对收益基数性更敏感的进化动态模型，挑战了传统随机稳定性模型的假设
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实世界中基于经验比较的决策行为提供了理论框架

title: Backcasting: A Design Thinking Approach to Creating Transformative Futures.
affiliations: Mohammed Bin Rashid School of Government and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Backcasting: A Design Thinking Approach to Creating Transformative Futures.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract:
Backcasting is the process of shaping events to a preferred future. It has five stages: future horizon, present

horizon, push and pull factors, anchor policies, and impact & early warning signals. It uses four iterative processes: imagination, scoping, boundary setting, and assessment, shifting frames from narrow to wide. Backcasting shapes the path toward a preferred future. In a continuous process, listing assumptions and

reflecting on impact (using them as early warning flags) allows backcasters to track future trajectories. It is not a simple exercise; it challenges the policymakers to confront their preconceived notions and hubris. This confrontation is critical as the future is not set in stone and also because the impacts of policy

performance often is a perception of public value delivered.

AI.tldr: 回溯法是通过五个阶段（未来视野、现在视野、推动与拉动因素、锚定政策、影响与早期预警信号）和四个迭代过程（想象、范围界定、边界设定、评估）来塑造通往理想未来路径的方法论。
AI.research_question: 回溯法如何帮助政策制定者塑造通往理想未来的路径？
AI.motivation: 传统预测方法无法有效应对未来不确定性，需要一种能够挑战政策制定者固有观念和傲慢的方法来塑造更理想的未来。
AI.theoretical_framework: 回溯法理论框架，包含五个阶段和四个迭代过程，强调从狭窄到宽泛的框架转换。
AI.method: 采用回溯法的五个阶段和四个迭代过程，通过列出假设和反思影响来追踪未来轨迹。
AI.findings: 回溯法能够有效挑战政策制定者的先入之见，通过持续评估假设和影响来调整未来路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了回溯法的系统理论框架，明确了其在政策制定中的方法论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实用的工具来应对未来不确定性，通过早期预警信号及时调整政策方向。

title: Optimal Privacy Protection in Central Bank Digital Currency
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - School of International Trade and Economics, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Industrial Bank Co. and Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - School of International Trade and Economics

detail.title: Optimal Privacy Protection in Central Bank Digital Currency

declarations.funderStatement: Yang acknowledges the financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant No. 72403265), the 75th batch of the General Program of CPSF (Grant No. 2024M753813), and the financial support from the National Social Science Fund of China (Grant No. 24\&ZD053).

detail.abstract: This paper develops a model that incorporates cash, existing digital payments, and central bank digital currency (CBDC), explicitly capturing their differences and interactions. Within this framework, we examine consumers’ payment choices under heterogeneous privacy preferences and analyze the optimal design of CBDC privacy protection. Because consumer privacy must be balanced against the commercial value of payment data, social welfare exhibits an inverted-U relationship with the level of CBDC privacy protection. The cost of using cash, the convenience of existing digital payments, and the fixed per-transaction benefit to digital payment firms increase the optimal level of CBDC privacy protection, whereas the effect of CBDC convenience on this level is ambiguous. The number of CBDC users increases with the cost of using cash and with CBDC convenience but decreases with the convenience of existing digital payments, while whether this number increases with the fixed per-transaction benefit or not is indeterminate. Furthermore, CBDC adoption lowers the user base and profits of existing digital payment firms, yet raises social welfare because it better accommodates heterogeneous privacy preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含现金、现有数字支付和央行数字货币(CBDC)的模型，分析消费者在异质隐私偏好下的支付选择，并研究CBDC隐私保护的最优设计。研究发现社会福利与CBDC隐私保护水平呈倒U型关系，CBDC采用会降低现有数字支付企业的用户基础和利润，但能提高社会福利。
AI.research_question: 在异质隐私偏好下，消费者如何选择支付方式？CBDC隐私保护的最优设计是什么？
AI.motivation: 需要理解现金、现有数字支付和CBDC之间的差异和互动，以及如何平衡消费者隐私与支付数据的商业价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建包含现金、现有数字支付和CBDC的支付选择模型，考虑异质隐私偏好和隐私保护水平。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，在框架内考察消费者支付选择、CBDC隐私保护最优设计及其影响因素。
AI.findings: 社会福利与CBDC隐私保护水平呈倒U型关系；现金使用成本、现有数字支付便利性等因素影响最优隐私保护水平；CBDC采用会降低现有数字支付企业利润但提高社会福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在统一框架内分析现金、现有数字支付和CBDC的互动关系，为CBDC隐私保护设计提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行设计CBDC隐私保护政策提供指导，帮助平衡消费者隐私与商业价值，提高社会福利。

title: Heterogeneous Predictability on Mutual Fund Alphas: A Sparse Clustering GMM Approach
affiliations: City University of Hong Kong, City University of Hong Kong (CityU) and City University of Hong Kong (CityU) - Department of Economics & Finance

detail.title: Heterogeneous Predictability on Mutual Fund Alphas: A Sparse Clustering GMM Approach
detail.abstract: Mutual fund managers' skills, measured by risk-adjusted alphas, are predictable using fund characteristics identified via machine learning (e.g., Kaniel et al., 2023, JFE; DeMiguel et al., 2023, JFE). However, alpha's predictive power varies across funds and periods, with most funds exhibiting negligible alphas. To model the heterogeneous predictability, this paper introduces Sparse Clustering GMM (SCGMM), a nonparametric approach to uncover latent fund group structures. SCGMM clusters funds using estimated alphas and identifies group-specific parameters tied to market predictors. The method accounts for heterogeneity in cross-sectional grouping and time variation mechanisms across predictors, without requiring prior cluster information or time variation specifications. Our proposed estimator is theoretically grounded, ensuring consistency in grouping and estimation of time-varying parameters. Empirical analysis of U.S. data shows that only a small group of mutual funds exhibit alphas predictably driven by market predictors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了稀疏聚类GMM方法，用于识别共同基金中alpha预测能力的异质性，发现只有少数基金组的alpha可被市场预测因子有效预测。
AI.research_question: 如何建模共同基金alpha预测能力的异质性？
AI.motivation: 虽然机器学习方法可以预测基金经风险调整后的alpha，但alpha的预测能力在不同基金和时期存在显著差异，且大多数基金的alpha预测能力可以忽略不计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稀疏聚类GMM（SCGMM）方法，这是一种非参数方法来揭示潜在的基金组结构。
AI.method: SCGMM使用估计的alpha对基金进行聚类，并识别与市场预测因子相关的组特定参数。该方法考虑了横截面分组和时间变化机制的异质性，无需先验聚类信息或时间变化规范。
AI.findings: 对美国数据的实证分析表明，只有一小部分共同基金表现出可被市场预测因子驱动的可预测alpha。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了理论上可靠的估计器，确保分组和时间变化参数估计的一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资实践提供了识别具有可预测alpha的基金组的方法，有助于改进基金选择和投资决策。

title: Household Wealth and Gray Divorce in the United States

detail.title: Household Wealth and Gray Divorce in the United States
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how changes in household wealth affect the likelihood of divorce among older adults aged 50 and above in the United States. Using panel data from the Health and Retirement Study from 1992 to 2018, I first establish a descriptive non-linear relationship between wealth, and divorce probabilities. The likelihood is higher for lower levels of wealth and monotonically declines, but only upto the median-beyond that it remains fairly flat. Extreme changes in wealth, both positive and negative, are associated with higher probability of divorce, as compared to moderate changes. To estimate the causal effects, I use two separate plausibly exogenous shocks to wealth, one from the stock market and the other from the housing market. A $10,000 predicted increase in real wealth driven by the S&P 500 contemporaneously raises divorce chances by 262%, marginally significant with a p-value of 0.06. A similar sized lagged housing market driven wealth increase also boosts divorce likelihood by 300%, significant at 1%. I find little evidence of a non-monotonic effect of these wealth shocks on divorce. These findings contribute to research on late-life divorce determinants and expand analysis of how wealth shocks shape well-being over the life cycle. The results have implications for policies targeting asset fluctuations among older households.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国家庭财富变化对50岁以上老年人离婚概率的影响，发现财富与离婚概率呈非线性关系，极端财富变化（无论正负）都会增加离婚风险。使用股市和房市外生冲击进行因果推断，发现财富增加显著提高离婚概率。
AI.research_question: 家庭财富变化如何影响美国50岁以上老年人的离婚概率？
AI.motivation: 研究晚年离婚的决定因素，分析财富冲击如何在整个生命周期中影响幸福感
AI.theoretical_framework: 财富与离婚关系的非线性理论，财富冲击对家庭稳定性的影响机制
AI.method: 使用1992-2018年健康与退休研究的追踪数据，采用股市（S&P 500）和房市外生冲击作为工具变量进行因果推断
AI.findings: 1. 财富与离婚概率呈非线性关系：低财富水平离婚概率较高，中位数以上趋于平稳；2. 极端财富变化（正负）均增加离婚风险；3. 股市驱动的1万美元财富增加使离婚概率上升262%；4. 房市驱动的财富增加使离婚概率上升300%

title: Why Bankruptcy Will Keep Eating Mass Torts
affiliations: City University of New York (CUNY) - Department of Law

detail.title: Why Bankruptcy Will Keep Eating Mass Torts

declarations.declarationOfInterest: An entity affiliated with the author's immediate family filed a proof of claim in Rite Aid's bankruptcy, and the author assisted in these efforts.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
Mass tort cases have increasingly migrated to bankruptcy, grabbing headlines and generating controversy. Yet criticism from scholars, courts, and the public could suggest this exodus may be inappropriate and short-lived. This Article argues that this pessimism is misplaced. Instead, bankruptcy’s attraction will survive the Supreme Court’s recent elimination of nonconsensual releases that offer immunity for nondebtors, or limits on divisional mergers that separate assets from liabilities prior to a bankruptcy filing. Tortfeasors value bankruptcy’s jurisdictional reach, negotiating leverage, and permissive institutional environment, and will innovate to sidestep these new constraints. Paraphrasing venture capitalist Marc Andreessen’s view that software will supplant entire industries and thus “eat[] the world,” bankruptcy will keep eating mass torts.

Several underexamined cases illustrate how companies can adapt bankruptcy to allocate liabilities, cap payments, and coerce releases from creditors. In Johnson & Johnson’s third bankruptcy, a divide-and-conquer strategy facilitated near-global settlements and releases for itself and its customers. In Rite Aid’s bankruptcy, secured debt (rather than a divisional merger) cut assets from the grasp of opioid victims, enabling cheap settlements and broad releases. Finally, in Tehum’s bankruptcy, insiders separated assets from liabilities and used other troubling maneuvers to obtain releases while shortchanging tort victims. These show that without nonconsensual releases, debtors will coerce “consent,” while a ban on divisional mergers will not stop them from removing assets from creditors.

Despite the troubling aspects of these cases, this Article argues that mass tort bankruptcies can still be beneficial because they can preserve going-concern value, increase recoveries for individuals, and avoid the uneven recoveries of the tort system. Many of the problems they pose exist regardless of whether nonconsensual nondebtor releases or divisional mergers are permitted. Targeted reforms or better enforcement of existing law can address the most egregious aspects of these cases. And such reforms are needed because bankruptcy will continue to eat mass torts.

AI.tldr: 本文认为破产法将继续在集体侵权案件中发挥重要作用，尽管最高法院限制了非债务人免责和资产分割合并。侵权者看重破产法的管辖权、谈判杠杆和制度环境，并将创新规避新限制。通过强生、Rite Aid和Tehum等案例显示，即使没有非同意免责，债务人仍会强制"同意"，而禁止资产分割合并也不会阻止他们转移资产。
AI.research_question: 破产法是否将继续在集体侵权案件中发挥重要作用？侵权者如何适应最高法院对非债务人免责和资产分割合并的限制？
AI.motivation: 集体侵权案件越来越多地转向破产程序，引发学者、法院和公众的批评，认为这种趋势可能不合适且短暂。本文旨在反驳这种悲观观点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于破产法的制度优势理论，包括管辖权范围、谈判杠杆和宽松的制度环境。借鉴Marc Andreessen的"软件吞噬世界"观点，提出"破产法将吞噬集体侵权"的论点。
AI.method: 案例分析法，通过强生第三次破产、Rite Aid破产和Tehum破产三个案例，展示企业如何适应破产程序来分配责任、限制支付和强制债权人同意免责。
AI.findings: 侵权者会创新规避最高法院的限制：即使没有非同意免责，债务人会强制"同意"；禁止资产分割合并不会阻止资产转移；企业使用担保债务等其他方式隔离资产。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了对破产法在集体侵权案件中作用持悲观态度的观点；提出了"破产法吞噬集体侵权"的理论框架；揭示了侵权者适应法律限制的创新策略。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供改革建议：需要针对性改革或更好执行现有法律来解决最严重问题；承认破产程序在保存持续经营价值、提高个人赔偿和避免侵权系统不均衡赔偿方面的益处。

detail.abstract: Much is at stake for the UK’s creative industries and cultural heritage sector, including significant gains. We see a crucial opportunity to encourage research and innovation, support the digital transformation of the cultural sector, protect the livelihoods of living creators and our vibrant creative industries, and produce high-quality data for AI development. Our response focuses on the potential of these public domain materials for the development of world-leading AI models and new creative frontiers.

title: National Security Agencies and National Security in Nigeria
affiliations: University of Calabar, Calabar, Nigeria, University of Calabar (UNICAL), University of Calabar and University of Calabar (UNICAL)

detail.title: National Security Agencies and National Security in Nigeria
detail.abstract: One of the top concerns of nations is national security The Nigerian nation is facing several security issues, from farmer-herder clashes to terrorism, armed banditry, among others. Numerous national security agencies, including the Nigerian Army, Navy, Air Force, Nigeria Police Force, Department of State Services (DSS), and Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC), work together to create a well-coordinated and effective security architecture in response to these complex threats. The function, organisation, coordination, and efficacy of Nigeria's national security services in preserving national security are all examined in this article. Based on theoretical frameworks including the Human Security Paradigm, Systems Theory, and the Realist Theory of State Security, the paper examines how the success of national security plans is influenced by the interplay of institutional capabilities, political will, interagency cooperation, intelligence collection, and community participation. The paper also examines the effects, on the security sector, of interagency rivalry, corruption, poor governance, and outside influences. In order to achieve a safe Nigeria, the necessity of inclusive governance, intelligence-led policing, and security sector reform (SSR) is also emphasized. Within the larger framework of national growth and democratic consolidation, the study adds to the conversation about sustainable security in Nigeria.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了尼日利亚国家安全机构在应对复杂安全威胁时的功能、组织和协调机制，探讨了制度能力、政治意愿、机构间合作等因素对国家安全战略成效的影响，并强调了安全部门改革的重要性。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Asian Economic Policy Review, 0[10.1111/aepr.70005]

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of green bond issuance on the yield spreads of conventional bonds in China. Using a sample of 1,468 corporate bonds and a difference-in-differences methodology, we document a significantly persistent reduction of 21 basis points in the yield spreads of existing conventional bonds after the green bond issuance. Our findings support a risk-based explanation: green bond issuance mitigates the environmental regulatory risks faced by the issuer, thereby reducing the perceived default risk of its conventional bonds. These results highlight the broader financial implications of green bond issuance, extending beyond the direct environmental benefits to influence the pricing and risk profile of conventional debt instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在中国，绿色债券发行会显著降低现有常规债券的收益率利差约21个基点，这种效应具有持续性。研究支持风险解释：绿色债券发行减轻了发行人的环境监管风险，从而降低了其常规债券的感知违约风险。
AI.research_question: 绿色债券发行对常规债券收益率利差有何影响？

AI.findings: 绿色债券发行后，现有常规债券的收益率利差显著且持续降低21个基点
AI.theory_contributions: 从风险角度解释绿色债券对常规债券定价的影响机制，丰富了绿色金融理论

title: Are Women with Disabilities More at Risk of Intimate Partner Violence?
affiliations: Stevens Institute of Technology, Fordham University - Fordham College at Rose Hill and Fordham University

detail.title: Are Women with Disabilities More at Risk of Intimate Partner Violence?
detail.abstract: Women with disabilities may face heightened risks of intimate partner violence (IPV) given the discrimination and barriers they face in society. While some country-specific studies explore the link between disability and IPV, cross-country research remains limited. Using internationally comparable data for women aged 15–49 from eleven countries (Cambodia, Haiti, Kenya, Mali, Mauritania, Pakistan, Rwanda, Senegal, South Africa, Timor-Leste, and Uganda), we assess whether women with disabilities consistently face higher IPV risks. Controlling for socioeconomic and demographic factors, women with disabilities have a 6-percentage-point higher risk of IPV compared to those without (P < .05) in the pooled sample. At the country level, this association is significant in five countries. The link between disability and IPV also varies by type, with stronger associations for severe physical IPV (seven countries) and weaker associations for sexual IPV (two countries). Logit decomposition analysis in the five countries where the disability gap in exposure to IPV is significant shows that observed differences in characteristics account for part of the gap. However, unobserved factors, such as stigma, also play a significant role in driving the disparity. Additionally, our results suggest that the lack of consistent findings across countries may result from data limitations, such as small sample sizes, measurement errors, and reporting biases. This underscores the importance of developing evidence-based approaches to better measure disability and IPV in household surveys.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用11个国家的数据发现，残疾女性遭受亲密伴侣暴力的风险比非残疾女性高6个百分点，这种关联在5个国家显著，且因暴力类型而异。未观察到的因素如污名化是导致差异的重要原因。
AI.research_question: 残疾女性是否面临更高的亲密伴侣暴力风险？这种关联在不同国家和不同类型的暴力中是否一致？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于残疾女性面临社会歧视和障碍的理论框架，探讨残疾与亲密伴侣暴力的关联机制。
AI.method: 使用11个国家的国际可比数据，采用控制社会经济和人口因素的回归分析，以及logit分解分析。
AI.findings: 残疾女性亲密伴侣暴力风险高6个百分点；在5个国家显著；严重身体暴力关联更强（7国），性暴力关联较弱（2国）；未观察因素如污名化是重要驱动因素。

title: A century of economics: trends with metagraphs
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Turin

detail.title: A century of economics: trends with metagraphs

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.

detail.abstract: This study provides a synthesis of the most relevant academic economic output over more than a century using text mining algorithms. We study key topics in six fields (development economics, international economics, labor economics, macroeconomics, microeconomics, public economics) through Natural Language Processing and statistical techniques using data extracted from the abstracts of papers published in the top 20 economic journals. We provide for each field a ranking of topics, a conceptual metagraph to show how these topics are related to each other, and a measure of the centrality of these topics to see how they have evolved over time. We find that among the most important recurring topics in economics are development and growth, equilibrium, human capital, labor market, monetary policy, and empirical evidence. There is also a clear predominance of studies related to the United States compared to other countries. These results are of interest to economists and policymakers alike, as they shed light on the current state of economics and future research prospects.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用文本挖掘算法对超过一个世纪的经济学学术产出进行综合分析，通过自然语言处理技术分析顶级经济期刊摘要，识别各经济学领域的核心话题及其演变。
AI.research_question: 经济学各领域的关键话题是什么？这些话题如何相互关联？它们随时间如何演变？
AI.motivation: 通过系统分析经济学文献，了解该学科的核心关注点和研究趋势，为经济学家和政策制定者提供学科现状和未来研究方向的洞察。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于文本挖掘和自然语言处理的理论框架，结合网络分析构建概念元图来展示话题关联性。
AI.method: 使用自然语言处理和统计技术，分析发表在20个顶级经济期刊论文摘要的数据，涵盖发展经济学、国际经济学、劳动经济学、宏观经济学、微观经济学、公共经济学六个领域。
AI.findings: 经济学中最重要且反复出现的主题包括发展与增长、均衡、人力资本、劳动力市场、货币政策和实证证据；与美国相关的研究明显多于其他国家。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了经济学各领域话题的系统性排名和概念关系图，揭示了话题的中心性及其随时间演变规律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学家和政策制定者提供了经济学研究现状的全面视图，有助于识别研究空白和未来研究方向。

title: Small Concept Models: A Specialized Framework for Legal AI in Hispanic-American Jurisdictions

detail.title: Small Concept Models: A Specialized Framework for Legal AI in Hispanic-American Jurisdictions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently without external funding, commercial relationships, or institutional affiliations that could influence the study's design, execution, or conclusions. The trademark application for pAIr Review™ methodology (INPI Argentina) represents a methodological innovation disclosed in the paper and does not constitute a commercial conflict. The open-source nature of all implementations (GitHub repository) ensures transparency and independent validation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human subjects and required no formal ethics approval. The study employed technical implementation, computational analysis, and evaluation against publicly available legal materials. No human participants, personal data collection, or confidential information were involved in the research protocol.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was conducted independently by the author using personal resources and open-source tools. The absence of external funding ensured complete independence in research design, methodology selection, and interpretation of results.

detail.abstract: Recent empirical research from Harvard Law School has documented systematic failures of Large Language Models (LLMs) in legal interpretation tasks, revealing fundamental incompatibilities between general-purpose AI systems and the requirements of professional legal practice. This paper proposes Small Concept Models (SCM) as a specialized alternative framework designed specifically for Hispanic-American legal applications. Unlike general purpose LLMs trained on massive unfiltered corpora, SCM employs domain-specific legal ontologies, multi-jurisdictional knowledge bases, and transparent methodological frameworks. Our implementation demonstrates that specialized legal AI can achieve appropriate performance levels (67% accuracy ± 8%) while maintaining the transparency, consistency, and accountability standards required by the legal profession. The framework incorporates comprehensive anti-bias measures, explicit limitation documentation, and professional integration protocols designed to complement rather than replace human expertise. I argue that the future of trustworthy legal AI lies not in ever-larger general purpose models but in carefully crafted, domain-specialized systems that respect the unique epistemological and methodological requirements of legal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出小型概念模型(SCM)作为专门针对西班牙裔美国法律应用的专业化替代框架，相比通用大语言模型在透明度、一致性和问责制方面表现更好。
AI.research_question: 如何开发专门针对西班牙裔美国法律应用的专业化AI系统，以解决通用大语言模型在法律解释任务中的系统性失败问题？

AI.theoretical_framework: 小型概念模型(SCM)框架，基于领域特定的法律本体论、多司法管辖区知识库和透明的方法论框架。
AI.method: 采用领域特定的法律本体论、多司法管辖区知识库和透明的方法论框架来构建专门的法律AI系统。
AI.findings: 专业化法律AI可以达到适当的性能水平(67%准确率±8%)，同时保持法律职业所需的透明度、一致性和问责标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了小型概念模型(SCM)作为通用大语言模型的专门化替代方案，强调领域专业化系统对法律推理的独特认识论和方法论要求的尊重。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了包含全面反偏见措施、明确限制文档和专业整合协议的框架，旨在补充而非取代人类专业知识，为可信赖法律AI的未来发展提供了实践路径。

title: A Six-Question Guide to Climate Transition Plans

detail.title: A Six-Question Guide to Climate Transition Plans
detail.abstract: The transition to a climate-neutral economy requires companies to fundamentally rethink their strategies, operations, and business models. Climate transition plans (CTPs) are emerging as a key legal and governance tool to structure this process. CTPs are not merely a compliance issue for legal departments; they require engagement across the corporate organisation, as well as with external stakeholders and public authorities. Existing literature on CTPs is often either overly general or highly technical, making it difficult to grasp the multifaceted challenges involved. This six-question guide aims to fill that gap by offering a clear and structured introduction to the key concepts, requirements, and dilemmas surrounding CTPs. It does so by addressing six basic questions: which companies must adopt CTPs, what content they should contain, how they should be assessed for 1.5°C alignment, what actions companies must take, how compliance can be monitored and enforced, and what broader benefits climate transition planning may bring. The guide uses Article 22 CSDDD as its main point of reference, while also drawing on other legal regimes and interdisciplinary perspectives. It serves both as an entry point for newcomers and a reference for specialists navigating the evolving CTP landscape.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一个关于气候转型计划（CTPs）的六问题指南，帮助企业理解这一关键法律和治理工具，涵盖采用要求、内容规范、1.5°C对齐评估、必要行动、合规监控以及更广泛效益等方面。
AI.research_question: 如何为企业提供清晰的结构化指南来理解和实施气候转型计划（CTPs）？
AI.motivation: 现有关于CTPs的文献要么过于笼统，要么过于技术化，难以把握其中涉及的多方面挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以《企业可持续发展尽职调查指令》（CSDDD）第22条为主要参考，同时借鉴其他法律制度和跨学科视角。
AI.method: 通过回答六个基本问题来构建指南：哪些公司必须采用CTPs、应包含什么内容、如何评估1.5°C对齐、公司必须采取什么行动、如何监控和执行合规性、气候转型规划可能带来哪些更广泛效益。
AI.findings: 开发了一个清晰的结构化指南，可作为新手的入门点和专家在不断发展变化的CTP领域中的参考。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了现有文献的空白，提供了理解CTPs多层面挑战的实用框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了实施气候转型计划的具体指导，帮助公司应对向气候中性经济转型的战略和运营挑战。

title: Number Two Executives: Bottom-up Monitoring
affiliations: University of Western Ontario - Ivey School of Business

detail.title: Number Two Executives: Bottom-up Monitoring

publicationDetails.detailsText: Li, Z.F. 2025. Number Two Executives: Bottom-up Monitoring. Journal of Business Finance & Accounting 52(4):2037-2061.

detail.abstract: This paper empirically examines the role of a firm's second-in-command in monitoring the CEO from the bottom up to mitigate agency problems. While CEOs have long been the focus, little research has addressed the No. 2 executive. This study provides a comprehensive understanding of these top executives and their roles in bottom-up monitoring. The results suggest that (1) bottom-up monitoring by No. 2 executives enhances firm value, (2) the effect is stronger in firms with weak corporate governance or poor CEO incentive alignment, (3) the effect is weaker when the No. 2 is promoted internally or lacks experience, and (4) such monitoring becomes more critical in the post-SOX regulatory environment. Further analysis reveals that bottom-up monitoring creates firm value by fostering a more transparent information environment, increasing CEO turnover-performance sensitivity, and reducing the CEO's ability to pursue the "quiet life," but has no effect on "empire building.
