title: Labour Scarcity and Colonial Labour Strategies (and the Africans’ Response) in German East Africa, 1885–1914

detail.title: Labour Scarcity and Colonial Labour Strategies (and the Africans’ Response) in German East Africa, 1885–1914
detail.abstract: the worldwide history of labour has recently garnered heightened interest, examining previously overlooked areas of employment and the key figures in labour. However, some facets of labour in colonial German east africa remain obscure. this paper discusses labour demand, africans' responses, and the changing mobilization strategies in German east africa, 1885-1914. With evidence from existing literature and a collection of primary historical sources, this paper argues that German labour mobilization strategies were informed by their unrealistic theories of readily available african labour in large numbers to serve in colonial enterprises. on the contrary, there was a persistent labour problem due to africans' reluctance to work for them. Unexpected african responses to labour questions influenced the changing nature of colonial labour organization strategies. Hence, the plans range from economic and political strategy to coercive means. the paper concludes that, despite the strategies to ensure labour availability, the labour question continued to be the field where the most significant interests of the colonizers and the colonized confronted one another throughout German rule in tanganyika.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了1885-1914年德国东非殖民地的劳动力动员策略，指出德国殖民者基于不切实际的劳动力供应理论，但面临非洲人拒绝为其工作的持续劳动力问题，导致殖民策略从经济政治手段转向强制手段。
AI.research_question: 德国东非殖民地（1885-1914）的劳动力需求、非洲人回应以及劳动力动员策略的变化是什么？
AI.motivation: 全球劳工史研究日益受到关注，但德国东非殖民地的劳工问题仍有待深入探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 殖民劳动力动员理论、殖民者与被殖民者利益冲突理论
AI.method: 基于现有文献和一手历史资料的分析
AI.findings: 德国殖民者的劳动力动员策略基于不切实际的非洲劳动力供应理论；非洲人普遍拒绝为殖民者工作；非洲人的意外回应影响了殖民劳动力组织策略的变化；策略从经济政治手段转向强制手段
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了殖民劳动力动员策略的动态变化过程；深化了对殖民者与被殖民者利益冲突的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解殖民统治下的劳工关系提供了历史案例；对研究殖民经济体系具有参考价值

title: Peace Talk and Conflict Traps
affiliations: and Ecole Polytechnique

detail.title: Peace Talk and Conflict Traps
detail.abstract: Costly pre-play messages can deter unnecessary wars-but the same messages can also entrench stalemates once violence begins. We develop an overlapping-generations model of a security dilemma with persistent group types (normal vs. bad), one-sided private signaling by the current old to the current young, and noisy private memory of the last encounter. We characterize a stationary equilibrium in which, for an intermediate band of signal costs, normal old agents mix on sending a costly reassurance only after an alarming private history; the signal is kept marginally persuasive by endogenous receiver cutoffs and strategic mimicking by bad types. Signaling strictly reduces the hazard of conflict onset; conditional on onset, duration is unchanged in the private model but increases once a small probability of publicity (leaks) creates a public record of failed reconciliation. With publicity, play generically absorbs in a peace trap or a conflict trap. We discuss welfare and policy: when to prefer back-channels versus public pledges.

AI.tldr: 成本高昂的事前信号可以阻止不必要的战争，但一旦暴力开始，这些信号也会加深僵局。我们开发了一个安全困境的代际模型，包含持久群体类型（正常vs恶劣）、当前老年群体向当前年轻群体的单边私人信号传递，以及上次遭遇的嘈杂私人记忆。
AI.research_question: 成本高昂的事前信号如何影响冲突的发生和持续时间？
AI.motivation: 理解事前信号在安全困境中的双重作用：既能阻止不必要的战争，又可能在暴力开始后加深僵局
AI.theoretical_framework: 安全困境的代际模型，包含持久群体类型、单边私人信号传递和嘈杂私人记忆
AI.method: 开发重叠代际模型，分析正常和恶劣类型群体的信号传递策略，考察信号成本对冲突动态的影响
AI.findings: 在中等信号成本范围内，正常老年代理人会在经历令人担忧的私人历史后混合发送成本高昂的安抚信号；信号通过内生的接收者临界点和恶劣类型的策略性模仿保持边际说服力；信号传递严格降低了冲突发生的风险；在私人模型中，冲突持续时间不变，但一旦存在公开性（泄露）概率，持续时间会增加
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了安全困境中事前信号传递的正式模型，揭示了信号在冲突预防和僵局加深中的双重作用，提出了和平陷阱和冲突陷阱的概念
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于何时偏好秘密渠道与公开承诺的指导，有助于理解国际关系中信号传递策略的复杂影响

title: Geopolitical Chess in South and Southeast Asia: US China Rivalry and the Cost of Regional Instability
affiliations: Siloam Mission

detail.title: Geopolitical Chess in South and Southeast Asia: US China Rivalry and the Cost of Regional Instability
detail.abstract: This comprehensive analysis examines the intensifying geopolitical competition between the United States and China across South and Southeast Asia, fundamentally reshaping global power dynamics in the 21st century. The study investigates how these superpowers navigate complex regional crises, identifies the primary beneficiaries of regional instability, and evaluates the implications for regional and global security. Drawing from extensive data through October 2025, the research reveals that China emerges as the primary strategic beneficiary of regional chaos through sophisticated exploitation of instability while the United States faces significant challenges in promoting democratic governance and maintaining influence. The analysis demonstrates that regional conflicts create opportunities for China to advance infrastructure projects, secure better investment terms, and divert Indian military resources from disputed borders. Meanwhile, various local actors-including ethnic armed organizations, criminal networks, and authoritarian regimes-profit from continued instability, creating stakeholders in perpetual conflict rather than peace. The study concludes that managing US China competition constructively while addressing transnational challenges requires sophisticated frameworks that preserve space for regional agency and promote cooperative solutions to shared security threats.

AI.tldr: 本文分析美中在南亚和东南亚的地缘政治竞争，发现中国是区域不稳定的主要战略受益者，通过利用混乱推进基础设施项目和投资，而美国在推广民主治理方面面临挑战。
AI.research_question: 美中在南亚和东南亚的地缘政治竞争中如何应对区域危机？谁是区域不稳定的主要受益者？这对区域和全球安全有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究美中竞争如何重塑21世纪全球权力动态，以及这种竞争对区域安全的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治竞争理论、区域安全理论、大国博弈理论
AI.method: 基于截至2025年10月的广泛数据分析
AI.findings: 中国是区域混乱的主要战略受益者，通过利用不稳定推进基础设施项目、获得更优投资条件并分散印度军事资源；各种地方行为体也从持续不稳定中获利；美国在推广民主治理和维护影响力方面面临重大挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对大国在区域危机中战略行为模式的理解，提出了区域不稳定如何被战略利用的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了管理美中竞争的建设性框架，强调需要保留区域自主性空间并促进对共同安全威胁的合作解决方案。

title: Common Risk Exposures of Bond Funds

detail.title: Common Risk Exposures of Bond Funds
detail.abstract: Active returns of bond funds across the US, Global, and Euro regions show strong comovement, driven by shared exposures to common risk factors. This behavior is most pronounced for Aggregate and Corporate bond funds and largely explained by negative exposure to duration risk and positive exposure to credit risk. This is consistent with funds structurally underweighting government bonds or high-grade credits and overweighting more risky, higher-yielding credits. Exposure to common factor risk is highly correlated with active risk levels and also explains over half of the cross-sectional variation in mean active returns. These findings are mostly driven by the funds with high active risk levels. Other factors investigated offer limited incremental explanatory power. High Yield funds diverge by exhibiting reduced exposure to credit risk compared to their benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 美国、全球和欧元区债券基金的主动回报表现出强烈的联动性，主要由对共同风险因子的共同敞口驱动。这种联动性在综合债券基金和公司债券基金中最为明显，很大程度上可以通过对久期风险的负敞口和对信用风险的正敞口来解释。
AI.research_question: 债券基金主动回报的联动性是由什么因素驱动的？不同风险水平的基金在因子敞口方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解债券基金主动回报的联动性及其驱动因素，有助于投资者更好地评估基金风险和构建投资组合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险因子模型，特别是久期风险和信用风险因子，来解释债券基金的主动回报联动性。
AI.method: 分析美国、全球和欧元区债券基金的主动回报数据，研究其对共同风险因子的敞口，并评估这些因子对主动回报变异的解释能力。
AI.findings: 债券基金主动回报的联动性主要由对久期风险的负敞口和对信用风险的正敞口驱动；高主动风险水平的基金对共同因子风险的敞口更大；高收益债券基金在信用风险敞口方面与其他基金表现不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对债券基金主动回报联动性的理解，强调了共同风险因子在解释跨区域债券基金回报联动中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了评估债券基金风险和构建多样化投资组合的实用框架，特别关注高主动风险基金的风险特征。

title: Accrual Accounting in the Public Sector: A Systematic Thematic Review
affiliations: Cenderawasih University

detail.title: Accrual Accounting in the Public Sector: A Systematic Thematic Review
detail.abstract: This article presents a systematic thematic review of the global literature on accrual accounting in the public sector. While accrual accounting is promoted for its potential to enhance transparency, accountability, and fiscal comparability, its implementation across jurisdictions reveals a landscape of complexity, variation, and persistent challenges. The review synthesizes recent academic research and organizes the findings into four core themes: (1) implementation and institutional context, (2) technical and resource challenges, (3) measurement, reporting, and decision-making, and (4) risk, integrity, and system resilience. Evidence shows that adoption is shaped by national legal frameworks, administrative traditions, and political environments, with no single pathway to reform. Technical and human resource constraints, educational gaps, and IT limitations frequently hinder effective implementation and sustainability. Furthermore, issues related to reporting complexity, lack of standardization, and conceptual frameworks limit the practical utility of accrual information for decision-making and public accountability. Risks such as earnings management, reconciliation difficulties, and crisis-induced vulnerabilities are also identified. The review concludes that while accrual accounting offers substantial promise for public sector financial management, realizing its full benefits requires holistic reform strategies, ongoing capacity-building, and adaptive governance tailored to each context.

AI.tldr: 本文对公共部门权责发生制会计的全球文献进行了系统性主题回顾，发现虽然权责发生制会计被推广用于提高透明度、问责制和财政可比性，但其实施在不同司法管辖区呈现出复杂性、变异性和持续挑战。
AI.research_question: 公共部门权责发生制会计在全球范围内的实施状况、挑战和效果如何？
AI.motivation: 权责发生制会计在公共部门被广泛推广，但其实际实施效果和面临的挑战需要系统性评估，以为改革提供指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共部门会计改革理论、制度理论、治理理论
AI.method: 系统性主题文献回顾方法
AI.findings: 1) 实施受国家法律框架、行政传统和政治环境影响；2) 技术和人力资源约束、教育差距和IT限制阻碍有效实施；3) 报告复杂性、缺乏标准化和概念框架限制决策效用；4) 存在盈余管理、对账困难和危机脆弱性等风险
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了公共部门权责发生制会计实施的综合分析框架，识别了四个核心主题维度
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实施权责发生制会计的实践指导，强调需要整体改革策略、持续能力建设和适应性治理

title: The Political Economy of Automation and Fragmented Production: Evidence from Mexico
affiliations: Princeton University - Department of Political Science,  and

detail.title: The Political Economy of Automation and Fragmented Production: Evidence from Mexico
detail.abstract: How does automation in the Global North shape politics and violence in the Global South? We develop a political economy theory in which robot adoption in advanced economies reduces demand for export-oriented labor in developing countries, depressing wages and employment and creating social and political consequences. We test this argument in Mexico, a close trade partner of the United States. Using commuting-zone data, we construct exposure measures combining pre-NAFTA export employment with U.S. industry robot growth and initial offshoring intensity, while accounting for domestic robot adoption and other shocks. To address endogeneity, we instrument foreign exposure with European robot diffusion. We find that regions more exposed to foreign robots experience higher levels of violent organized crime, including narcocrime and homicides (but not property crime), and stronger support for left-populist candidates. These findings demonstrate how automation shocks ripple through global value chains to reshape society and elections.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，发达国家的自动化技术应用通过全球价值链影响发展中国家，导致墨西哥地区工资下降、就业减少，进而引发有组织暴力犯罪增加和对左翼民粹主义候选人的支持上升。
AI.research_question: 发达国家的自动化如何影响发展中国家的政治和暴力？
AI.motivation: 探讨自动化技术在全球化背景下对发展中国家社会政治结构的深远影响，特别是通过全球价值链的传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治经济学理论，强调发达国家机器人应用减少对发展中国家出口导向劳动力的需求，导致工资和就业下降，产生社会政治后果。
AI.method: 使用墨西哥通勤区数据，结合NAFTA前的出口就业、美国行业机器人增长和初始离岸外包强度构建暴露度指标，并采用欧洲机器人扩散作为工具变量解决内生性问题。
AI.findings: 受外国机器人影响更大的地区经历更高水平的暴力有组织犯罪（包括毒品犯罪和谋杀，但不包括财产犯罪），以及对左翼民粹主义候选人的更强支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了自动化通过全球价值链影响发展中国家社会政治的理论框架，揭示了技术变革的跨国溢出效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解全球化背景下技术变革的社会政治后果提供实证依据，有助于制定应对自动化冲击的政策措施。

title: Ambiguity-Seeking Incentives in Electoral Competition
affiliations: University of Malaga and University of Malaga - Departamento de Teoría e Historia Económics

detail.title: Ambiguity-Seeking Incentives in Electoral Competition

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose.

detail.abstract: We develop a model in which two competing parties balance office-seeking incentives with a preference for ambiguity-what we term ambiguity-seeking incentives. These incentives capture the diverse benefits parties obtain from adopting vague platforms, including reduced accountability, greater ease in party recruitment, and enhanced adaptive governance, among others. Our theory shows that the role of ambiguity in electoral competition depends critically on the information parties possess about voter behavior rather than on voters' risk attitudes. Under full information about voter decisions, the unique equilibrium has parties converging to the median voter's ideal policy, which is unambiguous. Under uncertainty, however, ambiguity arises in equilibrium: parties adopt distinct but deliberately vague platforms centered on the policy midpoint. In this setting, parties face a trade-off: while ambiguity lowers expected vote share, it provides compensating advantages by preserving policy flexibility. Our results highlight the neglected role of ambiguity as an explicit objective of political parties and demonstrate its importance as a central feature of electoral competition, shaping party strategies and voter choices even when voters systematically prefer clarity.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个选举竞争模型，其中政党在追求职位的同时具有模糊性偏好。研究发现，在完全信息下政党会收敛于中间选民偏好，但在不确定性下会出现模糊平台均衡。模糊性虽然降低预期得票率，但为政党提供了政策灵活性等补偿优势。
AI.research_question: 选举竞争中模糊性平台的作用机制是什么？政党为何在明知选民偏好明确性的情况下仍采用模糊平台？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注选民风险态度对模糊性的影响，但忽视了政党本身对模糊性的偏好及其战略价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选举竞争理论、模糊性偏好理论、博弈论
AI.method: 理论模型构建，分析完全信息和不确定性两种情境下的均衡策略
AI.findings: 1. 完全信息下政党收敛于中间选民明确偏好；2. 不确定性下出现模糊平台均衡；3. 模糊性提供政策灵活性等补偿优势
AI.theory_contributions: 将模糊性重新定义为政党的主动战略目标而非选民风险态度的被动反应
AI.practical_contributions: 解释了现实政治中政党为何普遍采用模糊平台，为理解选举竞争提供了新视角

title: Neoliberalism, Digitalization and the Information Age
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Neoliberalism, Digitalization and the Information Age
detail.abstract: This note, extending the author's use of comparison and contrast between the economic models he has termed "Keynesian Fordism" and "Neoliberal Financialization," focuses on the defining technologies of each model--the author taking the automotive and electrical, "electrified factory" and "auto-subtopia"-oriented technologies of the Keynesian Fordist era, the digital computing and communications technologies of the neoliberal-financialized era, as representative of the thrust and social consequences of each. In contrast with the stress on physical transfer and the alteration of physical conditions in ways that laid the groundwork for (unrealized) visions of "generalized" middle classness, the digital communications in question may be deemed representative in an era in which not the creation of value through physical work, and physical consumption, but the traffic in assets and the claims on them central to financial operations within a highly financialized and unequal economy as process, productivity, product of material kinds stagnate by comparison. The note also considers the contrast between this reality and the claims earlier made for the supposedly epochal character of the digital, "information," age.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比"凯恩斯福特主义"和"新自由主义金融化"两种经济模式，分析各自代表性技术（汽车/电气化工厂 vs 数字计算/通信技术）的社会影响。指出数字时代并未实现其宣称的划时代变革，反而在物质生产停滞的同时加剧了金融化和不平等。
AI.research_question: 凯恩斯福特主义和新自由主义金融化两种经济模式的核心技术如何塑造不同的社会后果？数字技术是否实现了其宣称的划时代变革？
AI.motivation: 探讨不同经济模式下代表性技术的社会影响，揭示数字时代宣称的变革与现实之间的差距
AI.theoretical_framework: 凯恩斯福特主义理论、新自由主义金融化理论、技术社会影响理论
AI.method: 比较分析法，通过对比两种经济模式的核心技术特征和社会后果
AI.findings: 1. 凯恩斯福特主义技术促进物质生产和中产阶级发展；2. 新自由主义金融化技术强化资产交易和金融操作，物质生产停滞；3. 数字时代并未实现其宣称的划时代变革
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对不同经济模式下技术社会影响的理解，揭示了技术变革与社会经济结构转型的复杂关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解当代经济不平等和金融化现象提供新视角，对技术政策制定具有启示意义

title: The Role of the Employees Provident Fund in Contributory Pension and Social Security
affiliations: Public Administration Association of Nepal (PAAN)

detail.title: The Role of the Employees Provident Fund in Contributory Pension and Social Security
detail.abstract: This paper examines the role of the Employees Provident Fund (EPF) in Nepal as a cornerstone of contributory pension and social security for its contributors. While the traditional non-contributory pension system has provided lifelong benefits to government servants and formal organized institution, it has also imposed a growing fiscal burden on the state. The enactment of the Pension Fund Act (2075) and subsequent reforms marked a turning point by institutionalizing a contributory model managed by the EPF. The paper traces the historical evolution of Nepal's pension architecture, distinguishing between contributory and non-contributory schemes, and situates national reforms within broader global trends. Despite progress, several challenges persist: limited coverage of informal sector workers, actuarial imbalances between contributions and benefits, inflationary pressures, investment risks, governance gaps, and weak member awareness. Comparative insights from Malaysia, South Korea, and India underscore the importance of institutional integration, diversified and sustainable investment strategies, digital service delivery, and strong actuarial governance. The study argues that expanding EPF's reach to informal workers, institutionalizing inflation-indexed benefits, and prioritizing pension literacy are critical for long-term adequacy and equity. Sustaining reforms further requires policy coherence, fiscal discipline, transparency, and inclusivity. Positioned at the center of Nepal's evolving social protection system, the EPF can transform fragmented pension arrangements into a financially sustainable and socially inclusive framework.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了尼泊尔雇员公积金（EPF）作为缴费型养老金和社会安全网核心的作用，探讨了从非缴费型向缴费型养老金制度的转变，识别了覆盖范围有限、精算失衡等挑战，并基于国际比较提出了扩大覆盖、通胀指数化等改革建议。
AI.research_question: 尼泊尔雇员公积金（EPF）在构建可持续、包容性养老金体系中的作用和挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统非缴费型养老金制度给国家带来日益增长的财政负担，而2018年《养老金基金法》的颁布标志着向缴费型模式的制度性转变，需要评估这一改革的成效和面临的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 养老金制度改革理论、社会保护体系理论、制度变迁理论
AI.method: 历史演进分析、比较案例分析（马来西亚、韩国、印度）、政策文献分析
AI.findings: EPF改革取得进展但仍面临多重挑战：非正规部门覆盖有限、精算失衡、通胀压力、投资风险、治理缺口和成员意识薄弱；国际比较显示制度整合、多元化投资、数字化服务和精算治理的重要性
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对发展中国家养老金制度转型的理论理解，特别是从非缴费型向缴费型模式转变的制度化过程及其面临的独特挑战
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼泊尔养老金改革提供了具体政策建议：扩大非正规部门覆盖、建立通胀指数化福利、提升养老金素养、加强政策协调和财政纪律

title: Multitracking within a Multitasking Tournament: Evidence and Theory from China
affiliations: Peking University - School of Economics, , Peking University - Guanghua School of Management and Peking University - Guanghua School of Management

detail.title: Multitracking within a Multitasking Tournament: Evidence and Theory from China
detail.abstract: This paper studies how dividing candidates in a tournament into separate tracks with differentiated performance criteria affects incentives and aggregate outcomes. We exploit China's Major Function Oriented Zoning plan, which assigns counties to development or conservation tracks, with the latter de-emphasizing growth indicators. Using a staggered Difference-in-Differences design, we find that prefectures introducing a conservation track achieved higher aggregate economic performance despite relaxing growth-based evaluation for part of their subordinate counties. To explain this counterintuitive effect, we develop a stylized Tullock contest model that highlights two institutional features: promotion opportunities remain open to officials in both tracks, and counties within the same prefecture continue to interact across tracks. The model further predicts an inverted U-shaped relationship between the size of the conservation track and overall performance, which is supported by empirical evidence.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了中国主体功能区规划中将县级官员分为发展和保护两个考核轨道对激励和整体经济绩效的影响。研究发现，引入保护轨道的地区整体经济表现更好，尽管部分县放松了增长考核。通过理论模型解释，这种反直觉效果源于两个制度特征：两个轨道的官员都有晋升机会，且不同轨道的县之间仍存在互动。
AI.research_question: 将候选人分为不同考核轨道如何影响激励机制和总体经济绩效？
AI.motivation: 理解在官员考核体系中引入差异化绩效标准对整体经济产出的影响，特别是在中国主体功能区规划的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: Tullock竞赛模型，强调两个关键制度特征：双轨官员都有晋升机会，跨轨道县际互动。
AI.method: 交错双重差分设计，利用中国主体功能区规划的自然实验。
AI.findings: 引入保护轨道的地区实现了更高的整体经济绩效；保护轨道规模与整体绩效呈倒U型关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了考虑多轨道考核和跨轨道互动的理论模型，解释了差异化考核的反直觉正面效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计官员考核体系提供了理论依据，表明适当的分轨考核可以提升整体绩效。

title: German Remilitarization Accelerates: A Note
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: German Remilitarization Accelerates: A Note
detail.abstract: In this note the author follows up his prior discussion of Germany's military posture in the wake of the 2022 "Zeitenwende" announcement, specifically comparing the developments in German defense policy of 2025 with the Zeitenwende's associated actions, and probing their implications. Doing so the author ultimately argues that the commitments the German government made to elevated defense and security spending levels far more ambitious than those of 2022, the constitutional revision and other acts enabling that spending, and the German government's more specific actions with regard to the sizing of its forces, orders for new equipment, and intensified efforts at recruitment that may be suggestive of a return to conscription, all underline the exaggerated impressions many had of the Zeitenwende announcement (or at least, its specific policy changes); while plausibly having broad-ranging domestic and international consequences, particularly in their positioning Germany to  be at the center of a wider intensification of European militarization by way of its military-industrial base, and its unique position as a NATO "Framework Nation."

AI.tldr: 本文分析了德国2025年国防政策发展，认为2022年"时代转折"声明的政策变化被夸大，但德国通过增加国防开支、修宪和具体军事行动，正在推动欧洲军事化进程。
AI.research_question: 德国2025年国防政策与2022年"时代转折"声明相比有何发展变化？这些变化对德国国内和国际有何影响？
AI.motivation: 跟进作者之前对德国2022年"时代转折"后军事态势的讨论，分析2025年德国国防政策的具体发展及其影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国防政策分析框架，军事现代化理论，地缘政治分析
AI.method: 比较分析德国2022年"时代转折"声明与2025年实际国防政策发展，评估政策执行差距和实际影响
AI.findings: 德国政府承诺的国防开支远超2022年水平，通过修宪和其他法案支持支出，在部队规模、装备采购和征兵方面采取具体行动，表明"时代转折"声明的政策变化被夸大，但德国正通过其军事工业基础和北约"框架国家"地位推动欧洲军事化
AI.theory_contributions: 深化对国防政策执行差距的理解，分析军事现代化进程中的实际政策演变
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供德国国防政策发展的实际评估，帮助理解欧洲军事化趋势和德国在其中扮演的角色

title: Gendered impacts of oil price shocks: analyzing women's labor force participation in petrostates

detail.title: Gendered impacts of oil price shocks: analyzing women's labor force participation in petrostates
detail.abstract: Oil wealth has been shown to negatively affect women's participation in the labor force. But does declining revenue from fossil fuels, due to the global energy transition, lead to higher female labor force participation (FLFP) and greater gender equality in petrostates? Such hypothetical/future-oriented questions are difficult to answer. This study gets around the challenge by conducting a mixed-method analysis to assess the relationship between oil price shocks and FLFP, emphasizing socioeconomic development and policy implications. Empirical findings indicate there is a causal link between oil price shocks and FLFP in petrostates, with falling oil prices associated with increases in participation and rising prices linked to declines. This relationship appears to be driven by female employment opportunities, government transfers and subsidies, foreign worker flows, and governance quality. Qualitative evidence from Saudi Arabia demonstrates how policy reforms following the 2014 oil price bust can increase FLFP. The results suggest that petrostates are likely to encourage greater women's labor force participation to maintain their prosperity amid diminishing oil revenues driven by the energy transition and global decarbonization efforts in the coming decades.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法分析发现，在石油国家中，油价冲击与女性劳动力参与率存在因果关系：油价下跌会提高女性参与率，油价上涨则降低参与率。这一关系受女性就业机会、政府补贴、外籍工人流动和治理质量等因素驱动。沙特阿拉伯的案例表明，油价下跌后的政策改革可以促进女性劳动力参与。
AI.research_question: 化石燃料收入下降是否会导致石油国家女性劳动力参与率提高和性别平等改善？
AI.motivation: 全球能源转型背景下，石油国家面临收入减少的挑战，需要了解这对女性劳动力参与的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于石油财富对女性劳动力参与影响的现有理论，探讨油价冲击与女性就业的关系机制
AI.method: 混合方法分析，包括实证分析和沙特阿拉伯的定性案例研究
AI.findings: 油价冲击与女性劳动力参与率存在因果关系：油价下跌提高参与率，油价上涨降低参与率；这一关系受就业机会、政府补贴、外籍工人流动和治理质量影响
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了油价冲击影响女性劳动力参与的因果机制，拓展了石油经济与性别平等关系的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为石油国家在能源转型背景下制定促进女性就业的政策提供实证依据，帮助这些国家在收入减少时维持繁荣

title: A Tail of Five Skews
affiliations: Research Affiliates, LLC and

detail.title: A Tail of Five Skews
detail.abstract: We show that a highly statistically significant total skewness risk premium is embedded in the cross-section of returns within a large universe of multi-asset futures and forwards, within a broad set of 215 long/short style factors formed on that universe, and within the cross-sectional equity factor zoo. The skewness risk premium is most robust when it is measured in a relatively new, intuitive way that minimizes the impact of outliers while still capturing information in the tails, which we demonstrate by evaluating five candidate methods across a battery of empirical tests. We show there is compensation for bearing skewness risk in both the long run and ex ante on a point-in-time basis available to investors.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多资产期货、远期合约以及215个多空风格因子中存在显著的偏度风险溢价，且这种溢价在采用新的偏度测量方法时最为稳健。
AI.research_question: 在多资产期货、远期合约以及风格因子中是否存在显著的偏度风险溢价？
AI.motivation: 探索偏度风险在资产定价中的作用，特别是如何准确测量偏度风险溢价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 偏度风险定价理论，资产定价模型中的高阶矩风险补偿。
AI.method: 采用五种不同的偏度测量方法，对多资产期货、远期合约和215个多空风格因子进行横截面分析。
AI.findings: 在多资产期货、远期合约和风格因子中发现了统计显著的偏度风险溢价，且新的偏度测量方法能最小化异常值影响同时捕捉尾部信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了偏度风险定价的新证据，改进了偏度风险的测量方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了识别和利用偏度风险溢价的投资策略指导。

title: Human Rights Risks in Tech-Enhanced Incarceration: A Comparative Analysis
affiliations: Ibrar Law Associates, University of Lahore (UOL) and University of Lahore (UOL)

detail.title: Human Rights Risks in Tech-Enhanced Incarceration: A Comparative Analysis

publicationDetails.detailsText: https://ijhs.com.pk/index.php/IJHS/article/view/872

detail.abstract: The adoption of digital surveillance and electronic monitoring (EM) technologies by several countries is leading to the emergence of “digital prisons” as alternatives to incarcerations. Even though this has been displayed as a reformative initiative, yet these technological advancements often enhance and worsen carceral control, which disproportionately harms marginalized communities. This paper critically evaluates the concerns regarding privacy violations, algorithmic bias, as well as the elimination of due process. The paper attempts to establish that digital punishment frameworks should be considered as component of a broader carceral regime, instead of being labelled as decarceral innovations.   The lack of adequate accountability measure and transparency mechanisms in technological systems vitiates the right to a fire trial and effective justice. Thoroughly analyzing international human rights principles in comparison with different case studies across jurisdictions, this paper stresses the need for introducing robust regulatory mechanisms and human oversights through deployment of digital correctional tools. It lastly concludes that although technology has played a crucial role in the rehabilitation and reformation of prison management, however, unchecked reliance on digital devices led to digital authoritarianism within judicial frameworks, which erodes the principles of human rights and exacerbates existing social inequalities.

AI.tldr: 数字监控和电子监控技术的采用正在形成"数字监狱"作为监禁替代方案，但这些技术往往增强而非减轻监禁控制，对边缘化群体造成不成比例的伤害。
AI.research_question: 数字惩罚框架是否应被视为更广泛监禁制度的组成部分，而非去监禁创新？
AI.motivation: 尽管数字监控技术被标榜为改革举措，但实际上加剧了监禁控制，侵犯隐私权，存在算法偏见，并削弱正当程序权利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际人权原则和监禁制度理论，批判性地分析数字惩罚框架的本质。
AI.method: 通过比较不同司法管辖区的案例研究，分析数字矫正工具的应用现状。
AI.findings: 数字监控技术缺乏足够的问责机制和透明度，损害公平审判权和有效司法，导致司法框架内的数字威权主义。
AI.theory_contributions: 将数字惩罚框架重新定义为监禁制度的延伸，而非去监禁创新，为理解技术增强型社会控制提供理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要建立强有力的监管机制和人工监督，以防止数字威权主义，保护人权原则。

title: Peace Education Curriculum Implementation and the Culture of Peace in Yala, Cross River State, Nigeria
affiliations: University of Calabar, Taraba State College of Education and University of Calabar (UNICAL)

detail.title: Peace Education Curriculum Implementation and the Culture of Peace in Yala, Cross River State, Nigeria
detail.abstract: The purpose of the study was to investigate the relationship between the implementation of peace education curriculum and the culture of peace in Yala Local Government Area of Cross River State, Nigeria. To achieve the objectives of the study, two null hypotheses were formulated to direct the study. Literature was reviewed based on the hypotheses directing the study. Survey research design was adopted for the study. A census of 112 social studies and civic education teachers was used for the study. Structured Likert scale type questionnaires were distributed as the main instrument for data collection. Only 100 copies were found fit for use. Pearson product moment correlation analysis was employed to test the hypotheses. The hypotheses were subjected to testing at 0.05 level of significance. The result of the analyses indicated that the implementation of peace education contents of co-operation does not significantly relate with the culture of peace in Yala. Secondly, there is a significantly weak relationship between the implementation of the contents of empathy and culture of peace in Yala. These results were blamed on inadequate implementation of peace education curriculum in Yala. It was therefore recommended that social studies and civic education teachers be more practical by emphasizing affective learning and testing students’ emotions, engaging them in team work that leads to achieving a particular goal related to peace-building.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了尼日利亚克罗斯河州Yala地区和平教育课程实施与和平文化之间的关系。研究发现合作内容的实施与和平文化无显著相关，同理心内容的实施与和平文化呈弱相关，这归因于和平教育课程实施不足。建议教师应更注重实践教学和情感学习。
AI.research_question: 和平教育课程实施与和平文化之间是否存在显著关系？
AI.motivation: 调查尼日利亚Yala地区和平教育课程实施效果及其对和平文化的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 和平教育理论、课程实施理论、文化构建理论
AI.method: 调查研究设计，采用普查方法对112名社会研究和公民教育教师进行调查，使用结构化李克特量表问卷收集数据，采用皮尔逊积矩相关分析检验假设
AI.findings: 1. 合作内容的实施与和平文化无显著相关；2. 同理心内容的实施与和平文化呈显著弱相关
AI.theory_contributions: 为和平教育课程实施效果提供了实证证据，揭示了不同教学内容对和平文化影响的差异性
AI.practical_contributions: 建议教师应更注重实践教学，强调情感学习，通过团队合作活动促进学生和平建设能力的培养

title: An empirical analysis on the relationship between resource rents and education: the role of institutional quality thresholds

detail.title: An empirical analysis on the relationship between resource rents and education: the role of institutional quality thresholds
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of resource rents, specifically those from oil and gas, on education, with a focus on the role of institutional quality. Using a sample of 103 countries and a panel data analysis covering the period 1984-2020, the paper employs econometric threshold analysis to classify countries based on their institutional quality. The results indicate that in countries with weaker institutions, oil and gas rents have a negative impact on education levels. However, in countries with stronger institutions, the impact of resource rents on education is positive and significant. By adopting the threshold regression model, which considers the concept of threshold effects, this study contributes to the existing literature by examining the existence of an institutional quality threshold that captures the rich dynamics between resource rents and education. These findings have important policy implications, highlighting the heterogeneity in the role of resource rents in the economy, depending on the quality of political institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过阈值回归模型分析103个国家1984-2020年的面板数据，发现制度质量在资源租金对教育影响中起关键作用：在制度较弱国家，油气租金对教育有负面影响；在制度较强国家，则有显著正面影响。
AI.research_question: 资源租金（特别是油气租金）对教育的影响如何？制度质量在这一关系中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 研究资源租金与教育之间的关系，特别关注制度质量作为调节变量的作用，以解释不同国家间的异质性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度经济学理论，探讨制度质量如何调节资源租金对教育的影响，采用阈值效应概念分析制度质量的门槛作用。
AI.method: 使用103个国家1984-2020年的面板数据，采用计量经济学阈值分析方法，根据制度质量对国家进行分类。
AI.findings: 在制度较弱的国家，油气租金对教育水平有负面影响；在制度较强的国家，资源租金对教育有正面且显著的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过引入阈值回归模型，验证了制度质量在资源租金与教育关系中的门槛效应，丰富了现有文献对资源租金异质性影响的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果具有重要政策意义，强调资源租金对经济的影响取决于政治制度质量，为不同制度环境下的资源管理政策提供指导。

title: Democratized Informality: Mapping The Evolution of ‘Off-Plan’ Unauthorized Constructions in Attica, Greece, Over Half a Century
affiliations: National Technical University of Athens (NTUA)

detail.title: Democratized Informality: Mapping The Evolution of ‘Off-Plan’ Unauthorized Constructions in Attica, Greece, Over Half a Century
detail.abstract: The persistent challenge of informal urbanization necessitates longitudinal studies to understand its evolving nature. This study addresses this gap by conducting a comprehensive spatiotemporal analysis of unauthorized 'off-plan' construction in Attica, Greece, between 1955 and 2011, utilizing a unique dataset of 84,300 property declarations. It reveals the dynamic and evolving nature of urban informality, driven by a complex interplay of necessity, opportunity, and speculation, and its adaptation to shifting regulatory landscapes. The findings challenge many simplistic dichotomies prevalent in literature, highlighting the blurred boundaries between formal and informal, legal and illegal, and need-driven versus opportunistic motivations. Overall, the Athenian and Attica case study offers valuable, empirically grounded insights into the challenges of informal urbanization and sprawl, providing lessons for cities worldwide grappling with similar issues, especially during transitional phases.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对希腊阿提卡地区1955-2011年间84,300份房产申报数据的时空分析，揭示了非正规城市化的动态演变特征，挑战了文献中常见的简单二元对立观点。
AI.research_question: 非正规城市化如何随时间演变？其背后的驱动因素和适应机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 非正规城市化的持续性挑战需要纵向研究来理解其演变性质，填补现有研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非正规城市化理论、城市扩张理论、制度适应理论

AI.findings: 揭示了非正规城市化的动态演变特征，由必要性、机会和投机复杂互动驱动，并能适应不断变化的监管环境

title: Simple Contracts for Due Diligence and Execution
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, Universidad Andrés Bello and Northwestern University

detail.title: Simple Contracts for Due Diligence and Execution

declarations.funderStatement: The authors acknowledge financial support a joint grant of Universidad Andrés Bello (UNAB) and the University of Chicago Becker Friedman Institute for Economics in Latin America (BFI-LATAM). R. Caldentey also acknowledges financial support from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.

detail.abstract: We study a continuous-time principal-agent model in which an expert privately acquires information about a project's profitability before recommending whether to execute it. We consider two contract classes: one in which the principal controls the time the agent spends collecting information, and another in which the agent chooses when to stop collecting information. The principal prefers the former to the latter when the agent's outside option is large, and also when the agent's speed of learning is small. When the principal chooses the contract that leaves the stopping decision to the agent, she also delegates the execution to the agent with a positive probability, which increases the set of implementable stopping times and reduces the rents given to the agent to induce him to choose the principal's desired stopping time.

AI.tldr: 研究连续时间委托-代理模型，专家在推荐项目执行前私下获取项目盈利能力信息。比较两种合同：委托人控制信息收集时间 vs 代理人自主决定停止时间。委托人偏好前者当代理人外部选择权大或学习速度慢时。当委托人让代理人决定停止时间时，会以正概率将执行权委托给代理人，从而扩大可实施的停止时间集并减少租金支付。
AI.research_question: 在连续时间委托-代理模型中，委托人如何设计最优合同来激励专家获取项目信息并做出推荐决策？
AI.motivation: 研究在信息不对称情况下，委托人如何通过合同设计来激励专家有效获取信息并做出符合委托人利益的决策，特别是在专家可以私下获取项目盈利能力信息的情境下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间委托-代理理论、信息获取模型、最优合同设计、激励机制设计
AI.method: 连续时间数学模型分析，比较两种合同类别：委托人控制信息收集时间 vs 代理人自主决定停止时间
AI.findings: 1. 委托人偏好控制信息收集时间合同当代理人外部选择权大或学习速度小时；2. 当委托人让代理人决定停止时间时，会以正概率将执行权委托给代理人；3. 这种委托扩大了可实施的停止时间集并减少了租金支付
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了连续时间委托-代理理论，提供了在信息获取情境下的最优合同设计框架，揭示了委托执行权在激励机制中的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计专家激励机制提供了理论指导，特别是在需要专家获取专业信息做出决策的情境下

title: The Limits of Moral Wiggle Room: Risk and Plausible Deniability in Public Good Games
affiliations: University of Birmingham and Durham University

detail.title: The Limits of Moral Wiggle Room: Risk and Plausible Deniability in Public Good Games
detail.abstract: Although in the lab we often assume a deterministic relationship between contributions to public goods and their returns, in real life this relationship is often uncertain: consider corruption or inefficiencies in governments, or areas where our knowledge is limited such as climate change mitigation. Rational individuals may change their contributions to respond to this uncertainty, but we may also observe a reduction in contributions if people take advantage of the plausible deniability about one's actions that this uncertainty creates. The reduction of prosocial behaviour in the presence of plausible deniability was documented in Dana et al. (2007) and has since been widely replicated in two-person non-strategic settings. We test whether people exploit uncertainty in public good games (PGG) by using it as an excuse to free-ride. In two online studies that entail 5 between-subjects treatments, we varied whether the marginal per capita returns (MPCR) were certain or uncertain, and whether this uncertainty could give participants plausible deniability for their low or zero contributions. We found no change in freeriding or average contributions across treatments, suggesting that cooperation under uncertainty is accurately captured by the standard PGGs with certain MPCR, and that uncertainty need not hamper cooperation in social dilemmas.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试了在公共物品博弈中，不确定性是否会被人们用作搭便车的借口。研究发现，无论边际人均回报是否确定，搭便车行为和平均贡献都没有变化，表明标准公共物品博弈能准确捕捉不确定性下的合作行为。
AI.research_question: 在公共物品博弈中，人们是否会利用不确定性作为搭便车的借口？
AI.motivation: 现实生活中公共物品的回报往往是不确定的（如腐败、政府效率低下、气候变化缓解等），这种不确定性可能为人们提供合理的推诿理由来减少贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Dana等人(2007)关于合理推诿减少亲社会行为的研究，以及公共物品博弈理论。
AI.method: 两个在线研究，包含5个组间设计处理，操纵边际人均回报(MPCR)的确定性与不确定性，以及这种不确定性是否能为参与者提供合理的推诿理由。
AI.findings: 在不同处理条件下，搭便车行为和平均贡献没有显著变化，不确定性并未影响合作行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了不确定性会减少合作的假设，表明标准公共物品博弈能准确捕捉不确定性下的合作行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：在面临不确定性的社会困境中，不必过分担心不确定性会损害合作。

title: Skill Disruption and Post-Acquisition Employee Exit
affiliations: , ESSEC Business School and Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich (LMU) - Faculty of Business Administration (Munich School of Management)

detail.title: Skill Disruption and Post-Acquisition Employee Exit
detail.abstract: In knowledge-intensive industries, many acquisition targets are selected for their human capital. Acquisitions can also, however, trigger employee departure, reducing the very asset the acquirer originally wanted to obtain. To better understand this issue and its underlying factors, we argue that, when acquisitions disrupt the complementarity between employee skills and employer activities, they diminish human capital productivity in the value-creation process, which ultimately drives exit decisions. We predict that employees with specialized skills are more strongly affected by disruption than generalists, while the effect of individual disruption on employee exit becomes weaker if the acquisition target as a whole is more distant to the acquirer. Analyzing vertical acquisitions in the U.S. video-game industry, we find strong evidence for our hypotheses. Our findings have implications for the likely success of related and unrelated acquisitions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究知识密集型产业中，收购如何通过破坏员工技能与雇主活动的互补性，导致员工离职。研究发现专业技能的员工更容易受收购干扰，但当收购目标与收购方整体距离较远时，这种影响会减弱。
AI.research_question: 收购如何通过破坏员工技能与雇主活动的互补性来影响员工离职决策？
AI.motivation: 在知识密集型产业中，收购往往是为了获取人力资本，但收购本身却可能触发员工离职，从而减少收购方原本想要获得的资产。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本理论和技能互补性理论，认为当收购破坏员工技能与雇主活动的互补性时，会降低人力资本在价值创造过程中的生产力，从而驱动离职决策。
AI.method: 分析美国视频游戏行业的纵向收购数据
AI.findings: 专业技能员工比通才更容易受到收购干扰的影响；当收购目标与收购方整体距离较远时，个体干扰对员工离职的影响会减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对收购中人力资本流失机制的理解，提出了技能互补性破坏作为中介机制的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为相关和不相关收购的成功可能性提供了实践启示，帮助企业更好地管理收购后的人力资本整合。

title: Reference Dependent Utility and the Simple Portfolio Problem
affiliations: City University of New York, Baruch College - Zicklin School of Business - Department of Economics and Finance and University of Colorado at Boulder - Department of Finance

detail.title: Reference Dependent Utility and the Simple Portfolio Problem

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None

detail.abstract: How do risk-and ambiguity-averse investors allocate capital between uncertain and uncertaintyfree securities? What are the asset pricing implications of this behavior? We use Izhakian's (2017) model to provide an axiomatic foundation for constructing, from the uncertainty over probabilities in the market and investor preferences, the exogenous nonadditive capacities utilized in Schmeidler (1989) or Wakker and Tversky (1993). This allows an examination of the distinct impacts of ambiguity, ambiguity aversion, risk, and risk aversion on portfolio choice, the allocation of uncertainty across investors and a characterization of the uncertainty premium.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用Izhakian(2017)模型为Schmeidler(1989)和Wakker&Tversky(1993)中使用的非加性容量提供公理化基础，分析风险厌恶和模糊厌恶投资者的资本配置行为及其资产定价含义。
AI.research_question: 风险厌恶和模糊厌恶的投资者如何在不确定性和无风险证券之间配置资本？这种行为对资产定价有什么影响？
AI.motivation: 需要理解投资者在面对风险和模糊性时的资本配置决策，以及这些行为如何影响资产定价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Izhakian(2017)模型，为Schmeidler(1989)和Wakker&Tversky(1993)的非加性容量提供公理化基础。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，从市场概率不确定性和投资者偏好构建外生非加性容量。
AI.findings: 能够分别检验模糊性、模糊厌恶、风险和风险厌恶对投资组合选择的影响，分析投资者间不确定性的分配，并刻画不确定性溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 为模糊厌恶理论提供公理化基础，区分风险和模糊性的不同影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助理解投资者行为对资产定价的影响，为投资决策提供理论指导。

title: Market Mechanisms for Circular Economies: The Role of Taxation and Consortia in Paper Recycling
affiliations: University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics and University of Rome Tor Vergata - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Market Mechanisms for Circular Economies: The Role of Taxation and Consortia in Paper Recycling

declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical Approval: This article does not contain any studies with human participants or animals performed by any of the authors. Informed Consent: Not applicable.

detail.abstract: A positive gap between supply and demand reservation prices for recycled paper implies the nonexistence of a recycled paper market with high environmental costs. We show how creating a mandatory consortium imposing a unit tax on packaging producers, and using it to subsidize the collection and production of recycled paper, creates the market thereby reducing paper waste in landfills and increasing circularity. We discuss critical issues of this policy such as the protectionism/environmental sustainability trade-off, the redistributive effects on the two affected industries and consumers, the role of consortium investment in innovation and communication and the critical issues related to the definition of the unit tax with specific reference to the case of the COMIECO paper consortium in Italy. Based on our model we simulate the effects of four different types of shocks under the alternative scenarios of flexible and fixed packaging tax and show how the domestic market can survive if it avoids two limits, Scylla and Charybdis, which are, respectively, the political sustainability of packaging tax and import competition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过建立强制性联盟对包装生产商征收单位税，并用此补贴回收纸的收集和生产，从而创建回收纸市场，减少垃圾填埋场的纸张浪费并提高循环性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过政策干预创建回收纸市场以解决供需价格差距问题？
AI.motivation: 回收纸供需之间的正价格差距导致高环境成本的回收纸市场不存在，需要政策干预来创建市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于供需价格差距理论、环境经济学和政策干预理论
AI.method: 建立模型并模拟四种不同类型冲击在灵活和固定包装税情景下的效果，以意大利COMIECO纸业联盟为案例研究
AI.findings: 通过强制性联盟征收单位税并补贴回收纸生产可以创建市场，但需要平衡保护主义与环境可持续性的权衡，并避免政治可持续性和进口竞争两个限制
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了通过政策干预解决环境产品市场缺失的理论框架，分析了税收补贴机制的市场创建效应
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了创建回收纸市场的具体方案，指出了政策实施中的关键问题和限制因素

title: The Dammed Gender? Dams, Groundwater, and Female Schooling in Sub-Saharan Africa
affiliations: , Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - School of Humanities and Social Science and Division of Social Science, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

detail.title: The Dammed Gender? Dams, Groundwater, and Female Schooling in Sub-Saharan Africa
detail.abstract: This paper investigates gender-asymmetric impacts of dams on schooling in Sub-Saharan Africa. Exploiting that dams reduce groundwater storage in downstream vicinities within arid environments, we employ a difference-in-differences strategy comparing individuals proximate to versus distant from dams. Exposure to dams before age 15 is found to reduce female schooling by 1.2 years in downstream areas near dams relative to more distant locations. Effects are most pronounced in patriarchal societies and not driven by migration. No comparable schooling effects are found for males or upstream areas. One primary mechanism is educational disruption from increased water collection burden --- a task disproportionately borne by school-aged girls.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现水坝对撒哈拉以南非洲女性教育产生性别不对称影响，在干旱环境下，水坝会减少下游地区的地下水储量，导致15岁前接触水坝的女性教育年限减少1.2年，主要原因是增加了主要由学龄女孩承担的打水负担。
AI.research_question: 水坝对撒哈拉以南非洲地区教育是否存在性别不对称影响？
AI.motivation: 研究水坝对教育的影响，特别关注性别差异，因为水坝可能通过改变水资源获取方式对女性教育产生不成比例的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于水资源获取与教育机会的理论框架，特别关注性别角色分工对教育的影响。
AI.method: 采用双重差分策略，比较靠近水坝与远离水坝的个体，利用水坝减少干旱环境下下游地区地下水储量的自然实验。
AI.findings: 15岁前接触水坝使下游地区女性教育年限减少1.2年，影响在父权社会中最为明显，且不受移民因素驱动。男性或上游地区未发现类似教育影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了水坝基础设施对教育性别差异影响的理论证据，揭示了水资源管理对性别平等的间接影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为水坝建设政策提供性别敏感视角，建议在水坝规划中考虑对女性教育的潜在负面影响，并设计缓解措施。

title: The Economics of Return Insurance
affiliations: Seoul National University - Business School

detail.title: The Economics of Return Insurance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: This study examines the return strategies of competitive online sellers, considering three strategies: no insurance, return insurance, and free returns. Risk-averse consumers purchase products if they match their preferences, but decide whether to return them if they do not. Consumers are assumed to be identical except for their preferences and exchange costs. The analysis yields the following results. First, offering return insurance or free returns is superior to no insurance. This is due to consumers' risk aversion. Second, the proportion of consumers returning products increases in the order of no insurance, return insurance, and free returns. This is because purchasing insurance leads to lower return costs. Third, when sellers can choose return strategies, in equilibrium, (i) all three strategies coexist, (ii) only return insurance exist, or (iii) only no insurance and free returns coexist.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了竞争性在线卖家的退货策略，比较无保险、退货保险和免费退货三种策略。研究发现：退货保险或免费退货优于无保险；退货率按无保险、退货保险、免费退货顺序递增；均衡状态下三种策略可能共存、仅退货保险存在、或仅无保险和免费退货共存。
AI.research_question: 竞争性在线卖家应选择何种退货策略？不同退货策略如何影响消费者行为和卖家利润？
AI.motivation: 在线购物中消费者面临产品不匹配风险，卖家需要设计有效的退货策略来吸引消费者并管理退货成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险厌恶消费者理论，考虑消费者偏好异质性和退货成本，分析三种退货策略的经济效应。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，假设消费者风险厌恶且偏好异质，比较不同退货策略下的消费者购买决策和退货行为。
AI.findings: 1. 退货保险或免费退货优于无保险策略；2. 退货率随退货成本降低而增加；3. 均衡状态下退货策略存在多种组合可能。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了在线零售退货策略的理论框架，揭示了风险厌恶和退货成本在策略选择中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线卖家提供退货策略选择的决策依据，帮助平衡消费者吸引力和退货成本管理。

title: Are Intangible Asset Valuations in Financial Reports Useful? Historical Evidence from the Illinois Blue Sky Law
affiliations: Northwestern University, University of Maryland Baltimore County, Naveen Jindal School of Management, UT Dallas and Temple University

detail.title: Are Intangible Asset Valuations in Financial Reports Useful? Historical Evidence from the Illinois Blue Sky Law

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: Under current accounting standards, internally generated intangible assets (IGIs) are excluded from balance sheets, and for acquired intangibles only aggregate values are reported. Scholars argue that this lack of IGI reporting limits investors’ ability to assess a firm’s true value, yet standard setters remain uncertain whether such assets should be included in financial statements. Moreover, even if such assets were recognized, questions remain as to whether IGIs should be reported individually or in aggregate, and which valuation approach should be used. We contribute to this debate by analyzing a historical case: Illinois’s 1919 “blue sky law,” which required firms issuing securities to disclose itemized valuations of all intangible assets—without distinguishing between acquired and internally generated ones. Although our dataset spans various intangible types, we focus on patents—the only category with measurable future value—to assess whether reported valuations were informative. The data also allows us to distinguish among valuation methods, including historical research and development (R&D) costs, purchase prices, appraised values, and instances in which nominal valuations are listed. We find that reported patent valuations are uncorrelated with independent measures of long-term patent value. Moreover, there is no difference in correlation between acquired and IG patents, or itemized and non-itemized patents; all methods of valuation are likewise uncorrelated with long-term values, with the exception of appraised valuations, which are negatively correlated. To understand the plausible reasons behind these results, we draw on digit testing tools from forensic accounting. We find that in most cases, there is no evidence of manipulation of intangible asset values. Instead, we find that owners of intangible assets struggle to precisely value them. Overall, these results suggest that it is possible to expand disclosure of intangible asset valuations without leading to manipulation by asset owners, but uncertainty in the values of these assets make those valuations unpredictive of future value.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了1919年伊利诺伊州证券法要求披露无形资产估值的案例，发现报告的专利估值与长期专利价值无关，所有估值方法（除评估价值外）都无法预测未来价值，主要原因是资产所有者难以精确估值而非操纵行为。
AI.research_question: 无形资产估值报告是否能为投资者提供有价值的信息？特别是内部生成无形资产与外部获取无形资产在估值信息含量方面是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 当前会计准则排除内部生成无形资产，学者认为这限制了投资者评估企业真实价值的能力，但准则制定者不确定是否应包含这些资产，以及如何报告和估值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无形资产估值理论、信息披露理论、价值相关性理论
AI.method: 历史案例研究，分析1919年伊利诺伊州证券法要求下的无形资产披露数据，使用数字测试工具进行法务会计分析
AI.findings: 报告的专利估值与长期专利价值无相关性；获取与内部生成专利的估值无差异；所有估值方法（除评估价值外）都与长期价值无关；评估价值呈负相关；无证据表明存在估值操纵，主要问题是资产所有者难以精确估值
AI.theory_contributions: 为无形资产估值争议提供历史证据，证明估值不确定性是主要问题而非操纵行为
AI.practical_contributions: 建议可以扩大无形资产估值披露而不必担心操纵风险，但需认识到这些估值对预测未来价值的作用有限

title: Who clears the market when pro-cyclical investors trade?
affiliations: Deutsche Bundesbank, Goethe University Frankfurt - Department of Finance and Deutsche Bundesbank

detail.title: Who clears the market when pro-cyclical investors trade?
detail.abstract: Limits of arbitrage can explain why hedge funds and other investors do not take large countercyclical positions in the aggregate equity market, but they leave open the question of who buys when markets crash and who sells during booms. We address this long-standing puzzle using transactionlevel data on the universe of trades across major European equity and interest rate cash and derivatives markets. We classify investors into sectors and quantify, at horizons from 15 minutes to one month, which sectors absorb the net flows of the most pro-cyclical investors (asset managers). We find dealer banks are the dominant liquidity providers across markets. At daily frequency, they absorb nearly the entire net flow of asset managers, while principal trading firms and hedge funds absorb only about 10% and 5%, respectively. Long-term investors trade pro-cyclically, amplifying rather than offsetting flows. Our results provide direct evidence for the conjecture in the intermediary asset pricing literature that dealer banks are key liquidity providers across different asset classes.

AI.tldr: 本文使用欧洲股票和利率市场的交易数据，发现交易商银行是跨市场的主要流动性提供者，吸收资产经理的净流动，而长期投资者实际上加剧了顺周期性流动。
AI.research_question: 在市场崩溃时谁买入，在繁荣时谁卖出？交易商银行是否是跨资产类别的主要流动性提供者？
AI.motivation: 套利限制理论解释了为什么对冲基金等投资者不在整体股票市场中采取大规模逆周期头寸，但未能回答市场崩溃时谁买入、繁荣时谁卖出的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中介资产定价理论、套利限制理论、流动性提供者理论
AI.method: 使用欧洲主要股票和利率现货及衍生品市场的交易级数据，将投资者按部门分类，在15分钟到1个月的时间范围内量化各部门吸收资产经理净流动的情况
AI.findings: 交易商银行是跨市场的主要流动性提供者，在日频率上吸收资产经理近全部净流动；主要交易公司和对冲基金分别只吸收约10%和5%；长期投资者实际上进行顺周期交易，加剧而非抵消流动
AI.theory_contributions: 为中介资产定价文献中关于交易商银行是跨资产类别关键流动性提供者的猜想提供了直接证据
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了市场流动性提供者的真实构成，对市场稳定性和风险管理具有重要启示

title: RavenPack Quantitative Research: Harnessing News Sentiment for FX Futures Strategies
affiliations: RavenPack International, Université Paris Dauphine, RavenPack International and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: RavenPack Quantitative Research: Harnessing News Sentiment for FX Futures Strategies
detail.abstract:
In this paper, we demonstrate the predictive power of RavenPack’s news sentiment across G7 currencies building trend-following and mean-reverting signals from country-specific macroeconomic news and FX prices news, respectively.
(i) Our trend-following long-short FX futures strategy, rebalanced daily, achieves Information Ratios upwards of 0.52 with an effective holding period of 5 days.
Similarly, our mean-reverting strategy achieves Information Ratios upwards of 0.63 with an effective holding period of 4 days.

(ii) Each leg outperforms the equally-weighted basket of G7 currencies, showing the value added of RavenPack sentiment in currency rotation across time.

(iii) When compared to traditional price momentum and mean-reversion, backtested performance from news sentiment shows low correlation while significantly
outperforming.

(iv) Mean-reverting (trend-following) strategies have a faster (slower) decay and work better for shorter (longer) time horizons, suggesting that the two signals complement each other over different time horizons.

(v) The combined strategy generally outperforms the individual ones across the holding periods, as individual signals complement each other in terms of signal decays.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了RavenPack新闻情绪对G7货币的预测能力，分别从国家特定宏观经济新闻构建趋势跟踪信号，从外汇价格新闻构建均值回归信号。趋势跟踪策略信息比率达0.52，均值回归策略达0.63，两者互补且组合策略表现更优。
AI.research_question: RavenPack新闻情绪能否有效预测G7货币走势？趋势跟踪和均值回归策略在货币投资中的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 探索新闻情绪数据在外汇市场中的预测价值，比较不同策略在不同时间维度上的表现差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为金融学和市场效率理论，研究新闻情绪对汇率的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用RavenPack新闻情绪数据构建趋势跟踪和均值回归策略，进行回测分析，比较信息比率和持有期表现。
AI.findings: 趋势跟踪策略信息比率0.52（5天持有期），均值回归策略0.63（4天持有期）；两者与传统价格动量策略相关性低但表现更优；均值回归策略衰减更快，适合短期；趋势跟踪衰减较慢，适合长期；组合策略表现最佳。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了新闻情绪在外汇预测中的有效性，揭示了不同策略在不同时间维度的互补性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为外汇投资提供了基于新闻情绪的有效策略框架，展示了趋势跟踪和均值回归策略的实践应用价值。

title: ASSESSMENT OF THE FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM IN THE ELECTRIC POWER COMPANIES

detail.title: ASSESSMENT OF THE FINANCIAL RISK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM IN THE ELECTRIC POWER COMPANIES
detail.abstract: The purpose of the study is to assess the financial risk management system in organizations in the electric power industry, which allows to determine its most important components, to identify industry-specific risk management features, to establish risk factors and to propose a set of measures to reduce the negative impact of risks on the financial stability of electric power companies. Research methods - generalization and analysis of the scientific basis and practical experience in risk management in the electric power industry; a systematic approach and epistemological principle in assessing the risk management policy, the features of the functioning of management structures, the establishment of risk factors and a set of measures to manage risks in companies in the energy sector. As a result, it was found that the financial risk management system in the organizations of the electric power industry operates within the framework of the overall risk management system. An assessment of the multi-level hierarchical structure of risk management and its powers is given. A grouping of risks specific to electric power companies is made, which includes a group of financial risks, specific risk factors are identified, and measures to compensate them are proposed.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了电力行业组织的财务风险管理体系，确定了其重要组成部分、行业特定风险管理特征、风险因素，并提出了降低风险对电力公司财务稳定性负面影响的措施。
AI.research_question: 如何评估电力行业组织的财务风险管理体系及其对财务稳定性的影响？
AI.motivation: 识别电力行业特有的风险管理特征，建立风险因素，并提出降低风险对电力公司财务稳定性负面影响的措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统方法和认识论原则，用于评估风险管理政策、管理结构运作特征、风险因素建立以及能源行业公司风险管理措施。
AI.method: 概括和分析电力行业风险管理的科学基础和实践经验；采用系统方法和认识论原则评估风险管理政策、管理结构特征、风险因素和风险管理措施。
AI.findings: 电力行业组织的财务风险管理体系在整体风险管理框架内运作；评估了多层次分层风险管理结构及其权限；对电力公司特有的风险进行了分组，包括财务风险组，识别了特定风险因素，并提出了补偿措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了电力行业财务风险管理的理论框架，提出了行业特定的风险分类和因素识别方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力公司提供了具体的风险管理措施，帮助提高财务稳定性，并为行业风险管理实践提供了指导。

title: Why Labor-Managed Firms May Not be Socially Desirable
affiliations: Institute for Economic Sciences

detail.title: Why Labor-Managed Firms May Not be Socially Desirable
detail.abstract: We employ a game-theoretic model to analyze five duopoly regimes: (1) state-owned and labor-managed firms, (2) labor-managed firms, (3) state-owned and capitalist firms, (4) capitalist firms, and (5) capitalist and labor-managed firms. We compare the welfare outcomes across these regimes and find that labor-managed firms may not be socially desirable due to their adverse impact on economic welfare. This may help explain why labor-managed firms are relatively rare compared to capitalist firms.

detail.abstract: This study investigates the influences of university-generated social media content on students' e-word-of-mouth behavior and student-university identification, and student-university identification on students' e-word-of-mouth behavior. Understanding these relationships is crucial for enhancing institutional engagement and communication strategies in higher education, particularly in the Philippine context. Using predictive-causal and quantitative research design, the direct and indirect links between the latent variables of the structural model were estimated using partial least squares of 487 students at Tarlac State University in Tarlac City, Philippines, administered in November 2024. Results revealed significant relationship of university-generated social media content and e-word-of-mouth (β = 0.11, p < .001), university-generated social media content and student-university identification (β = 0.69, p < .001), studentuniversity identification and e-word-of-mouth (β = 0.60, p < .001), and mediation of student-university identification between university-generated social media content and e-word-of-mouth (β = 0.42, p < .001), thereby supporting all the hypotheses.

title: Peer Option Momentum
affiliations: University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business - Finance and Business Economics Department, , City University of Hong Kong, University of Kansas, City University of Hong Kong (CityU), Department of Economics & Finance, Students and Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University (XJTLU)

detail.title: Peer Option Momentum
detail.abstract: We find strong evidence of peer momentum in delta-hedged option returns. Our main peer momentum measure, in which firms are linked if they share common sell-side analysts, is highly profitable, with a pre-cost Sharpe ratio of 2.9. It is distinct from standard momentum, and there is little impact from controlling for standard momentum or other well-know option return predictors. It is robust to the length of the formation periods, the method of return computation, and realistic assumptions about transactions costs. Alternative methods for linking peer firms usually result in weaker performance, though it in most cases remains highly significant. We show that peer momentum is consistent with underreaction of implied volatilities to volatility shocks of peer firms. Using several different approaches, we also show that factor momentum is not a complete explanation of peer momentum. Our final results demonstrate the new finding of peer reversal, which is present in a smaller number of firm pairs but is nevertheless highly significant.

AI.tldr: 研究发现delta对冲期权回报中存在显著的同伴动量效应，基于共享卖方分析师的公司关联构建的主要同伴动量指标具有高盈利能力（夏普比率2.9），该效应区别于标准动量，对多种控制变量和交易成本假设保持稳健，并发现同伴反转的新现象。
AI.research_question: delta对冲期权回报中是否存在同伴动量效应？该效应是否区别于标准动量和其他已知期权回报预测因子？

AI.theoretical_framework: 同伴动量理论、隐含波动率反应不足理论、因子动量理论

AI.findings: 主要同伴动量指标高度盈利（夏普比率2.9），区别于标准动量，对控制变量和交易成本保持稳健，存在隐含波动率对同伴公司波动率冲击反应不足，发现同伴反转现象

title: Does Voluntary Private Tax Disclosure Reduce IRS Audit Risk?
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business, University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Accounting Area and

detail.title: Does Voluntary Private Tax Disclosure Reduce IRS Audit Risk?
detail.abstract: This paper examines the trade-off between voluntary private tax disclosure and audit risk associated with firms' use of private letter rulings (PLRs). PLRs allow firms to seek binding guidance from the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) on the tax treatment of specific transactions, reducing uncertainty but requiring voluntary disclosure of sensitive tax information to the IRS. Using a novel dataset of PLRs disclosed in public firms' SEC filings, we find that firms receiving a PLR for the first time experience a decreased likelihood of audit. These results are concentrated in small firms, and those with moderate levels of tax avoidance. We find no other change in tax outcomes--GAAP ETRs, Cash ETRs, or UTBs, suggesting that firms' tax behavior does not change following receipt of the PLR. We find firms that disclose PLRs also change tax disclosure, suggesting they perceive and want to convey to stakeholders this decreased audit risk. Our study contributes to the literature on corporate tax strategy, voluntary disclosure, and tax enforcement by providing large-sample empirical evidence on the effects of PLRs. For policymakers, our results suggest that expanding the availability of PLRs or similar programs could improve tax compliance and reduce enforcement costs for both firms and the IRS.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现企业首次获得私人信函裁决(PLR)后审计风险降低，特别是小型企业和中等避税水平企业，但企业税务行为未改变。PLR在降低不确定性的同时需要自愿披露敏感税务信息。
AI.research_question: 企业在使用私人信函裁决(PLR)时，自愿私人税务披露与审计风险之间的权衡关系是什么？
AI.motivation: PLR允许企业向国税局寻求特定交易税务处理的约束性指导，减少不确定性但需要自愿披露敏感税务信息，这种权衡关系尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业税务策略理论、自愿披露理论、税收执法理论
AI.method: 使用从上市公司SEC文件中披露的PLR新数据集进行实证分析
AI.findings: 首次获得PLR的企业审计可能性降低；结果集中在小型企业和中等避税水平企业；企业税务行为(GAAP ETRs、Cash ETRs、UTBs)未改变；披露PLR的企业也改变了税务披露，表明他们感知并希望向利益相关者传达降低的审计风险
AI.theory_contributions: 为企业税务策略、自愿披露和税收执法的文献提供了关于PLR影响的大样本实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：扩大PLR或类似项目的可用性可以改善税收合规性，降低企业和国税局的执法成本

title: The Heterogeneous Effects of Supply Shocks in Necessity Goods
affiliations: Stockholm University - Institute for International Economic Studies (IIES), Nova School of Business and Economics, Danmarks Nationalbank (The Central Bank of Denmark) and Nova School of Business and Economics

detail.title: The Heterogeneous Effects of Supply Shocks in Necessity Goods
detail.abstract: We study the efficacy of price subsidies-implemented via lower value-added taxes-in addressing sectoral supply shocks in the presence of non-homothetic preferences and imperfect pass-through. In our heterogeneous-agent model, sectoral shocks generate recessions in both necessity and luxury goods, with necessity recessions imposing larger costs on the bottom 30% of the income distribution. A subsidy that lowers the price of necessity goods is welfare-reducing: high-income households respond disproportionately even though these goods account for a smaller share of their consumption. In contrast, cash transfers reduce the welfare losses associated with sectoral supply shocks. Central to our findings is that the model aligns closely with the empirically observed non-homothetic behavior of households and the imperfect pass-through, which we also document.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在非位似偏好和不完全传导下，价格补贴（通过降低增值税实施）应对部门供给冲击的效果。研究发现，必需品补贴反而会降低福利，因为高收入家庭反应过度；而现金转移能更好地减少福利损失。
AI.research_question: 价格补贴（通过降低增值税）在应对部门供给冲击时的效果如何？与现金转移相比哪种政策更有效？

AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性代理人模型，包含非位似偏好和不完全价格传导机制
AI.method: 构建异质性代理人模型，结合实证观察到的非位似偏好行为和不完全传导现象
AI.findings: 必需品价格补贴反而降低整体福利，因为高收入家庭反应过度；现金转移能有效减少部门供给冲击带来的福利损失
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在非位似偏好和不完全传导条件下，价格补贴可能产生反直觉的福利效应
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要启示：在部门供给冲击下，现金转移比价格补贴更有效

title: Language and Economic Decisions
affiliations: Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca - Department of Psychology, IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca and IMT School for Advanced Studies Lucca - Analysis of Complex Economic Systems Unit

detail.title: Language and Economic Decisions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All others declare that they have no relevant or material financial interests that relate to the research described in the paper “Language and Economic Decisions”.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The experimental part of this work has been approved by the Ethics Committee of the University of Parma, Italy (Prot.: #279677).
declarations.funderStatement: This work was partly supported by the University of Parma (Grant FIL/2024 Prot. 0093910)

detail.abstract: Many economic problems are framed using language. We introduce a language-based utility function to rationalize how linguistic framing shapes decision-making. We derive a prediction in the dictator game and empirically test it across 107 experimental instructions. Language is evaluated using deep learning and human methods: BERT, MoralBERT, GPT, and experimental subjects. GPT evaluations most accurately predict giving behavior. We assess robustness by deriving predictions in equity-efficiency trade-off, ultimatum, and corruption games, and by showing that GPT evaluations predict human behavior also in these contexts. Our results show that language is a quantifiable dimension of economic decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文引入基于语言的效用函数来解释语言框架如何影响决策，在独裁者游戏中验证预测，并通过BERT、MoralBERT、GPT和人类评估方法分析语言。GPT评估最能预测捐赠行为，该发现在公平效率权衡、最后通牒和腐败游戏中得到验证。
AI.research_question: 语言框架如何影响经济决策？语言是否可以作为经济决策的可量化维度？
AI.motivation: 许多经济问题都通过语言来构建框架，但语言在经济决策中的作用尚未得到系统量化研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于语言的效用函数，将语言框架纳入决策模型。
AI.method: 使用BERT、MoralBERT、GPT和人类评估方法分析107个实验指令的语言特征，并在独裁者游戏、公平效率权衡、最后通牒游戏和腐败游戏中验证预测。
AI.findings: GPT评估最能准确预测捐赠行为，语言框架对经济决策有显著影响，语言可以作为经济决策的可量化维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于语言的效用函数理论框架，将语言纳入经济决策模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了通过语言框架影响决策的实际工具，证明了AI语言模型在预测人类行为方面的有效性。

title: One Ratio, Two Risks: Credit and Interest Rate Trade-offs under the CBLR Framework
affiliations: Marshall University

detail.title: One Ratio, Two Risks: Credit and Interest Rate Trade-offs under the CBLR Framework

keywords: Government Policy and Regulation in Accounting

detail.abstract: This paper examines how the Community Bank Leverage Ratio (CBLR) framework alters banks' risk trade-offs by simplifying capital regulation. Using Call Report data from 2017-2023, I study community banks' credit and interest rate risk exposures after CBLR adoption. Results show that adopting banks reduce higher-risk commercial and industrial lending, consistent with a shift away from activities that increase credit risk. At the same time, adopters increase their reliance on longer-term securities and mortgage lending, heightening exposure to interest rate risk. These findings highlight that while the CBLR reduces compliance costs, it also encourages banks to reallocate risk rather than reduce it. The results contribute to research on capital regulation by showing how simplified rules affect bank behavior, and they inform ongoing policy debates on balancing regulatory burden with financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究社区银行杠杆率框架如何通过简化资本监管改变银行的风险权衡。研究发现采用该框架的银行减少了高风险商业和工业贷款，同时增加了对长期证券和抵押贷款的依赖，表明银行重新分配风险而非减少风险。

AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了简化监管规则如何影响银行风险重新分配，丰富了资本监管对银行行为影响的研究

title: Sustainable Public Green Finance Under Domestic and Global Policy Uncertainties: Does Environmental Policy Stringency Matter? Evidence from OECD Nations Using Method of Moments Quantile-Based Analysis
affiliations: Holy Spirit University of Kaslik (USEK)

detail.title: Sustainable Public Green Finance Under Domestic and Global Policy Uncertainties: Does Environmental Policy Stringency Matter? Evidence from OECD Nations Using Method of Moments Quantile-Based Analysis
detail.abstract: This study fills the gaps by probing how policy uncertainties and the stringency of environmental policies (EPS), as well as their interactions, affect sustainable public green finance (PGF) in a sample of 19 OECD nations. The analysis employs a method of moments quantile-based analysis using fixed effects from 1996 to 2023. To accomplish these objectives, the present study focused on various policy uncertainties, including economic policy (DEPU) and energy-related uncertainties (DEUI) at the national level, alongside climate policy (GCPU) and world uncertainties (WUI) at the international level. Additionally, we utilized the EPS index and its sub-indices, which encompass market-based, non-market-based, and technology support policies, to assess the impact of environmental strategies thoroughly. Remarkably, the findings underscore that a rise in DEPU and WUI leads to an increase in PGF, while DEUI and GCPU have an adverse effect. Particularly, the findings show that the unfavourable impact of DEUI is more significant at higher levels of PGF, whereas GCPU has a more significant effect at lower levels of PGF. Furthermore, the findings reveal that the EPS index and its sub-indices have positive effects, and stricter environmental policies lead to stimulating PGF. Moreover, the interaction results indicate that the favorable impacts of the DEPU and WUI are intensified with increasing EPS, while the adverse effects of DEUI and GCPU are moderated. The findings are robust and have important implications for policymakers and investors.

title: Decumulation Confusions

detail.title: Decumulation Confusions
detail.abstract: This paper identifies ways in which advisers and writers persistently misunderstand the problem of spending down retirement savings held in lump-sum form (as opposed to life-annuity form).  The baseline misapprehension is that this “decumulation” problem is solvable at all: that there could, even in theory, be an efficient way to determine the velocity for drawing down a given sum in view of the unknowability of individual life-span.  A second error is that the problem is mostly relevant only to people of limited means.  Evidence is emerging that retirees of all descriptions the world over, decidedly including the affluent, do not know how to deploy lump-sum retirement wealth. On average – remarkably – retirees fail to spend down any principal at all, instead eventually dying with the bulk of savings more or less untouched, effectively by accident.  This evidently irrational behavior may in turn be partly due to advisors’ failure to communicate accurately the role life annuity contracts could play:  Annuities should not be thought of as an alternative method of “investing” lump-sum wealth, as frequently framed, but rather as a way of managing more intentionally the unknowable length of the spend-down period.  The paper concludes by arguing that despite the conceptual difficulties, we all have a moral duty to apprehend lump-sum retirement drawdown questions more clearly, and by suggesting a legislative proposal to help catalyze more effective thinking and planning about this subject in the United States.

title: Trade War and the Dollar Anchor

detail.title: Trade War and the Dollar Anchor
detail.abstract: We develop a general-equilibrium model in which the safety of a country's currency and the choice of its exchange-rate regime arise endogenously. Calibrated to pre-2025 data, the model replicates the U.S. dollar's safety premium, low Treasury yields, and its status as the world's anchor currency. Introducing a trade war that isolates U.S. goods markets from the world erodes the U.S. dollar's safety premium, raises U.S. interest rates, and lowers the world market value of U.S. firms. For sufficiently high tariffs, small economies optimally re-peg to the euro, precipitating a phase shift to a euro-centric international monetary system and a global welfare loss. The analysis implies that persistent trade wars may threaten the financial privileges the United States derives from the dollar's international role.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Theoretical and Applied Economics Volume XXXII (2025), No. 3(644), Autumn, pp. 301-322

detail.abstract: This study investigates the macroeconomic impacts of disasters in Türkiye from 1999 to 2023 using ARDL and Impulse Response Functions. Findings reveal that disaster-induced economic losses significantly reduce GDP per capita in both the short and long run. However, a rise in disaster victims appears to stimulate growth due to reconstruction and aid flows. Capital accumulation drives growth, while ODA has a temporary negative effect. Insurance and financial services consistently hamper growth, suggesting weak risk-transfer mechanisms. The study advocates strengthened financial resilience, increased recovery spending, and enhanced international cooperation to mitigate disaster risks and promote sustainable economic stability.

title: Don't Fear the Repo: The Evolution of Bank Behavior in a Post-Crisis Policy Environment
affiliations: University of Georgia

detail.title: Don't Fear the Repo: The Evolution of Bank Behavior in a Post-Crisis Policy Environment
detail.abstract: This paper examines how shifts in banks' exposure to repo markets and the expansion of deposit franchises have influenced their financial performance and balance sheet strength across three policy regimes: pre-GFC (1994-2007), GFC/ZIRP (2008-2015), and post-GFC (2016-2023). Using linear models, vector autoregressions, and a theoretical framework, I show the shifts in banks' equilibrium behavior based on risk preferences, collateral constraints, and the cost of funding. The lending and financing strategies diverged before the crisis, with risk-seeking banks prioritizing the maximization of their interest income and risk-averse banks benefiting from favorable repo terms by maintaining strong balance sheets. After the crisis, strategies converge as risk-seeking banks shift toward safer short-term funding, while risk-averse banks extend more credit amid diminishing repo market advantages, both of which are likely connected to the low-interest-rate environment.

title: The Effectiveness of Taxes on Two-Sided Markets: Evidence from Ride-Hailing in Chicago *

detail.title: The Effectiveness of Taxes on Two-Sided Markets: Evidence from Ride-Hailing in Chicago *
detail.abstract: This study evaluates the effectiveness of taxes as regulatory tools within two-sided markets, focusing on the ride-hailing industry in Chicago. Using a difference-indifferences approach, it examines how a city-wide per-unit tax impacts price levels and travel volumes. The analysis shows that tax pass-through rates vary with demand: approximately 70% during high-demand periods and 40% during low-demand periods. Additionally, ride-hailing usage decreased by 2% and 5% respectively, with minimal effects on congestion during peak hours. These results suggest that ride-hailing platforms adjust the tax burden based on price elasticity to maintain transaction volumes, demonstrating the complexity of using taxes as a regulatory mechanism in dynamic markets.

detail.abstract: This appendix introduces the Five Generations of Global Power (G⁰-G³) framework as part of the Third Generation in International Relations (3GIR) project. It provides a symbolic shorthand to explain how legitimacy and authority have evolved from tribal leadership to algorithmic governance. Unlike earlier theories of power that emphasized states, institutions, or economic inequality, this framework captures the dominant logic of control across history: tribal charisma, sacred law, industrial colonialism, globalized capitalism, and algorithmic infrastructures. By combining the generational sequence (G⁰-G³) with symbolic codes (P1, F, C, T1-T4, PRO, X, G1-G3), the appendix shows how visible forms of power intersect with hidden infrastructures that structure global order. The aim is not only to trace historical transformations but to provide a practical codebook for understanding contemporary symbolic and algorithmic governance. 2. Research Question How have the dominant logics of global power evolved from tribal authority to algorithmic governance, and why are symbolic codes (P1, F, C, T1-T4, PRO, X, G1-G3) necessary to capture the hidden infrastructures of legitimacy that earlier theories of power could not explain?

title: FINANCIAL SUPPORT OF THE CONSTRUCTION SECTOR ACTIVITIES: TRENDS, PROBLEMS AND OPPORTUNITIES

detail.abstract: The construction industry is the basis for the development of the economic systems of the regions and the state. The article presents an analysis of the current state of the construction industry, identifies the main trends in this segment of the economy. Particular attention is focused on the issues of financial support for the activities of the subjects of the construction industry. In modern conditions, the basic tool for attracting financial resources for the construction industry is project financing based on escrow accounts, which are characterized by certain advantages and risks for the participants in the interaction, the leveling of which is possible by improving the mechanism for using funds. The authors also considered the possibility of using additional sources of financial support for the construction industry through the use of project, corporate and infrastructure bonds, crowdlending, funds from large domestic funds, and reviving the practice of housing cooperatives. The development of approaches to financial support will expand the capabilities of the construction industry, intensify their activities and ensure a multiplier effect in the economy.
