title: The Rise of Sponsored Service for Clearing Repo
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: The Rise of Sponsored Service for Clearing Repo

publicationDetails.detailsText: Liberty Street Economics
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: https://doi.org/10.59576/lse.20251008

detail.abstract: Recently instituted rule amendments have initiated a large migration of dealer-to-client Treasury repurchase trades to central clearing. To date, the main avenue used to access central clearing is Sponsored Service, a clearing product that has, until now, received little attention. This post highlights the results from a recent Staff Report which presents a deep dive into Sponsored Service. Here, we summarize the description of the institutional details of this service and its costs and benefits. We then document some basic facts on how market participants use this service, based on confidential data.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国国债回购交易向中央清算迁移的现象，重点关注了Sponsored Service这一清算产品，探讨了其制度细节、成本效益以及市场参与者的使用情况。
AI.research_question: Sponsored Service作为国债回购交易中央清算的主要途径，其制度细节、成本效益如何？市场参与者如何使用这一服务？
AI.motivation: 近期规则修订促使大量交易商对客户的国债回购交易转向中央清算，而Sponsored Service作为主要清算途径却鲜有研究关注。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于中央清算理论和金融市场基础设施理论，分析Sponsored Service的制度安排。
AI.method: 使用机密数据进行分析，结合制度细节描述和成本效益评估。
AI.findings: 揭示了Sponsored Service的具体运作机制、成本效益特征，以及市场参与者使用该服务的基本模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了对Sponsored Service这一重要清算产品的研究空白，深化了对中央清算机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场参与者提供关于Sponsored Service使用策略的参考，为监管机构完善清算制度提供依据。

title: RavenPack Quantitative Research: Introducing The RavenPack Credit News Factors
affiliations: RavenPack International and Université Paris Dauphine

detail.title: RavenPack Quantitative Research: Introducing The RavenPack Credit News Factors
detail.abstract:
We introduce the RavenPack Event-Driven Credit Factors, a specialized framework designed to facilitate seamless integration of RavenPack News Analytics. These generic news-driven factors provide the starting point for a more targeted investigation, offering a user-friendly approach to sophisticating the decision-making process. To illustrate the effectiveness of these off-the-shelf factors, we perform credit event studies, and construct long-short credit portfolios for a diverse array of trading scenarios and present a comprehensive compilation of backtesting results that underscore its robustness and versatility across the universes.

Key findings include:

(i) Versatile alpha generation across the corporate credit universes: The Factors demonstrate robust alpha capture across the U.S. Investment-Grade and High-Yield universes for events around analyst ratings, credit ratings, earnings, price target, and stock price, spanning daily to monthly effective holding periods, and when controlling for bond characteristics.
(ii) High risk-adjusted returns for mid-frequency trading: When trading news around analyst ratings changes, the U.S. Investment-Grade and High-Yield universes exhibit an Information Ratio of 0.73 and 1.00, respectively, for an effective holding period of approximately one week and with a decent portfolio size. 
(iii) Complementary individual alphas at the event type level: Performance dispersion across event types, even within the same event group, allows combining the individual signals to complement uncorrelated sources of alpha.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了RavenPack事件驱动信用因子框架，通过新闻分析构建信用投资组合，在多个交易场景中展示了稳健的alpha生成能力。
AI.research_question: 如何利用新闻分析构建有效的信用投资因子，并在不同信用市场中获得稳健的alpha收益？
AI.motivation: 传统信用投资决策过程需要更精细化的工具，新闻驱动的因子可以为信用投资提供新的alpha来源和决策支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件驱动投资理论、新闻情绪分析、信用投资组合管理
AI.method: 信用事件研究、多空信用投资组合构建、回溯测试分析
AI.findings: 因子在美国投资级和高收益信用市场中均能稳健生成alpha；分析师评级变化新闻交易可获得高信息比率；不同事件类型的alpha具有互补性
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新闻驱动的信用因子框架，扩展了事件驱动投资理论在信用市场的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为信用投资者提供了现成的新闻驱动因子工具，可提升投资决策的精细化和效率

title: Technology in the Game of Football: The Innovations, and What the Future Holds.

detail.title: Technology in the Game of Football: The Innovations, and What the Future Holds.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial or personal relationships that could have influenced the research and findings presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research is based on doctrinal/legal analysis and secondary sources. No human participants or patient data were involved, and ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

contentType.other: An earlier version of this paper appeared in Emergence Magazine 1.0 (2023), published by the Technology Law Club, University of Nigeria.

detail.abstract:
Background: Football has always been a sport that relies on human judgement and decision making, but with the advancement of technology, the game has undergone many changes. Technologies such as the Video Assistant Referee (VAR), Goal-Line Technology (GLT), and the Electronic Performance and Tracking System (EPTS) have been introduced to improve refereeing accuracy, assist players in training, and provide fans with deeper insights into the game. These developments have modernized football but also raised new questions about the future role of technology in the sport. 
Objective: This paper examines the influence of established technologies on football while also considering future innovations, particularly the potential integration of robots and cyborgs, which until recently belonged to the realm of science fiction. It seeks to assess how such developments (the future innovations) might reshape the sport and how global football regulators (the International Federation of Association Football (FIFA) and the International Football Association Board (IFAB))are likely to respond to them within their established legal frameworks.
Method: The study adopts a doctrinal research methodology, analyzing the Laws of the Game, and regulatory programmes such as the International Match Standard (IMS) and the FIFA Quality Programme, alongside scholarly commentary on sports law and technology. 
Results: Findings indicate that while FIFA and IFAB have integrated VAR and GLT into football governance, future technologies such as robotics and cyborgs present more complex challenges. Robots could play a role in training or even participation on the pitch, while cyborg technologies might enable injured players to extend or revive their careers. These possibilities raise concerns about fairness, the definition of a footballer, and the extent to which technology should alter the essence of the game. The paper further finds that many national jurisdictions are struggling to keep pace with these rapid technological shifts, particularly in regulating cyborg applications. 
Conclusion: The study concludes that FIFA and IFAB will likely embrace future technologies, provided they align with football's principles of fairness and integrity. It recommends that international football regulators maintain flexibility in accommodating innovation, while national legislatures take proactive steps to establish legal frameworks that anticipate technological convergence in sport. This dual approach will help ensure global consistency in governance and safeguard the spirit of football in an era of accelerating technological change.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了足球运动中现有技术（如VAR、GLT、EPTS）的影响，并分析了未来机器人及赛博格技术可能带来的变革，同时研究了国际足球管理机构对此的法律应对框架。
AI.research_question: 未来技术创新（特别是机器人和赛博格技术）如何重塑足球运动？国际足球管理机构（FIFA和IFAB）如何在现有法律框架内应对这些技术发展？
AI.motivation: 随着VAR、GLT等技术的引入，足球运动正在经历技术变革。未来机器人、赛博格等更先进技术的潜在应用，将带来关于比赛公平性、球员定义和足球本质的新问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于体育法与科技交叉理论，分析国际足球管理机构的法律框架，包括比赛规则、国际比赛标准和FIFA质量计划等。
AI.method: 采用教义学研究方法，分析比赛规则、国际比赛标准（IMS）、FIFA质量计划等监管文件，并结合体育法与技术的学术评论。
AI.findings: FIFA和IFAB已成功整合VAR和GLT技术，但机器人和赛博格技术带来更复杂挑战。机器人可能在训练或比赛中发挥作用，赛博格技术可能延长受伤球员职业生涯。这些技术引发公平性、球员定义和足球本质的担忧，许多国家法律体系难以跟上技术变革步伐。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了足球技术发展的理论分析框架，探讨了体育法在应对新兴技术时的适应性，为体育技术治理提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议国际足球管理机构保持灵活性以适应创新，同时各国立法机构应建立前瞻性法律框架，确保全球治理一致性，在技术加速变革时代保护足球精神。

title: Unification of the Gravitational Constant and the Speed of Light in Unified Field Theory: Proposal and Verification of the Universal Constant µ g
affiliations: Independent Researcher, Independent Researcher and Independent Researcher

detail.title: Unification of the Gravitational Constant and the Speed of Light in Unified Field Theory: Proposal and Verification of the Universal Constant µ g
detail.abstract:
In classical physics, the gravitational constant G and the speed of light c are regarded as mutually independent natural constants. However, the origin of their values and their intrinsic connection have long remained unexplained.

Based on the spiral-flow model of space proposed by Unified Field Theory (UFT), this paper points out that mass is not an inherent property of matter, but rather the coupling strength between matter and the flow of space. A universal constant, μg, is introduced to describe this coupling. Within this framework, we derive:
G =4πc2/μg

Using orbital data from the Sun–Earth system, Jupiter–Galilean satellites, and Saturn– major satellites, as well as independent observations of Mercury’s perihelion precession, we invert μg and obtain consistent values concentrated at 1.6914×1028 kg/m, with relative divergence only ∼ 4 × 10−4.


This demonstrates that μg retains universality across scales and phenomena, thereby proving that G and c are not independent, but rather share a common origin in the righthanded spiral flow of space. The results presented here provide an answer to the longstanding problem of the “origin of the gravitational constant” and open a new pathway for the unification of quantum mechanics and relativity.

AI.tldr: 基于统一场论的空间螺旋流模型，本文指出质量并非物质的固有属性，而是物质与空间流动的耦合强度。引入普适常数μg描述这种耦合，并推导出G=4πc²/μg的关系。通过太阳-地球系统、木星-伽利略卫星、土星-主要卫星的轨道数据以及水星近日点进动的独立观测，反演得到一致的μg值，证明G和c并非独立常数，而是源于空间右旋螺旋流的共同起源。
AI.research_question: 引力常数G和光速c是否相互独立？它们是否存在共同的物理起源？
AI.motivation: 经典物理学中，引力常数G和光速c被视为相互独立的自然常数，但它们的数值起源和内在联系长期以来无法解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统一场论(UFT)提出的空间螺旋流模型，认为质量是物质与空间流动的耦合强度，而非物质的固有属性。
AI.method: 使用太阳-地球系统、木星-伽利略卫星、土星-主要卫星的轨道数据，以及水星近日点进动的独立观测数据，反演普适常数μg的值。
AI.findings: 通过不同系统反演得到的μg值高度一致，集中在1.6914×10²⁸ kg/m，相对偏差仅为∼4×10⁻⁴，证明μg具有跨尺度和现象的普适性。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了G和c并非独立常数，而是源于空间右旋螺旋流的共同起源，为引力常数起源问题提供了答案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量子力学和相对论的统一开辟了新途径，建立了质量与空间流动耦合的新物理图像。

title: Quantifying Energy Consumption Variability in Injection Molding: A Meta-Regression Analysis
affiliations: Clemson University, Clemson University, University of Delaware, Clemson University and Clemson University

detail.title: Quantifying Energy Consumption Variability in Injection Molding: A Meta-Regression Analysis
detail.abstract: Injection molding dominates global thermoplastic production, making its energy performance critical to sustainability assessments. Specific energy consumption (SEC, kWh/kg) is a key metric for comparing manufacturing efficiency and is widely used in decision-support analyses, including life cycle assessment (LCA). However, for injection molding, SEC is typically represented as a single generic value, with limited consideration of variability across both process parameters and system configurations, potentially compromising the robustness of LCA results. Here, we conduct a meta-analysis of 160 energy-use data points from 15 peer-reviewed studies, spanning 20 material types and three machine types. We then apply a mixed-effects meta-regression, which identifies material theoretical heating energy, machine type, and injection utilization as the primary drivers of variability, collectively explaining 74.2% of the observed variance. We find a mean SEC of 3.13 kWh/kg, which is 2–2.5 times higher than default values reported in commonly used databases. Moreover, selecting polymers with low theoretical heat energy and maximizing injection utilization can reduce SEC by up to 50% across machine types. This study provides a data-driven model to improve LCA accuracy and guide energy efficiency strategies in sustainable materials manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过荟萃分析发现注塑成型能耗比常用数据库默认值高2-2.5倍，识别出材料理论加热能、机器类型和注射利用率是能耗变异的主要驱动因素，可解释74.2%的变异。
AI.research_question: 注塑成型过程中特定能耗(SEC)的变异性和主要驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 注塑成型在全球热塑性塑料生产中占主导地位，其能耗性能对可持续性评估至关重要。但目前SEC通常表示为单一通用值，缺乏对工艺参数和系统配置变异性的考虑，可能影响生命周期评估(LCA)结果的稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 特定能耗(SEC)作为制造效率比较的关键指标，广泛应用于生命周期评估等决策支持分析。
AI.method: 对来自15篇同行评审研究的160个能耗数据点进行荟萃分析，涵盖20种材料类型和3种机器类型，并应用混合效应元回归分析。
AI.findings: 平均SEC为3.13 kWh/kg，比常用数据库默认值高2-2.5倍；材料理论加热能、机器类型和注射利用率是SEC变异的主要驱动因素，共同解释了74.2%的观测变异；选择低理论加热能的聚合物和最大化注射利用率可降低SEC达50%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了数据驱动的模型来改进LCA准确性，识别了注塑成型能耗变异的关键驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可持续材料制造中的能效策略提供指导，帮助企业通过材料选择和工艺优化降低能耗。

title: The Credit Card Spending Channel of Monetary Policy:  Micro Evidence from Account-level Data
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Boston and Federal Reserve Bank of Boston

detail.title: The Credit Card Spending Channel of Monetary Policy:  Micro Evidence from Account-level Data

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Boston Working Paper No. 25-10

detail.abstract: Monetary policy impacts consumer spending via the effect of interest rate changes on credit card borrowing. Using supervisory account-level spending and balance data, we estimate that a 1 percentage point increase in the interest rate reduces credit card spending by nearly 9 percent and revolving balances by close to 4 percent. Aggregate results are primarily driven by revolving accounts, while we estimate small and statistically insignificant interest-rate elasticity for transaction accounts. Consistent with financial constraints, low-credit-score accounts tend to adjust spending, while high-credit-score accounts adjust balances.

AI.tldr: 使用监管账户层面的支出和余额数据研究发现，利率提高1个百分点会使信用卡支出减少近9%，循环余额减少近4%。这些总体效应主要由循环账户驱动，而交易账户的利率弹性较小且统计上不显著。
AI.research_question: 货币政策如何通过利率变化影响信用卡借贷和消费者支出？
AI.motivation: 理解货币政策传导机制，特别是利率变化如何通过信用卡渠道影响消费者支出行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制理论，信贷约束理论，消费者行为理论
AI.method: 使用监管账户层面的支出和余额数据进行实证分析
AI.findings: 利率提高1个百分点导致信用卡支出减少近9%，循环余额减少近4%；低信用评分账户倾向于调整支出，高信用评分账户倾向于调整余额
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对货币政策通过信用卡渠道传导机制的理解，揭示了不同信用评分群体对利率变化的异质性反应
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行制定货币政策提供实证依据，帮助金融机构更好地理解客户行为对利率变化的反应
